items.name: Twiggy Sword
items.description: This basic sword won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Smithy Sword
items.description: This well-forged sword is ideal for beginners.

items.name: Fwell Sword
items.description: Highly prized by young Iops, this sword will make a hero of you if you know how to handle it... However, be careful. Don't get too attached to it as it always falls down a well. Eventually, here or there, it'll fall down a well. Don't even try to avoid wells... you could be in a desert and THIS SWORD WOULD FALL DOWN A WELL. Got it?

items.name: The Sad Blade
items.description: This sword, soaked in a young Boowolf's tears, is said to bring luck and is supposed to fill warriors with courage on the battlefield. Ah, the naivety of terror.

items.name: Ha Sword
items.description: Designed by a blacksmith with double vision, this sword is very popular in Brakmar. As a popular slogan in the local militia says, "Ha Sword, will travel!" Just the sight of it will leave even your most courageous enemies cross-eyed with terror.

items.name: Goultard
items.description: The sword Goultard was quenched in the blood of a Dragon Pig. The hero who can resist the sword's powerful stench will find himself climbing the social ladder very quickly indeed.

items.name: Badoul's Mane
items.description: This sword captures the sights, the sounds and the smells of Badoul, the brave, bloodthirsty and above all punctual warrior who one day left his clan due to artistic differences.

items.name: Infernal Sharp
items.description: Sharp and diabolical: these were the wide-eyed words of the succubus who fathered this deadly little minx. Minx? Fathered? Damn, that was the page about Vald's sister. Sorry about that.

items.name: Owl Amulet
items.description: This amulet increases the wearer's Intelligence.

items.name: Bear Amulet
items.description: This amulet increases the wearer's Strength.

items.name: Boowolf Amulet
items.description: This amulet increases the wearer's Vitality.

items.name: Twiggy Bow
items.description: This basic bow won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Twiggy Daggers
items.description: This basic pair of daggers won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Wisdom Ring
items.description: This ring increases the wearer's Wisdom.

items.name: Chance Ring
items.description: This ring increases the wearer's Chance.

items.name: Agility Ring
items.description: This ring increases the wearer's Agility.

items.name: Bowisse's Boots
items.description: These exceptional boots will grant you an extra Movement Point in combat. However, the smell of Bowisse's feet will quickly stop you in your tracks again if you accidentally bring them too close to your nose.

items.name: Iop's Crushers
items.description: These boots are perfect for that special coup de grace.

items.name: Twiggy Wand
items.description: This basic wand won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Twiggy Staff
items.description: This basic staff won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Twiggy Hammer
items.description: This basic hammer won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Twiggy Shovel
items.description: This basic shovel won't make a hero out of you, that's for sure.

items.name: Power Belt
items.description: This Power Belt will render you particularly powerful during fights but its weight will considerably decrease your Agility.

items.name: The Gougnole
items.description: The Gougnole is made of a moon stone that was marinated for 5,000 years in a barrel of beer. This has inevitably endowed it with terrific powers.

items.name: Golden Destiny
items.description: The Golden Destiny will considerably increase your Vitality and Agility.

items.name: The Celestial Brooch
items.description: People say the famous blacksmith Boulgur made this brooch. Yes, the guy who created weapons for the gods.

items.name: The Stars Custard Tart
items.description: This amulet, cast in a mixture of celestial eggs and milky stardust, must be kept refrigerated.

items.name: Fame
items.description: This powerful amulet will certainly make a name for you.

items.name: Ice Wand
items.description: A well-carved wand, recommended for beginners.

items.name: Limbo Wand
items.description: This wand comes from the Syrastass Limbo. The legends say that it can make entire fields of daisies bloom, if asked politely by its bearer.

items.name: Sky Wand
items.description: Helle from High in the Sky blessed this wand. It gives its bearer Agility and Vitality in combat.

items.name: Leafy Staff
items.description: A well-carved staff, recommended for beginners.

items.name: Staff Bonely
items.description: This staff increases Wisdom. It has one awkward side effect... I'm sure you can guess.

items.name: Sacred Staff
items.description: This staff increases Vitality and can be eaten if required.

items.name: God Rod
items.description: The God Rod is a fearsome weapon. Warriors have been known to win battles in their sleep with the aid of this... fearsome weapon.

items.name: Hook
items.description: The Hook was found on a corpse, near a huge, decomposing Crocodyl.

items.name: Raziel
items.description: This sword was blessed by the tears of the angel Raziel. Terribly destructive, it's powerful enough to help you fend off the most fearsome of enemies.

items.name: Tot's Belt
items.description: If you ever work out how to get this incredible item around your waist, you'll be one of the luckiest heroes in the universe. It used to belong to the strongest and most attractive of the bearded heroes of old.

items.name: Kryst O'Ball
items.description: This living staff roamed the darkest corners of Amakna for aeons. Now it sleeps deeply, only waking up every 300 years to move to a different place or to look for a different owner. It favours the stench of small, sweaty tunnels.

items.name: Smithy Daggers
items.description: These well-forged daggers are recommended for beginners.

items.name: Croclage Daggers
items.description: These well-forged daggers will make a worthy adversary of you.

items.name: Bashers
items.description: Bashers are formidable daggers favoured by assassins who must dispatch the most bloodthirsty of warriors.

items.name: Blessdags
items.description: These Blessdags once belonged to the renowned Ogre 'Dark Hand' who died while fighting a Bimd'Oole paladin. Apparently, his blood animates their twisted blades.

items.name: Chakra Style
items.description: The Chakra Style... a pair of daggers that once belonged to the greatest female thief of all time. Chakra was the first to open the doors of the Osaroth Temple and steal the precious relics hidden within.

items.name: Scraping Hammer
items.description: A well-forged hammer, recommended for beginners.

items.name: Ivory Hammer
items.description: This hammer increases its bearer's intelligence.

items.name: Kaiser
items.description: Kaiser was the name of the dastardly Dragon Pig who destroyed Bounkaïda Village many years ago. When the militia got the better of this monster, the smiths used his remains to make weapons. This hammer is one of them.

items.name: Ragnarok
items.description: Ragnarok is powerful enough to raise a storm. It can also raise the temper of your friends if you don't know how to use it properly.

items.name: Cerberus
items.description: This hammer once belonged to the guardian of the Door of Hell. He prevented the living from coming in, the dead from going out and the living dead from urinating through the letterbox. Dirty monkeys!

items.name: Barabas
items.description: Barabas is a fearsome weapon: it allows its wearer to move with stealth and ease and most importantly, to become even deadlier in close combat.

items.name: Sargasse
items.description: Sargasse once belonged to a child with fearsome powers. No one has seen it since it was reportedly traded for a bag of marbles.

items.name: Crapouille's Shovel
items.description: A well-balanced shovel, recommended for beginners.

items.name: Scratchy Shovel
items.description: An extremely well-forged shovel, this tool will make a worthy adversary of you.

items.name: Axel
items.description: Halfway between an axe and a shovel, Axel was one of the seven weapons used by the demon Kajlir to overcome the Brotherhood of the Enutrofs, vicious adventurers searching for the Crimson Dofus.

items.name: Greybeard
items.description: Greybeard was the favourite weapon of the demon-dwarf Assan Cehef who terrorised countless villages with his surprise attacks.

items.name: Vital Belt
items.description: This belt increases its wearer's Vitality, increasing their chances of surviving a fight.

items.name: Strong Belt
items.description: This belt increases its wearer's Strength.

items.name: Nimble Belt
items.description: This belt increases its wearer's Agility.

items.name: Disconcerting Bow
items.description: The Disconcerting Bow is not new by any means, but it can be very useful.

items.name: Xaver
items.description: Xaver is an efficient bow. It once belonged to the great baker Xavier. Between two batches, he used it to distribute bread to the monsters around his bakery.

items.name: The Chafer Hammer
items.description: This hammer is a beautiful, strange and fascinating weapon. Make sure you get nice and close to your enemy before you use it - that's the way Chafers like it, after all!

items.name: Nomoon
items.description: This bow is powerful enough to shoot an arrow to the moon.

items.name: Yamato String
items.description: Yamato's Rope has made more than one monster's heart beat a little faster. A finely tuned weapon, it can direct arrows to even the most well-hidden targets.

items.name: Rocky Ring
items.description: A ring set with a rare stone. Do I need to explain the name?

items.name: Gobball Tear
items.description: If we are to believe one renowned adventurer, this amulet contains a tear from a Gobball, which has the same properties and stench as Gobball Leather tea.

items.name: Rainbow Necklace
items.description: Collectors prize this necklace, you will certainly get a good price for it.

items.name: Crackler Shovel
items.description: The only thing as solid as a Crackler is a Crackler, that's why this Crackler hunting shovel is made of Crackler Stone.

items.name: Tofu Sandals
items.description: These sandals are made from the feathers of boiled Tofu and the sole from Tofu Beak, a very resistant material. Protracted wearing can render the wearer as daft as a Tofu.

items.name: Faillette Boots
items.description: Attack is the best defence. With these anti-aggression boots, you will easily send muggers packing. And those guys who come up to you at crossroads to clean your mount's teeth.

items.name: Tabi Staff
items.description: This staff used to be very handy for Amakna breeders who wanted to keep their flocks of Tabis in one place. It doesn't actually do much, but it is very light. Great for running after Gobballs.

items.name: Kam Assutra Amulet
items.description: This amulet gives the wearer special abilities: they will be possessed by a mysterious aura, which flows through their bodies and increases their physical abilities tenfold.

items.name: Krokette Amulet
items.description: This amulet turns pink when you're feeling perky. Rumour has it that it also increases your chances of finding good items tenfold.

items.name: Sram Amulet
items.description: Handmade by one of the greatest Sram jewellers, this amulet is made of small skulls carved in bone, helping its wearer escape perilous situations.

items.name: Deulegarnoulle Amulet
items.description: This amulet comes from the Nordic regions. It will increase your summoning powers.

items.name: Gob-Trotter Blade
items.description: This blade was originally forged for Gob-Trotters but is actually much too heavy for those puny goblins. It's a very light weapon for normal beings, however – light enough to deliver rapid blows in succession.

items.name: Slash
items.description: This strange double-bladed sword was originally used to prune trees and cut through dense forests. The lumberjacks soon realised that it was also an excellent weapon against other creatures.

items.name: The Arc de Triomphe
items.description: As its name indicates, this bow will help you on your path to consistent victory. A skilled Cra architect without an ounce of imagination later stole the same name for one of his monuments.

items.name: Rain Bow
items.description: This is the bow of choice in the region. From what people say, you'll find treasure where its arrows fall. You have to make sure you fire them towards the end of a rainbow, but I still think it's crazy.

items.name: Joan's Bow
items.description: Joan was a little crazy, always hearing Tabis burping she said... They confiscated her bow - for her own good, mind you - and finally decided to burn her at the stake altogether. She burnt great, she did. Really something else... And I've seen a few burnings, me... I still have her singed kneecap if you want... come... hey! Where... ahhhh!

items.name: Ber Ed Stick
items.description: Originally made to be eaten, this baguette became a fearsome weapon when Xavier the Baker left it in the oven for 234 years. Why did he leave it for so long? Well, he reached a point where he'd had enough of making cheese sandwiches, and so he started handing out knuckle sandwiches to the monsters around the bakery instead. He had so much fun, he forgot all about the baguette.

items.name: Liriel's Wand
items.description: This wand used to belong to Liriel, the Eniripsa, who suffered a painful death from a strawberry overdose and lost his wings with a cry that curdled more than just the cream. Collectors are surprisingly desperate to get hold of this wand, given that it's said to be cursed.

items.name: Bwork Magus Staff
items.description: Without their staffs, Bwork magi are as harmless as peckless Tofus. Need I say more about the power of this staff?

items.name: Gwandpa Wabbit's Staff
items.description: This staff can levitate Cawwots! Mind you, that's not much use in fights.

items.name: Bwork Archer Bow
items.description: The Bwork Archer Bow is extremely simple to use. It was designed with the Bwork Archers in mind... A bloody Tofu could use it... The catch is that you have to be as strong as a Crackler to string it.

items.name: Chafer Blade
items.description: This blade once belonged to Metzger the butcher, who used it to cut up bones. A Chafer managed to steal it from him and the blade became a fearsome weapon in his hands. Whole families of shoe salesmen went out of business, not to mention the glove trade... just terrible.

items.name: Leurnettes
items.description: These daggers allow you to steal anything and everything, anything from everyone, or everything from anyone, or everyone from any... no that doesn't work... They're great, though.

items.name: Eurfolles Daggers
items.description: These legendary daggers are a true collector's item for any self-respecting Sram. They are so revered that even some of these rats refuse to steal them.

items.name: Birming Hammer
items.description: This very special hammer was made of Kwak Beaks. That's why it's so prickly when it knocks you head over heels!

items.name: Ano Rak Ring
items.description: According to some legends, this ring protects against bad weather. In reality, this has never been proven because it has never rained in Amakna.

items.name: Golden Rhizome
items.description: This shovel is a very efficient tool for cutting nutsedge, a type of weed. It's also an excellent weapon for taking care of the weeds you'll find in the inns of Amakna.

items.name: Celery-Tea's Boots
items.description: These boots once belonged to a cook who was always in a big rush. He spent his time criss-crossing the land of Amakna looking for celery-tea.

items.name: The Klebik
items.description: This kind of sword is forged for the bodyguards of a renowned and wealthy shopkeeper. Its main use consists of frightening thieves but when murder is required - a tenacious burglar, a fussy customer - you'll find it equal to the task.

items.name: Valuable Ring
items.description: This ring increases Strength and Chance.

items.name: Stamina Belt
items.description: This simple belt increases stamina.

items.name: The Tail
items.description: This sword symbolises a body part of which Ecaflips are particularly proud. If you don't feel it's hypocrisy to take it, be my guest.

items.name: The Infernal Tail
items.description: The Infernal Tail is really... infernal. If you don't use it properly, it will drive your enemies and teammates completely crazy. Before long, you won't have any teammates left, just enemies. Nobody has ever been known to use it properly, so, well, you've been warned.

items.name: Ecalisor
items.description: A long time ago, King Allister gave this ring to Isidor, a smart cat, renowned for his incomparable Agility.

items.name: Treechnid Root Staff
items.description: This staff is carved out of a huge Treechnid Root, and its main use is in close combat. The only problem for the owner is that its roots regenerate when in contact with water... That includes rain, by the way.

items.name: Hammer of Dawn
items.description: This ridiculously small hammer was used by Zokrim the peasant. Every day at dawn, he would work on his useless, meandering fences which still stretch all over his territory like confused spider webs.

items.name: Oak Killer
items.description: This axe enables you to easily cut down trees, even the biggest ones. It is, above all, appreciated for its heavy weight which can cut a Bwork into three pieces. The only requirement is that you are strong enough to lift it!

items.name: Captain Chafer Amulet
items.description: Some say the Chafer is sensitive and distinguished, because his amulet carries the skulls of his dead cousins. Others say he's a beastly creature, because it was he who killed them.

items.name: Treechnid Root Bow
items.description: Though you can kill the Treechnids, their wood never truly dies... this makes it incredibly difficult to work. All the same, killing a Treechnid with an arrow made of the root of one of its brothers will really hit hard, and if they don't die, you can be sure it'll ruin their lives forever! Good show!

items.name: Treechnid Root Wand
items.description: This wand makes use of the magic properties of the Treechnid Root. Beware of the side effects of this living wand, it can sometimes turn against its owner.

items.name: Hornbeam Pruner
items.description: This axe has Woodee the Lumberjane to thank for its name... She knew how to turn on the charm and divert the lumberjacks' attention, running in and stealing all the best trees for herself while they scurried off to pay ridiculous prices for rosebuds, sugarcane and those little snow globes that you shake... as soppy as wells they were.

items.name: Pushn Shovel
items.description: An Enutrof builder who'd had a few drinks too many at the tavern realised one night that this shovel could do more than dig holes in the ground.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.description: With this Magnifying Glass, you'll be able to analyse the elements of your surroundings. Treasures will be yours!

items.name: Yew Axe
items.description: This axe is the only tool that can cut down enchanted trees. It's the silver bullet of axes.

items.name: Boulgourde of the Glades
items.description: This axe once belonged to the renowned lumberjack, Brouce Boulgoure. He used to be married to Kassiopee Baine, another great lumberjack's daughter. Many's the time this weapon protected him when he was alone in the forest.

items.name: Ivan Nowe String
items.description: This bow once belonged to Ivan Nowe, a foolhardy Cra who had a cruel habit of attacking stray Tofus. This bow first puzzles the enemy before efficiently killing them.

items.name: Crab Amulet
items.description: This delicate but original whitish amulet is made of Crab.

items.name: Fisherman Amulet
items.description: This amulet, set with fish scales, is supposed to bring its wearer good luck when he puts out to sea on stormy nights.

items.name: Pirate Amulet
items.description: Many sailors have been impressed by this terrifying amulet. All you have to do is put it on and you'll be a feared warrior.

items.name: Gobball Master Staff
items.description: This staff allowed Paile Ingalsse, breeder of Gobballs, to summon the Tofus that kept his flocks safe. After a tragic accident, he discovered that it was also a fierce weapon.

items.name: Kralove Cutting Sword
items.description: Thanks to this sword, the celebrated sailor Mobby Diquerivurs sliced the tentacles off the equally famous Giant Kralove of Moon Island, much feared for his habit of smothering drunken sailors.

items.name: Pointed Hat
items.description: Everyone will want this magnificent hat when you go the masked ball, hey hey!

items.name: Somoon Fisherman Amulet
items.description: Fishing a Somoon is quite a miracle but don't worry, with this amulet around your neck, there's no such word as "can't".

items.name: Amulet of the Depths
items.description: This Amulet of the Depths was found in the submerged shipwreck of the renowned Kralove fisherman, Tom Fawyer, also famous for his lousy jokes at the pirates' bar.

items.name: Rento Bow
items.description: Fishermen used this bow to clean the vermin off the coastlines of Amakna... The cowards usually committed the pesticide from the windows of the local bars.

items.name: Tofu Master Staff
items.description: This staff allowed Shika Ingalsse, leader of Gobballs, to summon the Tofus that kept her flocks safe. After a tragic accident, she discovered that it was also a fierce weapon.

items.name: Tabi Master Staff
items.description: This staff allowed Gramine Ingalsse, leader of Gobballs, to summon the Tofus that kept his flocks safe. After a tragic accident, he discovered that it was also a fierce weapon.

items.name: Chestnut Tree Eater
items.description: This axe has no outstanding features except its natural lightness which is due to the Chestnut Wood it is made from. It has a shaft as light as a feather from the tail of a young Evil Tofu.

items.name: Cherry Splitter
items.description: "There's nothing wrong with this axe... Seriously, nothing. Really." The wise words of Brouce Boulgoure, lumberjack extraordinaire. Its Cherry Wood shaft cushions vibrations when you're cutting trees down or splitting Bworks' skulls.

items.name: Walnut Cutter
items.description: This axe doesn't look special, but it gets the job done. Brouce Boulgoure the lumberjack won the Bwork Dwarf tree-cutting championship with this modest tool - that's saying something.

items.name: Maple Tree Eater
items.description: This axe's special feature is that it never gets rusty, so don't be surprised when hungry lumberjacks start licking the sweet tree sap from its blade.

items.name: Pirate Cloak
items.description: This cloak once belonged to Zokrim, an old pirate. He must have been rather unlucky.

items.name: Crimson Dofus
items.description: Ignemikahl the Fire Dragon created the Crimson Dofus. I would tell you that it stinks of sulphur... but it stinks of so many other things too.

effects.formatted:
For each attack suffered, the final damage inflicted is increased by 1% for 1 turn.
The effects can stack 10 times.

items.name: Slob Headgear
items.description: Besides its has-been look, the Slob Headgear is great for those high-noon duels... keeps some sun out of your eyes.

items.name: Makroute
items.description: Makroute is a very affectionate dog. He never leaves his master's side. A fine animal.

items.name: Sortingat Hogwat
items.description: The Sortingat Hogwat comes from a famous School of Magic. This lively creature has met the greatest wizards of our time, like Mrs Magoa AlaGale, Mr Doublegore and the renowned Misk'arry Rotter.

items.name: The Troma
items.description: The Troma is as shady as an eraserhead made of Bherb hairs, and that's saying something (if you don't know what an eraserhead made of Bherb hairs looks like, refer to the great books of the Hen Pens).

items.name: Pandawa
items.description: Ah, the Pandawa, look at the face on him! Just like his good friend Makroute, he spends all his time on his owner's head. This lazy beast never needs to move more than an arm's length - he steals all he needs straight from his owners hands!

items.name: The Oiram
items.description: The Oiram has many fans throughout the World who just love its classy look. This hat once belonged to a plumber who spent his days cleaning pipes. He was quite stylish himself.

items.name: Kritter
items.description: This demon skull, constructed from various bones, gives its bearer a graceful and elegant look. Even your lover will be sick with envy.

items.name: Dora
items.description: This magical hat, which looks like an upside-down wicker fruit basket, is in fact... a magical upside-down fruit basket hat. It will certainly impress the neighbours, especially if they are Bwork Magus apprentices.

items.name: Eachure Hat
items.description: With this hat made from Chafer Lancer Leather Briefs, the female Bwork Magi won't be able to resist you. That's not a good thing, mind - many are known to wear long, red beards and none are known for their femininity.

items.name: Tromatising Mask
items.description: If what you're looking for is a bit of trauma, you'll find great relief in this magnificent Rokokonut. We remind you that a free straw and many a mouthful of fresh Rokokonut-flavoured goodness are waiting for you inside.

items.name: Crystal O'Ball
items.description: Hung 'Short Memory' Lekahurse owned a magnificent crystal ball - his grandpa gave it to him. He wisely decided to hold on to it for the rest of his life. In fact, he put it on his hat which he never took off again, until one day, a jealous breeze took it away. He followed, and the breeze seemed to mock him, suspending the hat in the air, and whipping it away just as his searching fist approached. Not without a sense of decency, the wind took him home for a brief visit once a season and when it sensed the poor man was close to the end, took him to the edge of a cliff, hung the hat there for a moment and down Lekahurse tumbled, at peace at last.

items.name: Minot'Horn
items.description: With this Minotoror Horn hat, you'll have no problem passing yourself off as a Minotoror if your confidence in your own powers is failing. This trickery only works on simple-minded creatures such as Iops and Tofus.

items.name: Pilbocks Hat
items.description: This brand new, magical, Green Larva Skin hat gives its bearer a jolly appearance... jolly but incredibly stupid. We can't always get what we want and this hat is a perfect example.

items.name: Lorko Kasko
items.description: This hat of enchanted bark once belonged to Lorko, a lumberjack. He challenged the renowned Brouce Boulgoure to an Elm uprooting duel in Liroye Merline.

items.name: Korko Klako
items.description: The Korko Klako is a beautifo hato worno by the mo handso Sadido.

items.name: Jouik Krampe
items.description: This magnificent leather mask once belonged to Jouik Krampe, cousin of Zeurg. They were both fond of tight leather clothes. A bit like Captain Chafer, only not as depraved.

items.name: Gulliver
items.description: This hat is so original that you will soon think you're fantastic, unique and on top of the World. It is said that in bygone days, Rakmar Bilgout used it to charm the queen of the Gobballs. He didn't hesitate to cut her throat open afterwards... Nothing to do with the hat I hope.

items.name: Silimelle's Wedding Ring
items.description: This magnificent wedding ring was stolen from Silimelle, a female brewer, during a boozy meal at the inn. See what happens when you accept drinks from strangers?

items.name: Ragalde's Boots
items.description: Without any doubt, Ragalde was one of the most foolhardy Iop warriors. With these magic boots, he slew a great number of enemies.

items.name: Blo'up Belt
items.description: This belt is the weapon of choice for crowd control in Amakna prison and at the annual town fair.

items.name: Emerald Dofus
items.description: Greener than a sick Tofu, the Emerald Dofus was created by Aerafal the Air Dragon. To create such a green thing, he was certainly feeling airsick. That bodes well for its powers, doesn't it?

effects.formatted:
At the end of the turn, gives 100% of the owner's level in shield points for each adjacent enemy.
Summons are not counted.

items.name: Turquoise Dofus
items.description: The Turquoise Dofus was created by Aguabrial, the Water Dragon. Isn't it incredible what a Dragon can do with some water?

effects.formatted: For each Critical Hit inflicted, the final damage is increased by 1% for 3 turns. Can be stacked 10 times.

items.name: Horned Staff
items.description: "I am the eggman, I am the Dofus. Waka fu ku." The last words recorded by the renowned axe smith-cum-minstrel, Jon Lemon. Soon after, he was crushed by a giant Tofu egg.

items.name: Bowisse's Cloak
items.description: This cloak is an often underestimated one-of-a-kind. It is made of Green Larva Skin, giving it a most pleasant, rugged appearance.

items.name: Vampire Cloak
items.description: Marinated in pure blood for many long years, this cloak has acquired a ruby red colour that is very pleasing to the eye. This cloak is much favoured during the Al Howin's Day celebrations.

items.name: Dispenser of Justice Cloak
items.description: This cloak can only be worn by the great Bontarian dispensers of justice... It's not very popular.

items.name: Chogreloting Cheeken Cloak
items.description: This magnificent cloak was made with the feathers of the very last Cheeken of Amakna. It's a real rarity that collectors dream of hanging on their living room wall.

items.name: Farle Ingalsse's Scythe
items.description: This scythe once belonged to Farle Ingalsse himself. It is sharp enough to mow any kind of cereal and any kind of monsters hidden in cereal fields.

items.name: Koliet Aclou
items.description: This amulet tickles your curiosity... and your neck.

items.name: Royal Gantie
items.description: Don't mind its stuck-up name, this ring can only make your hero stronger. Okay, his chin will shrink too, but hey, who cares!

items.name: Camate
items.description: This ring influences your fate. You'll be tougher but less lucky. In other words, you improve your chances of living a long time and ruin your chances of living happily.

items.name: Einekeineux
items.description: These boots bring good fortune. Unfortunately, they decrease your resistance.

items.name: Ash Tree Eater
items.description: This axe is nothing exceptional but it is appreciated by lumberjack apprentices for its simplicity of use.

items.name: Swashbucloak
items.description: According to what people say, this legendary cloak makes you almost invisible when combined with the fencers' legendary sword, the Dart Onion, and to the legendary hat of the Six Rams of the Rahk Shepherds.

items.name: Ellinie Cloak
items.description: This light cloak comes from the Patitalian Country, a place where people communicate with their limbs. This explains the incredible lightness and complete freedom of movement given by the cloak.

items.name: Cape Ulais
items.description: Coming from the Mount Taigue, this cape ended up poisoning its former female owner... Strangely enough, if you wear it, it will increase your resistance.

items.name: Cape Ability
items.description: This cape has been made with infinite care and attention, it allows the wearer to find the enemy's weak point.

items.name: Sin Cape
items.description: A certain Mulba used this item to carry half her kitchen with her on a long, difficult quest to find the Seven Crystal Hens which fell from the stars. This cloak will make you strong and brave.

items.name: Salt 'n' Battery Cape
items.description: The battery cock whose feathers made this cape fought its killers for several days and nights before finally dying of exhaustion. Let me tell you, killing that crazy chicken nearly finished them off too.

items.name: Mori Arty's Cloak
items.description: This authentic bad guy cloak proves you belong to the gang of the diabolic Mori Arty. It is said that his bad luck equalled his astounding intelligence. Only true bad guys can wear it.

items.name: Maj'Hic Cloak
items.description: This cloak looks ordinary... but isn't. It can make its wearer invisible to the eyes of those who are not looking at him. Really impressive!

items.name: Itou Lascione Cape
items.description: This superb cloak once belonged to the Great Stratequerre. This renowned and expert strategist lord of war, hungry for the universe conquest, soon gave up his plans after having arrayed himself in the cloak. Really strange!

items.name: Agride
items.description: This very special axe was originally designed to teach budding lumberjacks the art of chopping. When it is well used, it can split a young carefree Treechnid in two, provided that such a Treechnid exists.

items.name: Lumberjack Amulet
items.description: This amulet, made exclusively of precious wood, is highly prized and loved by lumberjacks who usually exaggerate its abilities to offset the cost of the material.

items.name: Mulish Cat's Boots
items.description: Mulish Cat was a renowned Ecaflip, and the most stupid in his class. In combat, the only match for his nonexistent intelligence was his bewildering luck.

items.name: Fortifying Ring
items.description: The tradition of passing this ring down from grandfather to grandson gives it incredible power. This one is but a pale imitation of the original, but even so, it is much sought-after by collectors, whether they are Enutrofs or not.

items.name: Puny Owl Pendant
items.description: The jeweller's hand slipped while shaping this amulet, which imparts more intelligence to the wearer but in exchange, imparts a tear-inducing migraine, making it almost impossible to see anything.

items.name: Ano Rexik Ring
items.description: This strange little ring can increase the Agility of the wearer in exchange for Chance points.

items.name: Koober's Belt
items.description: This belt is all the rage among young Amaknians. A follower of Sadida, couturier by trade, is behind this fashion. When he sold it for the first time, he said: "Life is short, play hard!"

items.name: Cape of Good Hope
items.description: The magic effects of this cape are often overestimated, which inevitably causes heavy losses in adventurers, such as the notorious minstrel Jon Lemon.

items.name: Treechnidis Vivitus
items.description: This is a staff made of living Treechnid Roots. But watch out... it has a tendency to turn on its master. When it does decide to attack the same target as you, it can be very deadly.

items.name: Holy Sword
items.description: Holy Swords are awarded to young warriors during their training.

items.name: Knight Sword
items.description: The Knight Sword is an efficient and sturdy sword. Properly used, it can inflict serious damage upon your enemies.

items.name: Bwork Blade
items.description: This basic sword can usually be handled by the most cretinous of Bworks, that is to say the ones who are incapable of using a bow or a staff... Some of these geniuses even mistake the blade for the handle. The tradition in this case is for the Bwork to poke its own eyes out with its fingers... Lovely!

items.name: Whistling Bow
items.description: This bow fires its arrows so rapidly that the whistling sound travels for miles. A sound piece of advice: if you want to be discreet, equip it with a silencer.

items.name: Com Bow
items.description: Due to its restricted range, this bow is not very popular... Use it to weaken your enemies before finishing them off with a close-range weapon or a crafty spell.

items.name: Intelligence Wand
items.description: This wand increases the bearer's Intelligence.

items.name: Wisdom Wand
items.description: This wand increases the bearer's Wisdom.

items.name: Treering
items.description: This ring, made of Treechnid Bark, has great powers but carries great responsibility with it. However, in spite of its value, it is said to be cursed.

items.name: Kluh's Boots
items.description: These boots increase your Strength but they affect your Intelligence. They could even turn you into a Iop in case of prolonged and regular use.

items.name: Ring of Satisfaction
items.description: This ring increases AP in exchange for some Strength, Intelligence, Agility and Chance.

items.name: Strong Ring
items.description: This small ring increases Strength.

items.name: Nimble Ring
items.description: Amaknian collectors are desperate to get their fingers into this ring, though it's not worth a penny.

items.name: Vital Ring
items.description: This small ring increases Life.

items.name: Small Magic Ring
items.description: This small ring increases Intelligence.

items.name: Small Chance Ring
items.description: This ring increases the wearer's chance.

items.name: Little Frog
items.description: This small amulet increases Agility.

items.name: Chance Belt
items.description: This basic belt increases luck.

items.name: Strength Boots
items.description: These boots make whoever wears them stronger, but don't make the wearer any less stupid. When you're short on brains, you'd better have fists.

items.name: Intelligence Sandals
items.description: These sandals increase the intelligence of the wearer. They are also eternally fashionable. They are finished off with a breathable walnut sole for exquisite grip.

items.name: Nimble Boots
items.description: These boots increase the Agility of the wearer so that he can get into character as a Tofu every time he feels like making a fool of himself.

items.name: Chance Boots
items.description: These boots increase your luck in finding powerful items such as Gobball Slobber.

items.name: Dragolyre
items.description: Made of Dreggon remains, this splendid amulet is impressive enough to make your bravest enemies run home sobbing.

items.name: Concentration Boots
items.description: These boots are so comfortable that they instantly increase your concentration.

items.name: Gobball Boots
items.description: These boots are made of Gobball leather. Thanks to the smell they give off, breeders can approach and kill other Gobballs with the slightest of ease.

items.name: Sylvan Daggers
items.description: These daggers were created for cutting roots and young saplings in spring time but they were soon decommissioned in favour of quite a different purpose.

items.name: Dasguised
items.description: These modest-looking daggers are extremely dangerous. They are easily hidden down the pants which makes them a weapon of choice for murderous eunuchs throughout the land. The words chicken and egg come to mind.

items.name: Klime's Boots
items.description: According to the legend, these boots were secretly replaced by another pair, which though defective, were ultra-powerful; they were made by a clumsy, overworked shoemaker.

items.name: Chase Boots
items.description: With these boots, Hogmeiser used to chase off the only human beings he couldn't stand the sight of: children. Fortunately for them, the weight of the footwear prevented him from ever catching a single one.

items.name: Hogmeiser's Boots
items.description: These boots belonged to Hogmeiser for many years, before he actually lost them on a stupid bet with Grizmine. The moral of this story is... never gamble with an Ecaflip.

items.name: Hogmeiser's Worn Boots
items.description: These boots belonged to Hogmeiser for many years. They are so worn they are crippling. A skilled shoemaker should be able to repair them.

items.name: Hogmeiser's Golden Boots
items.description: These magnificent Hogmeiser boots are finely peppered with precious stones, protecting you against magic attacks. Brouce Boulgoure himself used them to crush the Treechnid King's head many years ago, just to liven up the opening of the Trool Fair.

items.name: Silicate Amulet
items.description: Silicate made this amulet on a wintry morning for a famous adventurer named Rimb Vardi. He was hunting down an old Bwork Magus whose bungling magic was the root of many a natural disaster.

items.name: Autumn Leaf
items.description: This brooch was made one autumn morning in the depths of a Beech and Elm forest, near the Olag-Lacustre Island. It is considered to be a true relic by a great many lumberjacks.

items.name: Ancestral Daggers
items.description: These powerful daggers, forged from Ancestral Amber according to ancient techniques, were used during the colonization of Moon Island. It soon became wild again.

items.name: Treechnid Splitter
items.description: This battle axe was forged by Kademlia Boulgoure to fight against the most terrifying Treechnids. Legend has it that this legendary weapon killed more Treechnids in a night than there are trees in Amakna.

items.name: Klime's Boots
items.description: These boots gave Klime the shoemaker such agility that he was able to ride Gobballs. He died when he mistook a Jelly for a Gobball, having spent an evening drinking in the tavern.

items.name: Ancestral Treechnid Splitter
items.description: This battle-axe was forged by Kademlia Boulgoure to fight against the Ancestral Treechnid. Only the best warriors can handle it.

items.name: Ogralimde's Sword
items.description: Ogralimde was a great warrior who derived his strength from his master Adyol, an exceptionally intelligent and powerful Bwork Magus. This apprentice never surpassed his master.

items.name: Redness Cloak
items.description: This cloak increases life.

items.name: Bluish Cloak
items.description: This cloak increases chance.

items.name: Farter
items.description: The Farter protects you from physical damage.

items.name: Komintot Headband
items.description: The Komintot increases the Wisdom of the wearer.

items.name: Smoother
items.description: The Smoother resists magic damage.

items.name: Dark Cloak
items.description: This cloak increases Wisdom.

items.name: Treecloak
items.description: This magnificent cloak is a clever mix of Treechnid essence and nice familial Gobball.

items.name: Vitality Headband
items.description: This headband increases Vitality.

items.name: Mad Boowolf Cloak
items.description: This cloak was made of hairs and other organic elements taken from various Boowolves... You can smell its power from here.

items.name: Mad Tofu Cloak
items.description: With this handmade cloak of Tofu Feathers, you will be able to run faster and escape from tackle zones with the grace of a shotgun-blasted pigeon.

items.name: Poak Cloak
items.description: The legendary Poak Cloak was specially embroidered for warriors who live for close combat situations.

items.name: Cape Hillary
items.description: Hairdressers use the Cape Hillary to tie up their hair. Will you?

items.name: Cape Rice
items.description: This cloak increases your range, allowing distant targets to be attacked... or naive adventurers to be dumbfounded into unsuspecting admiration. Haha!

items.name: The Gobb
items.description: The Gobb increases damage and Vitality, but it gives off a nasty odour, too. Don't be surprised if the Gobballs think you're one of the gang.

items.name: Dofusteuse
items.description: This cloak is certainly one of the most powerful of its kind in the World. It increases all the elemental characteristics of its wearer.

effects.formatted:
Dofusteuse:
• Increases one of the bearer's elemental characteristics per turn: 300 Chance → 300 Strength → 300 Agility → 300 Intelligence.

items.name: Dazzling Cloak
items.description: This magnificent cloak increases AP, as well as Vitality and Wisdom.

items.name: Dazzling Belt
items.description: This magnificent belt increases AP, as well as Vitality and Wisdom.

items.name: Wa Wabbit's Crown
items.description: This magnificent Crown once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit.

items.name: Wa Wabbit's Staff
items.description: This staff once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit.

items.name: Wa Wabbit's Cloak
items.description: This cloak once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit. It is still imbued with his perspiration which will bring back a few memories of the amazing fight every time you put it on.

items.name: Cawwot Dofus
items.description: If a dragon really did lay this egg, then she must have been a right sweetheart. Especially since its main purpose seems to be to attract adventurers to the Wa Wabbit's island so he can nick all their garb and gear before humiliating them. All in all, it's quite a good way to obtain the latest sets without having to leave the house.

effects.formatted:
Gives 25 AP Parry if an AP penalty is suffered, or 25 MP Parry if an MP penalty is suffered. 
The two effects last 1 turn and do not stack.

items.name: Pumpkwin
items.description: A distinctive feature of the Pumpkwin is that it prevents the dispersion of magic particles, making it a good magic insulator. That's why some warriors use this vegetable as headgear.

items.name: Helmet
items.description: Wearing this hat creates a very special look, halfway between ridiculous and comical.

items.name: Wooden Wings
items.description: For those who have always dreamt of flying like a Kwak, go back to bed because these wings will turn you into a public menace and an idiot.

items.name: Stek Knife
items.description: One day, the infamously crazy T. Bun Stek found two strange yet impressive knives... No one could figure out what they were for. He used the very same knives to sacrifice half his livestock to the Gods and soon after they bellowed the answer from the heave's. He was slaughtering a particularly noisy cow at that very moment... The poor guy didn't hear a word.

items.name: Kitten Tails
items.description: This pair of daggers is in fact a magic game. Designed to entertain young Ecaflips, it was taken off the market when a visiting Sram decided to join. She was only a child... Shame on you... shame on us all.

items.name: Elorie Entuwan's Cruel Daggers
items.description: These magnificent daggers once belonged to the cruellest Sramette Amakna ever saw. Well, one of the most cruel. Actually, she was just a tiny bit more cruel than the others. No, I'm exaggerating there. She wasn't quite as cruel as the others. That's still quite an achievement though.

items.name: Rowler Blade
items.description: This dagger was originally used by the secret brotherhood of Rowler. This guild wanted to plunge Amakna into chaos. They finally disappeared when the island where they hid and schemed was submerged by the waves.

items.name: Deceitful Daggers
items.description: This Sram daggers are especially deceitfully shaped. So deceitful that you may wonder if they really are daggers. Once you have the answer, it's often too late...

items.name: Ortimus Contrari's Bloody Blades
items.description: Ortimus Contrari is a legendary assassin. If I told you how he carried out his contracts... you'd want to kill yourself even before he got to you.

items.name: Unlucky Knight's Broken Sword
items.description: The legends tell of a famous Iop who left his island home and travelled across the sea to find work as an interpreter for the Kings of Amakna. He took to the job full of hope, enthusiasm and diligence, dazzling Ecaflips and Fecas alike with his vibrant wordplay and passion for good grammar. Unfortunately, on his way to the castle, he stumbled over a rock that turned out to be a Mega Crackler, and this broken sword was the only trace they found of him, or his equipment.

items.name: Sleeping Shovel
items.description: This shovel is made of a very rare wood. According to the legend, young girls fall into an eternal sleep when they touch this weapon. Note that in case of repeated contact, valiant heroes can also be affected.

items.name: Mishmashovel
items.description: What can be better than an eco-friendly shovel to clear your garden of weeds? This shovel is THE best way of getting rid of daisies. It's also great to feed them to your enemies.

items.name: Woukuis Shovel
items.description: The Woukuis family forged this shovel during the war between the Elle-Poma and the Touge-Woukuis. The one problem is that it covers your hands with grease. It's also very popular with unmarried warriors who spend a lot of time alone. Dunno why.

items.name: Cruel Trovel
items.description: Half trowel and half shovel, the Trovel went out of fashion with builders and was remarketed as a weapon. Easy to handle and to put away thanks to its size, it's the ideal accessory for any Enutrof that's fond of a drink.

items.name: Koutoulou's Shovel
items.description: These ghastly shovels are hand-crafted by the islanders of Koutoulou who use whatever materials come to hand to make them. Useless for digging holes, their main purpose is to ward off imaginary spirits and naughty children.

items.name: Field Shovel
items.description: This shovel is much favoured by the potato farmers of the region. It can be used for all kinds of crops however.

items.name: Dha's Mace
items.description: A weapon created by Dha, this aerodynamic mace hurts the very air as it cleaves through and splits your enemies skulls open... Are you convinced yet?

items.name: R'Unique Hammer
items.description: Rumour has it that this hammer is one of a kind, handmade by the ancient Xelor Smiths. Some people are convinced it is a copy, only carrying a convincing forgery of the Xelor rune... Go find out for yourself, hit someone over the head with it!

items.name: Mace Tmosfer
items.description: Before being struck by lightning for the last time, the creator of this mace truly thought it would allow him forecast the weather. Much later, it was discovered that the tool was better at giving than taking blows.

items.name: Outar Hammer
items.description: According to the legend, Outar Great Bwork ordered these fearsome hammers from a village of Xelors with the promise of sparing the townspeople if the hammers were well made. When he received the hammers, he destroyed the village. He needed to try his new weapons after all.

items.name: Aj Taye Mace
items.description: This mace is the sole heritage left by the pacific Aj Taye tribe. Roll it on aching muscles and the pain will disappear. Big bullies will tell you it's quite good at making pain appear as well.

items.name: Pospodrol Hammer
items.description: This hammer is so ridiculous that your enemy will laugh his head off. This should give you just enough time to beat it off with the very same hammer... Is that ironic?

items.name: Hammer of Wrongs
items.description: With this fearsome Hammer you will be able to prove the popular belief that muscles are more important than intelligence. This logic only works for people who are weaker than you, however. As we say ourselves... Strong is... never wrong.

items.name: Falistos's Maul
items.description: Falistos are Xelor demons. They betrayed their old principles and increased their strength by forging more and more powerful hammers. After spreading chaos across the land, they were defeated and banished underground. But some of the weapons they forged remained intact.

items.name: Mental Ring
items.description: This ring slightly increases intelligence.

items.name: Kanniball Mask
items.description: This mask is the faithful replica, only a bit bigger, of the ones proudly worn by important Kanniballs.

items.name: Buzzard Bow
items.description: This bow is specifically designed to hunt birds. Light and easy to handle, you'll be able to sneak up on an eagle.

items.name: Hour Wand
items.description: The Eniripsa Mie Dopan made this series of sharpened wands to fight against the rising level of burglaries in the area. In theory, these wands can go back in time and nip any aggression in the bud. They often appear in hospitals, disguised as nurses asking stuff like, 'Have you seen so and so? Well, he hasn't been born yet. Yeah a real nasty character.'

items.name: Gobball Horn Bow
items.description: "With a Gobball, no waste at all!" Such was the motto of a visionary shopkeeper who specialised in recycling Gobball carcasses. This bow is one of his best products, not for aesthetic reasons, but simply because it's a fearsome weapon.

items.name: I Kea Bow, Standard Model
items.description: A type of bow only made in the far North of Amakna, the I Kea Bow is a cheap, conveniently flat-packed weapon. Its effectiveness will strongly depend on the owner's ability to follow poorly translated instruction manuals.

items.name: Eco Bow
items.description: The instructions for the making of this 100% biodegradable bow have been found in the ruins of Din by an adventurer apparently renowned for his mastery of the whip. I never trusted those Greenies... Many die each year in passionate and misguided embraces with sleeping Treechnids.

items.name: Crystal Bow
items.description: Take an old worn bow, dust it with magical cure, ask a dragon to blow on it and you'll have an enchanted bow. Be careful however, theorising with fairy recipes is all very well, but in practise, dragons take a malicious pleasure in blowing on everything but the bow.

items.name: King of Borins Bow
items.description: This unconventional bow was designed specially for the self-proclaimed king of a village of lowly peasants, who liked to show off by shooting two arrows at once.

items.name: Clergy Wand
items.description: This heavy Wand shattered more than one soul's skull. Iop priests use it to send repentant sinners to heaven with a bang.

items.name: Ni'Ninnin Wand
items.description: It's the symbol of purity and stupidity. Just like its creator who nevertheless gave it tremendous magic powers.

items.name: Inacleft Stick
items.description: This wand was the key to the emancipation of Eniripsa housewives – a fearsome weapon against both monsters and hard-to-reach dust. Pretty handy, right?

items.name: Houvette's Wand
items.description: Houvette invented these wands to claim back her Enutrof husband from the liquid grip of the bar where he spent his evenings. She also used them to spice up their relationship, but nobody knows exactly how.

items.name: Iron Wand
items.description: According to the tag, this wand has the power to make people obey whoever is holding it. The instructions say you have to shake it rapidly near your adversary. If it doesn't work, try and poke him in the eye with it.

items.name: Fake Magic Staff
items.description: This staff is a replica of a legendary artefact, but with slightly lesser powers. It sends out light if it falls on the ground and it can distort your voice to any pitch you desire. The latter feature is useful for luring enemies into mortal traps... just don't try to kill them with it when they fall for your trick.

items.name: Dakn Staff
items.description: Most young Fecas have a staff quite similar to this one. It's gone beyond a trend now, and has become a ritual of sorts. Has no one ever told them how ridiculous they look?

items.name: Crystal Staff-Ball
items.description: A short-sighted, grumbling, fortune telling, smelly old Feca accidentally created this powerful weapon when her staff rammed into her crystal ball as she slipped from the kitchen table. She'd read her own fortune long before and, well, she more or less lived on that table... Wonder what it was she thought was going to kill her... Well, I guess she wasn't the best fortune teller.

items.name: Kings' Staff
items.description: The success of the Wa Wabbit Staff lead to the creation of a host of cheap copies. Today, there are far more fakes than originals.

items.name: Oly Medal
items.description: Oly was a disciple of Iop with only one ability – cooking. It is said that Iop himself gave her this medal in order to compensate for her weaknesses in battle. Only the pure of heart can wear it.

items.name: Strong Bow
items.description: This bow was created by a magician who believed you could find happiness in even the plainest of things. He invented this water-based bow to prove his point.

items.name: Ykulf Bow
items.description: "With a bow, it's make or break" as the saying goes. Wise men avoid this bow. It's rumoured to have the evil eye.

items.name: Mushd Bow
items.description: This bow carries the forces of earth and water. Woe betide him who cannot control at least one of the two.

items.name: Sawn-Off Pulley Bow
items.description:
All the pulleys of this bow were sawn off. It used to be a symbol of the conflict between Good and Evil.
Touch it and you'll feel the supreme justice of the ancient lawmakers running through your fingertips.

items.name: Hickory Tree
items.description: Hick was an cursed Cra: he couldn't stop hiccupping. One day he threw his bow into the fire and decided to use a sword instead. The curse strangely disappeared at that exact moment.

items.name: Hidsad Bow
items.description: The man who created this bow, a certain Marc Hidsad, never really knew how to use it. He usually hurt himself just as much as his enemies.

items.name: Half Loaf
items.description: Rika Zarouil The Female Baker was renowned for having been the smallest Eniripsa in the whole World of Amakna. She made her loaves in small cardboard furnaces and used this old bread to impale many a hero.

items.name: Wangs
items.description: A sculptor who loved practical jokes tried to pass their wands off as daggers. The strategy was a flop, but the wands were a hit.

items.name: Wily Wand
items.description: The origins of this wand are shrouded in mystery. Nevertheless, it has always helped its happy owners find the least crowded routes in Amakna – which is particularly helpful when the crowds are out strolling through the Royal Gobball Estates.

items.name: The Hyldegarde
items.description: This wand was created many years ago in the forging flames of Dyin Ard. You'd be well-advised to have a bucket of water at hand just to keep control of the mini-inferno.

items.name: Sylvian Wand
items.description: The Sylvian Wand gives you sharp sight. You'll probably use it for picking out a good escape route.

items.name: Vampiric Stake
items.description: The vampiric stake is, in fact, the wand of a vampire who retired long ago from social life and slaughtering. This strange piece of wood has nevertheless inherited a few qualities from its former owner.

items.name: Tont'Ata Staff
items.description: On top of its unbearable name, this staff has many ways to get on its owner's nerves.

items.name: Forgetfulness Staff
items.description: This staff will help its owner forget about their worries and their strife. Unfortunately, it sometimes causes them to lose some of their memory and become subject to frequent lapses in concentration. Reserved for sages only.

items.name: Flatu Lance
items.description: They say it was this staff that made a fearsome warrior of Heds; they say it was magic and could shoot fire. Ever heard of All Bran? Eight bowls of this stuff a day and you'd be shooting fire too, buddy.

items.name: Gobbherd Staff
items.description: This staff is commonly used by gobbherds during the trading season to fend off the Bworks, who like to snack on the Gobball herds around this time. The prized dish is the gobbherd himself.

items.name: Staff of Dina Mite
items.description: This staff once belonged to the beautiful Dina Mite, renowned for her explosive voice. In her day, she was a cracker too.

items.name: Arson Fire Lance
items.description: Apparently, this lance belonged to one of the 110 Amaknian firefighters it took to put out the fire started deliberately by the reckless red wyrmling. There were definite signs of arson about. One must have courage and dedication to use it.

items.name: Table Knives
items.description: These knives have been specially conceived to be used in luxury restaurants. However, because of their rather strange appearance, the owner decided to resell them to a travelling knife thrower.

items.name: Ergot Mina
items.description: The hilt of this weapon is greasy and slippery but it really does look fab.

items.name: Eulasse Daggers
items.description: Eulasse was a gobbherd in Amakna who one day found these dirty daggers in the Gobball dung heap. Be careful with them, the hilts are still a bit slippery...

items.name: Otof'Mai'We Daggers
items.description: Otof'Mai'We was a hermit, a legendary disciple of Sram, who spent his life avoiding all sorts of contact with others. When he died, his favourite daggers were found next to his body. Only the nimblest of men can control them.

items.name: The Infernal Razor
items.description: Any Enutrof worthy of the name has a beard and old Krys Nosheive was no exception. One day his wife, Mrs Nosheive, bought him a razor, and he decided he would rather use it as a weapon.

items.name: Penn Knives
items.description: Penn was a renowned Amaknian scribe who would use daggers to engrave his stone notebooks. He was so fast that he was commissioned to write an encyclopedia of Astrubian swear words. He was never able to complete his opus.

items.name: Terophyle Axe
items.description: Terophyle the Iop was capable of lifting enormous stones... It's not really proof of intelligence to you or me, but a Iop who can capture the idea of picking up something round is already a king among his people.

items.name: Huvant Axe
items.description: This axe might be heavy, but it will take down Trools in a flash. The magic runes it contains can also burn enemies.

items.name: Samuel J. Axe
items.description: Hure was a young priest who used weapons freely to spread the word of God. His favourite weapon was an axe on which he inscribed numerous meaningful quotations. His final blows were always accompanied by a blood-curdling supplications, which ended, each word like a hot pin in the victim's ear, with the phrase "And, you will know my name is The Lord when I lay my vengeance upon thee!"

items.name: Jon Lemon
items.description: Created for young, bloodthirsty warriors, this battle axe makes a deafening noise when it strikes another weapon.

items.name: The Bhharnsheee Hammer
items.description: Legend has it that this hammer is named after the sound it makes when it crushes enemy skulls. Unfortunately, there aren't any enemies left to confirm that this is the case.

items.name: Tortoi Hammer
items.description: It took many, many years and many, many smiths to forge this hammer. The result is a magnificent weapon which has unfortunately inherited a particular concept of efficiency from its creators.

items.name: The Metronome
items.description: This Hammer was made from a clock, the famous clock swallowed by the Crocodyl when it devoured the hand of Captain Hawkfish. Though the clock has been located, the hand is still missing. Hawkfish's hand that is... the clock was in surprisingly good... oh, forget it.

items.name: Aclou Mallet
items.description: Just like the amulet of the same name, the Aclou Mallet can transform your vital energy into strength. To be used in moderation.

items.name: Ha Hammer
items.description: This hammer once belonged to Aha, a young Osamodas who wasted all his days telling painful one-liners. The hammer couldn't break open a hazelnut, but it's useful for breaking the ice from time to time.

items.name: Toh'Lo Hammer
items.description: So you like animals? So did Toh'Lo. He devoted his whole life to helping them out. This hammer kind of represents his relationship with animals, a communion as shaky as a lame Gobball on a freshly gravelled driveway.

items.name: Layte's Slicer
items.description: Layte, the creator of this shovel, was a devoted disciple of Iop. You can guess what this guy's major flaw was.

items.name: Zebuth Shovel
items.description: This shovel is used by the Kanniball High Priests of Moon Island to invoke Zebuth, one of their gods who is often depicted as a cow. Only vile characters use it.

items.name: Mechba Shovel
items.description: This shovel, created by Mechba, is used by Enutrof followers to knock nuts from trees. On the battlefield, it has a similar function. Yowza!

items.name: Houze Shovel
items.description: Gaston Houze, gardener and disciple of Enutrof, planted too many plants. It had to be said... There, I've said it. What's more this worn spade is the evidence of his dirty business. Never talk to this thing, it'll tell you stories, don't believe a word, it'll have you digging yourself into your own grave before you know it... and then where will you be? I hate this damn thing.

items.name: Security Shovel
items.description: This shovel was once a self-defence weapon used by a small group of female Enutrof's followers. Once they had even this puny pile of power in their clutches, they turned into horrible crea.......

items.name: The Fat Shovel
items.description: Very heavy shovel. For fa... um, big boned adventurers.

items.name: Ikan Shovel
items.description: Ikan was Churros the Warrior's little fish. The shovel doesn't look a thing like the creature, but the smell is almost identical.

items.name: Unlucky Pick
items.description: This pick seems to attract the evil eye to you. But with a few minor alterations here and there, you could have a great pick on your hands.

items.name: Xelor Amulet
items.description: This ultra-powerful amulet is the fruit of the expert time-mastery of an old Xelor.

items.name: Pretty Blade
items.description: The Pretty Blade has been crafted by the renowned blacksmith Dave-LoL, just before he died for the sake of the prettiest girl in the kingdom, a Iop. It is said that the efficiency of the blade is only matched by the grace of the wearer.

items.name: Crackler Pendant
items.description: This powerful pendant contains the life-blood of the Crackler, that is to say all the items he gathered before he was killed by some jealous adventurer.

items.name: Lucky Mulette
items.description: Mulette was a little female Ecaflip dogged by bad luck... until her grandmother presented her with this amulet.

items.name: Harmony
items.description: This pendant will make you feel more harmonious.

items.name: The Cardboard Twot
items.description: This legendary Hammer has already proved itself in Amakna. It belonged to the powerful Cardboard Twot who used it to transform his opponents into confetti and papier-mâché.

items.name: Peace
items.description: This pendant will make you feel at peace with the World.

items.name: Understanding
items.description: This pendant will make you grant you greater understanding of the World around you.

items.name: Palid Emblem
items.description: This is an extremely useful amulet, but it turns its wearer as white as a Gobball.

items.name: Kabbala
items.description: A mysterious symbol of a mysterious organisation... by the way, it doesn't exist and you've never heard of it, understand?

items.name: Instant Calm Amulet
items.description: An excellent copy of the work done by Polma Kartnay, the silversmith's apprentice. This reproduction surpasses the original.

items.name: Pippin
items.description: This amulet is said to be a modified version of the Golden Destiny... which is really strange when you think that these two amulets have nothing in common except their ridiculous appearance.

items.name: Holy Medal
items.description: Holy was a female Iop, intent on spreading Evil throughout the land. Renowned for her incredible composure, she would never get angry except when people compared her to someone named Oly.

items.name: Adelus
items.description: Not only is this belt elegant, it also massages you as you walk... You'd be surprised what a back rub can do for your murderous instinct.

items.name: Plimclik
items.description: This strange name refers to an equally strange object made from previous amulets... goodness knows how. We know just as little about the circumstances in which it was found.

items.name: Pin of Mhete
items.description: With this near-perfect pin, you'll have the Wisdom of an Irish salmon. It's great for group therapy sessions among friends. Don't forget to bring some tissues, though, it can get emotional!

items.name: Nhanor Kibrill Chain
items.description: The creator of this chain, someone called Ken Aton, was renowned for his strange habits. He spent all his time hunting the Minotoror for his coat which he wanted to make into a merkin.

items.name: Liche Chain
items.description: The Liche was a dirty creature known for infiltrating the ranks of valiant warriors in order to steal food. Marmalade and toast was his favourite. But one day, the warriors saw through its little game and the Liche had to run away.

items.name: Sacrier's Wound
items.description: The stone set in this ring is so incredibly sharp that it could open a vein at the slightest touch. Fortunately, Sacriers know how to handle this jewel with skill and care. This includes using it on themselves to inflict a little damage when they need to shed a tear or two. Tears of pain or tears of joy... either way, that's how they honour their goddess.

items.name: Ringer
items.description: The main function of this pretty ring was to help Osamodas recognise their Tofus during fights.

items.name: Soff Ring
items.description: This small modest-looking ring was created by Degun. He was more famous for shouting his head off without the slightest reason and his violent aversion to the Liche than for his talent as a jeweller.

items.name: Ecaflip's Luck
items.description: This ring was made to increase its wearers luck during card games.

items.name: Xelor's Past
items.description: Rings forged during Xelor's temporal journeys.

items.name: Enutrof's Memento
items.description: These rings were cooled from the forge with the tears of Enutrof, shed over his lost shovel. Must have been some shovel!

items.name: The Enutrofion
items.description: This ring is meant for Enutrofs only. It was enchanted by their God so that the followers would be the only ones to wear it. It allows all god-fearing Enutrofs to be even luckier than usual in treasure hunts.

items.name: Carpet Cape
items.description: Made of many different fibres, this magnificent cloak is unique - just look at that patchwork of colour and the way the light plays on its surface.

items.name: Wedding Ring
items.description: This wedding ring will satisfy the most mercenary of fathers-in-law.

items.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp's Wand
items.description: It is said that to create this wand, it is put into a warm corpse, which is then buried shortly afterwards. No one dares to imagine by what route exactly the wand is put into the dead body.

items.name: Billy-Ray's Daggers
items.description: Billy-Ray Red Neck was renowned throughout the countryside. One day, as he was yodelling at the top of his voice, someone cut off his head, which is why he got the nickname. The dagger was found but nobody looked for the murderer... Billy-Ray was famous for singing out of tune.

items.name: Flute
items.description: This exceptional Treechnid wood flute is ideal for entertaining and inspiring your friends.

items.name: Nine Tails
items.description: According to the legend describing the Dantesque fight after which he was raised to the rank of God himself, Ecaflip used a weapon made by the ancient principle: "a tail for a life". This series of swords was forged as a tribute to him.

items.name: Soft Treering
items.description: This ring is in fact an outgrowth of the Soft Oak, uprooted during a storm. It's now yours, but keep it away from its master as he could decide to take back what's his!

items.name: Yench Cutting Sword
items.description: This sword belonged to the late lamented Kih Besans, known as the Yench Carver. This was his main hobby... Pointless to mention that some people waste their lives.

items.name: Dark Treering
items.description: This ring allows the Dark Treechnid to be very stylish when it goes dancing. And as life is kind, there are many parties in the Dark Forest.

items.name: The Treemu
items.description: The Treemu is a very elegant amulet. If you're planning on putting it on, we advise you not to wear any other clothes so as to really show off this precious jewel. You'll be irresistible.

items.name: Treebow
items.description: This bow looks as if it were still alive and can almost shoot arrows on its own like a big boy. It could have been the perfect bow for people who are clumsy with their hands but, unfortunately, the arrow always has to be loaded the right way.

items.name: Skill Boots
items.description: Skill boots increase the wearer's agility and intelligence but lower their strength and chance. Contrary to what many people believe, they won't defeat your opponent for you.

items.name: Power Boots
items.description: Power Boots increase the wearer's strength and chance but lower their intelligence and agility. Contrary to what many people believe, they won't grant you insane amounts of power.

items.name: Anticipation Boots
items.description: Anticipation Boots increase Strength and Agility to the detriment of your Intelligence and Chance. Contrary to what many people believe, they won't allow you to anticipate your enemy's next moves.

items.name: Nexus's Boots
items.description: These boots once belonged to the great knight Nexus - the poor bugger was frozen for eternity.

items.name: Fire Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Earth Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Air Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Water Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Light Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Life Artefact
items.description: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

items.name: Evening Star
items.description: This sword was created by a glamorous young lady who wanted a weapon in her own image and endowed it with her own graceful beauty and passionate nature. The magnificent result speaks for itself.

items.name: Craft Knife
items.description: This sword is absolutely perfect for attacking the defenceless. Quick, handy and above all extremely sharp, it has been banned from shops for many years now. It is tolerated only if used on Bworks.

items.name: Magus Fecalizer
items.description: This ring can protect you from weak magic attacks... In practise, from infantile monsters with something to prove.

items.name: Warrior Fecalizer
items.description: This ring can protect you from weak magic attacks... In practise, from infantile monsters with something to prove.

items.name: Moskito Ambamulet
items.description: Wearing a necklace with a Moskito encased in amber will show your opponents you're a fearsome hunter of Moskitos! Unless you're still a toddler, that's got to be embarrassing.

items.name: Arachnee Ambamulet
items.description: Wearing an amber Arachnee around your neck when attacking one of its sisters can be enough to disconcert it. Poor bug. It's what we call the "irony of fate".

items.name: Apprenticeship Boots
items.description: These strange boots were first used by young disciples who were one or two socks short of a pair. Ah yes, popular with the Iops.

items.name: Apprentice Summoner Boots
items.description: These boots have been especially made for those who prefer to watch their summons do all the hard work during fights.

items.name: Luthuthu Belt
items.description: This belt takes its name from its creator, a shoemaker who was less renowned and much older than Bowisse, but quite gifted all the same.

items.name: Trembling Dodu Belt
items.description: The Dodu was a Sadida who loved frightening his enemies. He asked Bowisse to make him a belt that matched the colour of his hair... Like many charmers, the Dodu had a rotten heart.

items.name: Event Belt
items.description: This belt was made for the most popular of all the Craettes who often organised parties and wacky events to keep her countless friends and acquaintances on her side. All this between ironing and washing Captain Chafer's leather underpants.

items.name: Jules Yanos's Cloak
items.description: The famous tailor, Jules Yanos, was particularly renowned for having exchanged his wife for a magic thimble. What a businessman, hmm? Just great!

items.name: Elya Wood's Cloak
items.description: Some say Captain Chafer tried to steal this cloak to replace his famous leather panties. But it didn't suit him at all - it just wasn't perverse enough.

items.name: Small Gobbly Wool Bag
items.description: Don't expect this bag to make a hero of you. It will keep all your personal items in one place. Better than nothing, I suppose.

items.name: Small Harvester Bag
items.description:
This bag has been designed to hold a few collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

items.name: Small Adventurer Bag
items.description: This bag is ideal for those who never wander far from home but take useless things with them when they do. Like Ash Planks for example.

items.name: Celerity Belt
items.description: Designed by Tengra Reufrus, this aerodynamic belt will make you as nimble as a Tofu and as windy as the breeze. Or is it the opposite?

items.name: Pocket Belt
items.description: This belt has small pockets allowing you to stock more items in your inventory.

items.name: Harvester Bag
items.description:
This bag has been designed to hold collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

items.name: Large Harvester Bag
items.description:
This bag has been designed to hold many collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

items.name: Staca Noviste's Rucksack
items.description: Legend whispers of a miner who worked continuously for several months in 4 different mines simultaneously, raising a family in the process and running a successful one-man printing press with his feet. Ah, the Hammer-Sickle newspaper has been hard at work again.

items.name: Adventurer Bag
items.description: It's the ideal bag for holding all your bread and potions when you go away for several months... into the labyrinth for example.

items.name: Large Adventurer Bag
items.description: This is the ideal bag for keeping all your bread and potions in when you are on an exotic holiday on Moon Island.

items.name: Bow Wow
items.description: You'll be saying "wow" and taking bows every time you take this tiny Bow Wow out to do its business. Due to its wild nature, this pet should not be fed – that is, unless you want to lose a hand.

items.name: Crocoburio's Strength
items.description: The powers given to this ring by the Dark Breath of Grougalorasalar are now considerably weakened. This relic was intended for Crocoburio, the only one capable of mastering it without being dominated himself.

items.name: Crocoburio's Spirit
items.description: This pair of boots apparently belonged to Crocoburio. Only a few people can put them on and they are immediately plunged into a clever, Machiavellian frame of mind. Legend has it that this evil spell is due to the numerous skulls the boots have crushed.

items.name: Crocoburio's Power
items.description: Grougalorasalar loved collecting the bone fragments of his most fearsome enemies. His affection for Crocoburio inspired the creation of this ultra-powerful belt.

items.name: Bow Meow
items.description: The fairer sex of any class will fall under the spell of this cuddly little ball of fluff. That alone makes it an animal to be feared.

items.name: Mer Ring
