items.name: Gobkool Amulet
items.description: This Amulet was worn by adventurers who said they wanted to make tea, not war. Each to their own.

items.name: Gobkool Ring
items.description: This ring will enable you to cause even more pain when doling out those well-deserved spankings to your little darlings.

items.name: Gobkool Hammer
items.description: This hammer is great for expressing your pacifism... all over your enemy's face.

items.name: Gobkool Boots
items.description: Stuffed with Gobkool wool, these boots are just fantastic. Light and warm for the cold season and cool for the hot one, they will please even the pickiest of adventurers.

items.name: Gobkool Cape
items.description: If you're the kind of person who always thinks positive, this cape is made for you. It's so thick and comfy that it can be used as an improvised bed when you feel extremely sleepy. Its smoked Kaliptus odour even repels insects and other unwanted creatures.

items.name: Gobkool Belt
items.description: Wrapped around your hips, this belt will give you the appearance of a peace-loving adventurer. This enables you to surprise your enemies with a dagger in their back.

items.name: Gobkool Headgear
items.description: Let's be honest, as headwear goes, this cap is about as fashionable as a mullet hairdo. You never know though, look what happened to drainpipe jeans.

items.name: Koolich Headgear
items.description: This headgear once belonged to the famous Koolich, renowned for his clay feet and his legendary good mood.

items.name: Koolich Bag
items.description: The Koolich uses this bag to keep his Kaliptus leaves fresh or to suffocate Koalaks that are a bit too enterprising.

items.name: Koolich Boots
items.description: These boots used to belong to the Koolich - even if you can't tell, you can smell! These boots are so comfortable that you'll almost forget how miserable your existence is.

items.name: Koolich Staff
items.description: This staff is really an emptied bone of one of the Koolich's ancestors. Pierced on both ends, it can be used as a Kaliptus pipe but also as a shepherd's stick. Ahhhh... sticks, eh! What would we do without them?

items.name: Mini Wa
items.description: This little Wabbit is in fact a bastard son of the notorious Wa Wabbit. Maybe one day it'll get to wear its father's crown.

items.name: Willy Peninzias
items.description: Willy Peninzias is a nasty creature indeed, and seems to have had a very tough childhood. Count on it to follow you around and scare your friends away.

items.name: Golden Lady's Belt
items.description: An old legend extracted from the famous old book titled "Everything You Need To Know About Women" says that this belt once belonged to a golden lady, a lot more interested in wealth than in power. In the non-censored version of this book, we also learn that she was keen on cracking dirty jokes. I guess she wasn't that different from most women.

items.name: Bloody Koalak
items.description: This little Koalak seems harmless, but that's far from the truth. Tortured when it was young, it frequently received boomerangs in the face, or even the bum. It has positively loathed boomerangs ever since, and has an appetite for violence rivalled only by your own thirst for blood.

items.name: Animagi (GM)
items.description: This mysterious item, forgotten by the World, used to belong to a great magus. People say it gives you the ability to speak to certain animals.

items.name: Royal Tofu Crown
items.description: This crown is almost impossible to hold... No surprise, it belongs to the Royal Tofu! Doesn't seem to suit your small head, though. I think it just might be out of your league. LOSER!!!

items.name: Bworky
items.description: This small creature is a Bwork that was locked inside a jar for several decades. It took the shape of the jar as it grew, and will now be a dwarf the rest of its life. Its legendary good humour makes it the perfect companion when you know you're going to die soon, or for boisterous social occasions.

items.name: Koalak Amulet
items.description: This amulet does not look like any other amulet, simply because no other amulet looks like it.

items.name: Koalak Ring
items.description: This beautiful ring is worn by the most foolhardy of all Koalaks... the ones who stole it in Astrub.

items.name: Koalak Bow
items.description: This bow enables you to steal your opponents' life and sometimes, to steal your opponents from life. (Don't spend too long trying to understand, that doesn't mean anything.)

items.name: Koalak Boots
items.description: These boots are in fact real Koalak feet that were brutally pulled off their owners, then emptied of their content before being padded with Koalak hairs. Both terrifying and attractive, these boots will make you the terror of Astrub.

items.name: Koalak Cloak
items.description: This cloak will protect you from most attacks, but not from being ridiculous.

items.name: Koalak Belt
items.description: This Kaliptus leaf belt diffuses a delightful smell that will hide all others. Besides, this belt is perfect for hiding your chubbiness.

items.name: Koalak Headgear
items.description: This headgear is adorned with huge Koalak ears which can amplify any sound within hearing distance. Be careful, it can destroy your eardrums if your friends are fond of the Wind of Panic.

items.name: Kaliptus Dofus
items.description: No one knows exactly which dragon created this Dofus, but the rumours suggest it ingested an incredible quantity of Kaliptus leaves before laying the egg and then dying of acute aerophagia.

items.name: Gyver Wand
items.description: This wand, made out of useless office stationery, holds incredible magical powers. Legend tells that it can move of its own will, choose its target and protect its master even when death is seemingly inevitable.

items.name: Iots Wand
items.description: Iots was a parrot who repeated just about anything you could say. Rumour has it that this wand was carved from its beak.

items.name: Caribbean Staff
items.description: Legend has it that this staff bites people, or was it that people always bit it? Something about biting anyway.

items.name: Palm Cane
items.description: This palm cane celebrates a famous festival in the South East. Unfortunately this one isn't made of gold.

items.name: Ostwogoth Daggers
items.description: The Ostwogoth is neither sharp nor smart but when he has his daggers to hand, no one dares face this monster.

items.name: Killarity Sword
items.description: This sword perfectly illustrates the old Iop saying "In a slain enemy is a sword's hilarity".

items.name: Andy War Sword
items.description: This conversation piece is mass-produced according to an unchanging style. Since it's also quite deadly, it's often used in combat. In this case, art doesn't imitate life, it tears it out at the roots.

items.name: Dunb Hammer
items.description: This hammer's previous owner used to dance with Boowolves, until one day he was wolfed down altogether.

items.name: Hammer O'In
items.description: Even your enemies will be asking to be hit again and again with this weapon.

items.name: Blade O'Ven
items.description: This axe is really special. Its vibrating blade plays beautiful music while you slice the life out of your enemies.

items.name: Axe of Lies
items.description: Rumour has it this weapon has been dipped into a fountain of pure lightning and then sprinkled with stardust. Other rumours entirely contradict this story.

items.name: The Warf Axe
items.description: This axe has been pierced in many different places making it whistle pleasantly while you slice your enemies. As the old song goes 'Whistle while you Whack.'

items.name: Kape Axe
items.description: This troublesome axe claims it comes from a mysterious land far away... Don't listen to its rambling, though, it has made peace-loving fools out of more than one fine warrior. What a shame.

items.name: Web Bow
items.description: This bow is made from fossilised hair of a Sadida who slept for so long that Arachnees spun a film of tough webs around it.

items.name: Chtelion Bow
items.description: This bow is a bizarre colour but is perfect to show off at the Zaap of Bonta. You won't pass off as a rooster, but you'll surely attract all the chicks! Sometimes amazing, sometimes disgusting, it might even overcome your enemies without your needing to shoot a single arrow.

items.name: Tofu Amulet
items.description: As light as a Tofu feather, this amulet can be worn around your neck or around your forehead if you want to be original.

items.name: Tofu Ring
items.description: This ridiculously small ring can end up being essential... your enemies might pity you so much they'll finish you off instead of letting you agonize. Let's be positive!

items.name: Tofu Wand
items.description: Unlike what some adventurers may think, this wand is not used by Tofus - they're way too stupid to know how to use such a weapon - but to fight them. Indeed, this wand is made of Tofu feathers which enable hunters to simulate the Tofu mating dance and catch them. What else will these terrible hunters invent to satisfy their murderous instinct?

items.name: Tofu Slippers
items.description: Light and soft, these slippers are warm in winter and cool in summer. Unfortunately, they can't stand being washed in washing machines.

items.name: Tofu Cloak
items.description: This weird cloak has been cut in half. But why would somebody cut it in half? No one knows... though everybody has his own little idea about it.

items.name: Tofu Belt
items.description: This belt is the ideal tool for strangling Tofus, but hunters also use it to whip any adventurers who stray onto their land in hunting season. Probably best not to mess with the hunters - they have a history of jumping the gun, shooting first and asking questions later.

items.name: Helmetofu
items.description: This safety helmet became a very fashionable item that every pretty lady adventurer should have. What's wrong in this World?

items.name: Golden Scara Helmet
items.description: This helmet will hide your teenage acne or your ugly face.

items.name: Golden Scaracape
items.description: More golden than a classical Scaracape and less black than a Black Scaracape, this cape is perfect to hide your outgrowths. The Scarabugly used to use it to hide its awful hump, for example. These days, this cape is mainly used to hide terrible-looking behinds. No need to point out that this cape is very popular.

items.name: Golden Scarabugly Wand
items.description: This magic wand is perfect for dusting old furniture or old people.

items.name: Golden Scarabelt
items.description: If you love running naked on the paradisiacal Moon Island beaches, you'll surely fall in love with this belt.

items.name: Golden Scarabugly Amulet
items.description: Worn on a hairy torso, this amulet just looks fantastic! Hair tufts are just the perfect match for this amulet.

items.name: Golden Scarabugly Ring
items.description: Scarabuglies are strange creatures. Born hunchbacked and ugly, they inevitably become the laughing stock of the other Scaraleaves. Maybe that's why you feel so close to this creature.

items.name: Golden Scaraboots
items.description: These hooked boots make it easy for you to climb the sheerest of cliffs or to plough your fields without a plough.

items.name: Farmer Amulet
items.description: This amulet smells of Wild Sunflower oil and herbs. You can use it as a lure to trap dangerous rummagers... like Gobballs, or your mother-in-law.

items.name: Farmer Beltudas
items.description: With its complementary pair of linen Bermuda shorts attached, the Beltudas is simply a must have. This belt is designed for those who need to get their clothes off in a heartbeat and burst into action just as fast. Be careful though. For reasons of hygiene, it is forbidden to wear it in public swimming pools... we don't want a repeat of the Bonta incident... I almost lost my sight that time.

items.name: Farmer Sunhat
items.description: If you need protection from the sun while working in the fields, what you really need is a Slob Headgear. If you need protection from the sun while working in the fields and you're poor, the famous Farmer Sunhat will have to do.

items.name: Farmer Moth-Eaten Mittens
items.description: These moth-eaten mittens are a real treasure. They're said to be covered with diamond dust which gives them extraordinary resistance. They are also abrasive on one side, perfect for putting the finishing touches to that latest DIY project.

items.name: Damaged Farmer Scythe
items.description: This robust but damaged scythe has already been used extensively. It is now quite dull. However, it is still wonderfully suited to ripping out chunks of tender, surface flesh. Your opponents' varicose veins won't stand a chance.

items.name: Farmer Boots
items.description: These boots are padded with wheat straw, absorbing perspiration and allowing the portable and low-cost cultivation of toxic mushrooms. Thanks to their soft sole, they've been recommended by all the great Gobbowl players.

items.name: Boowolfulet
items.description: Behind this stupid name, you'll find an extremely powerful amulet, made with Boowolf fangs and bones which explains why it smells so bad. If it doesn't suit your neck, it will perfectly suit your breath.

items.name: Boowolf Axe
items.description: This terrible axe has beheaded many foolhardy adventurers even if it does not cut very well. Indeed, a dozen attempts can be necessary to finish cutting a resistant neck.

items.name: Farmer Bag
items.description: This bag is very fashionable among school kids and is ideal for storing animal and vegetable flours. Once opened, unfolded and torn along the seams, you'll be able to use this bag as a skirt, just shave those legs, for Iop's sake.

items.name: Black Scarabelt
items.description: This belt is anything but original... funny, it seems to match your hairdo.

items.name: Black Scara Helmet
items.description: This helmet is perfect for those who see the World through opaque black glasses.

items.name: Black Scaracape
items.description: If you can't afford to buy a Mastralis Croak, but you like to scare Arachnees by wearing black clothes, this is the cape for you!

items.name: Black Scararing
items.description: This beautiful ring can be worn around your big toe. It's perfect to hide your warts and your ingrown nails.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Boots
items.description: If you like to break a few toes when you take your date out to dance, these boots are made for you!

items.name: Legendary Crackler Helmet
items.description: This is an improved version of the Crackler Helmet. This rock will efficiently protect you from falling rocks, but not from hair loss.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Hammer
items.description: This huge hammer is in fact a Crackler sword, adorned with a rock from the Legendary Crackler. This shocking creation will stun your opponents, just before squashing them.

items.name: Legendary Cracklering
items.description: This rock, set with precious stones, is perfect if you want to leave a permanent mark on the forehead of an enemy.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Amulet
items.description: This amulet has quite a modest look though it contains many secrets including the one telling what secrets it contains.

items.name: Gobtubby
items.description: This little monster will follow you everywhere and bit anyone who tries to pull the wool over your eyes. Always ready to ring your enemies' bells, he'll bring a bit of music into your life. You can also count on him to keep insomnia away.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Belt
items.description: The Legendary Crackler wears this belt around one of his toes. You wear it around your waist... at least for a few seconds before it clunks down around your ankles!

items.name: Treechster
items.description: This young Treechnid could no longer stand its family and, like you, has decided to rebel. Now, it follows you everywhere, sticking to your heels like moss on a tree trunk.

items.name: El Scarador
items.description: This charming little southern beetle is in fact a thoroughly fearsome creature. Humiliated by its friends as a young beetle, it decided to take revenge and will gladly help you kick any bottoms you encounter.

items.name: Minifoux
items.description: This magnificent creature is somehow related to the famous Lenalds from the Wabbit Islands. More reckless and a lot more unruly, it will help you in combat but can also prove incredibly deceitful if you don't treat it well.

items.name: Pumpkwin Head
items.description:
With this magic Pumpkwin on your head, you'll look even more idiotic than usual. But remember the Al Howin curse. Yes, the curse that transforms creatures into misshapen beasts.
It seems that this headgear is the only thing that can protect you from this terrible curse.

items.name: Kabuto
items.description: Formerly worn by the authorities of the greatest cities, this helmet is now used to intimidate rebels and those who are a bit too curious about the rulers of the universe.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Cloak
items.description: This cloak of big stone chunks will turn you into a big stone chunk.

items.name: Pingoku
items.description: This creature must have escaped from a zoo or some remote island somewhere. Its most distinguishing feature – sometimes shared with its master – is its rotten-fish breath. We suggest that you tape its mouth closed (tape sold separately).

items.name: Red Piwi Amulet
items.description: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried red Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

items.name: Blue Piwi Amulet
items.description: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried blue Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

items.name: Red Piwi Ring
items.description: This ring will allow your lover to find you, no matter where you are.

items.name: Red Piwi Sandals
items.description: They're perfect for protecting your little feet and squashing small creatures that crawl through the grass, like Xelors or Eniripsas for example.

items.name: Red Piwi Cape
items.description: If you're small enough, this cape of Piwi feathers may cover up your behind. Some modest protection that will at least draw attention away from your greasy hair and horrible warts.

items.name: Red Piwi Belt
items.description: This small belt will accentuate your hips if you're fighting in front of important people.  It's also handy for holding your guts in if a plain boar rips you open in the depths of a forest.

items.name: Red Piwi Hat
items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

items.name: Blue Piwi Hat
items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

items.name: Yellow Piwi Hat
items.description: Some people might think you look ridiculous wearing this hat, others will find you adorable. That's life.

items.name: Pink Piwi Hat
items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

items.name: Sponge Amulet
items.description: This amulet is often mistaken for a lucky-bag gift... It's actually something you win at the shooting range.

items.name: Sponge Ring
items.description: Offered as a wedding ring, this ring sends two subliminal messages to the wearer: "I love you" and "Go do the dishes". Perfect for those who hate wasting their time repeating the same things over and over again.

items.name: Sponge Shovel
items.description: Many inexperienced adventurers will remember this terribly powerful weapon, used as a defence against sods of earth. If you wet it, it becomes soft and can be rolled about, though it generally takes at least two weaklings like yourself to manage it.

items.name: Sponge Boots
items.description: With these boots, Eniripsas can walk on water... which is quite useless since they can fly anyway, but it always impresses the crowds. Normal folk can always use these boots to exfoliate their feet while they sit around the house.

items.name: Sponge Belt
items.description: This belt allowed Vald to take his seasonal bath without putting his life in danger. Indeed, no Iop ever succeeded in learning so much as the doggy paddle.

items.name: Sponge Cape
items.description: This cape is perfect for camouflaging yourself in the natural environment. Well, it's more like you'll be adding a pleasant touch to the countryside, but hey, who wants to be invisible anyway?

items.name: Sponge Helmet
items.description: Instructions: "Offer this helmet to your husband. Firmly attach it to his head and drag him by his feet around your kitchen. You now have a clean, shining floor. Be careful not to drown him when rinsing the helmet off." This sums up the state of the modern marriage. Bloody feminists.

items.name: Kaliptus Headband
items.description: This headband will make Iops more handsome than ever!

items.name: Amoolet
items.description: The Amoolet holds a strange substance that is only found in the guts of a Moowolf. Some say it's the monster's essence, others say it's just the semi-digested remains of a Kirball.

items.name: Moowolf Ring
items.description: Beware! This ring will make your finger stink, although the foul smell may cover a worse odour. Actually, that might be the best thing that could happen to your finger, your hands, and the people around you, to be honest.

items.name: Moowolf Boots
items.description: Ubiquitous boots that are still driven by the voracious appetite of the Moowolf. If your feet smell of Clakoss, these boots will probably bite them.

items.name: Moowolf Cloak
items.description: The Moowolf's beautiful, fluffy tail is so long that it trails on the ground. Driven into a jealous rage, some adventurers pulled it off and they now wear it to increase fertility.

items.name: Moowolf Belt
items.description: This coloured belt has a wonderful purple tuft on the front and if you wear it back to front you can pretend to be a Wabbit.

items.name: Moowolf Headgear
items.description: While dismembering the Moowolf, hunters discovered that it only has one big horn going right through its skull. That doesn't seem to bother Iops, who wear it proudly anyway.

items.name: Minotoror Necklace
items.description: This necklace protected the Minotoror from getting fleas, ticks and even lice. You can be the judge of whether you need it or not.

items.name: Minotoror Ring
items.description: Unlike what some adventurers may think, this ring was never worn by the Minotoror who was unable to fit such a delicate thing around his hoofs.

items.name: Minotot Bracelet
items.description: This bracelet fully protects the arm of an Eniripsa, but triples its weight.

items.name: Dragon Pig Ring
items.description: This ring of leather and ivory makes it easier for you to stimulate your partner.

items.name: Minotot Necklace
items.description: This necklace protects the Minotot's cervical vertebrae from lethal Wabbit punches.

items.name: Dragon Pig Necklace
items.description: This necklace comes with a small loop so the owner of the Dragon Pig can attach a leash to it. It also does wonders for Dragon Pig lice.

items.name: Minotoror Axe
items.description: This very axe actually beheaded one of the most dangerous Minotorors in the province of Amakna. What I can't believe is that you don't seem to care!

items.name: Minotot Sceptre
items.description: This sceptre with a Plissken head made of precious stones at one end enables you to scare away young adventurers and kick their pinky butts.

items.name: Minotoror Boots
items.description: You won't go winning the legendary race of Amakna Bay with these terrible boots of Minotoror Hair and leather. You might manage to break the competitors' toes on the starting line, though.

items.name: Minotot Sandals
items.description: These incredible sandals will enable you to bathe in the most dangerous waters without hurting your feet. Be careful however, as they're said to scratch the bottom of bathtubs.

items.name: Dragon Pig Mules
items.description: A good pair of mules at your side and you'll feel stronger, more powerful and deadlier than ever. They're just ordinary mules, though. It must be the vibes they give off.

items.name: Minotoror Cloak
items.description: Take a Minotoror. Firmly tie him up. Take a giant plane and peel off his back in a oner. There! You've got your Minotoror Cloak!

items.name: Minotot Cloak
items.description: This is the perfect cloak to go out or practise your seduction skills at the Captain Chafer's masked ball.

items.name: Dragon Pig Cloak
items.description: This cloak will not turn you into a Piglet but at least you'll be able dress up for one night and seduce a beautiful sow.

items.name: Minotoror Belt
items.description: This supple belt can be used to whip unruly kids' bottoms. Its buckle might even mark their skin but this would only teach them their lesson once and for all.

items.name: Minotot Belt
items.description: The Minotot used this stiff belt to hold his huge potbelly in, preventing him from toppling over every time he felt a draught.

items.name: Minotot Headgear
items.description: This headgear has been passed down from generation to generation through the Minotot family. This partially explains why it smells like rotting dandruff.

items.name: Dragon Pig Headgear
items.description: With this huge skull on, you'll look like a stiff-bristled Grizball, but with no hair. Your admirers will be speechless.

items.name: Dreggon Cape
items.description: According to the legend, this scale-covered cape will protect you from lightning, beans and femmes fatales, whatever they are.

items.name: Dreggon Helmet
items.description: A little angel like you could easily pass for a merciless warrior with such a terrifying and disproportionate helmet on. If that doesn't work, it'll make a great cloak rack.

items.name: Dreggon Belt
items.description: The most perverted minds in Amakna say that this belt can be used as a prosthesis. No one knows why they would say that, though, and they're wrong. It's just a plain old Dreggon belt. Really.

items.name: Dreggon Ring
items.description: This ring, directly cut in the shape of a giant Dreggon scale, will protect a small part of your phalanx. Maybe the most important part...

items.name: Dreggon Amulet
items.description: Made of Dreggon scales, this amulet will efficiently protect your Adam's Api or your tonsils. It will make all the difference on a battlefield.

items.name: Dreggon Boots
items.description: These boots are perfect for killing Gobballs while playing Gobbowl or making your enemies suffer some more during spanking sessions.

items.name: Dreggon Sword
items.description: You'll end up without a nose if you use this sword to shave your face. Save it for your back.

items.name: Dreggon Axe
items.description: This axe cuts through skulls like a hot knife through butter.

items.name: Dreggon Hammer
items.description: Heavier than an empty Munchor Skull, but less solid than a Cave-dwelling Kirball femur, this hammer is nevertheless quite a fearsome weapon.

items.name: Dreggon Bow
items.description: This bow is so powerful that it can send Dreggon eggs over the great wall of Brakmar. What a wonderful waste of food!

items.name: Dreggon Wand
items.description: This wand seems to be a lot more effective when it's used as a club or as a Moskito swatter!

items.name: Dreggon Staff
items.description: One end of this staff is armed with a long, sharp point. No one knows where it came from, but you can guess where it usually goes.

items.name: Shika's Ears
items.description: Shika used to help Farle at harvest time by picking up the magic grain his scythe swiped. She used it to make necklaces. Though their roots and stalks have been cut off, these magic ears keep on ripening every year around the same time.

items.name: Shika's Magic Bracelet
items.description: This bracelet covered up Shika's arms. This way it protected her from sunburn and Crobak pecks... the little creatures were attracted by her stunning beauty and many claim to have gotten lucky with her.

items.name: Shika's Hoe
items.description: This custom-made hoe helped Shika make the highest haystacks in the realm. Legend has it they were so big that sailors used them as markers to tell how far they were from the Amaknian coast.

items.name: Shika's Clogs
items.description: These clogs were created for Shika so that she wouldn't trample the seedbeds of the Snossios plains. The high-heels make it easier to run in the stubble without hurting her ankles and stop the dew getting in.

items.name: Shika's Cape
items.description: Flowers from harvest time have been sewn to this cape made of woven magic cereals. It's driven by such a powerful magic that Shika used to use it for protection against lightning on stormy nights!

items.name: Shika's Belt
items.description: This belt of leather used to protect Shika's thighs when she ran across the wheat fields to bring back to their herd lost Gobballs. Covered with pollen from magic cereals, legend says that it used to shimmer in the moonlight and ensured Farle didn't cut his wife's legs while reaping fields of cereals at night.

items.name: Shika's Hat
items.description: Covered with a multitude of flowers, this hat made Shika look happy and bright when she left at the crack of dawn to plough the Church Hills.

items.name: Dragandrop Headgear
items.description: This little headgear lets Dragandrops throw themselves at their enemies without running the risk of getting lumps on their foreheads. It's long been in use on major construction sites in Amakna, as well. This headgear became all the rage again after Moowolves from Kruup Mountain invaded Astrub. What's the point of this story? There is no point, but who cares?

items.name: Dragostess Hat
items.description: With this hat on, you'll be able to dress up and seduce any naive Astrubian you find... Just offer him a hot date for 100 kamas, and Bob's your uncle, his wallet's empty.

items.name: Father Kwismas Cape
items.description: This mysterious cape only comes out once a year, but the scammers always use it to get a fast kama from the kiddies.

items.name: Father Kwismas Hat
items.description: This hat will hide the scars all over your head. That way, no more toddlers will be injured trying to flee in terror from your Santa stall.

items.name: Kwismas Sword
items.description: This strange sword sure won't make you invincible... In fact, people have died trying to kill snowmen with it.

items.name: Pineapi Boots
items.description: These boots smell of Pineapi juice marinated with wet socks. The great thing is that when you visit your friends, they will never ask you to take your shoes off.

items.name: Little Red Waddling Cape
items.description: This cape used to belong to a famous capon, a long-feathered bird that loved to dance near the Bonta Zaap and puff itself up in front of all the gullible poultry and immature chickens.

items.name: Dreggon Daggers
items.description: These daggers are perfect for cutting the top off a soft-boiled Dreggon egg. They're also very light, which enables you to run fast when the Dreggon community realises what you've done.

items.name: Cake Shovel
items.description: This small shovel was once given to a young Enutrof. He liked it so much that he took up digging full time. He dug his own grave when he was twenty eight and healthy... dug himself a whole graveyard, he still didn't die. His body was lost at sea first time he left home. How ironic.

items.name: Shovel Ijah
items.description: Captain Mayhav is said to have used this very shovel to rip open the Great White Kralove known as Dopy Mick.

items.name: Dreggon Shovel
items.description: Dreggons like to dig networks of underground passages but they never use these shovels. The Enutrof community studied this enigma but concluded that it was less important to know where they came from than how to hit someone with one.

items.name: Billalo
items.description: Bill wanted a halo. He screamed so loud and threw such a tantrum that he finally got it. A real little devil.

items.name: Black Rat Mask
items.description: Brouce Boulgoure used this mask to discreetly infiltrate a Grossewer rats' den and cut down an elm by the roots. On the way out, he squashed every single rat in the den with his wooden clogs.

items.name: Black Rat Cape
items.description: This cape can be made with any sort of animal hair provided that it's very dirty. They are plaited together and then cemented with various secretions. The smell is unfortunately not optional.

items.name: Black Rat Daggers
items.description: Badly damaged, but extremely sharp, these dagger blades will slice off a limb with disconcerting ease. They'll sink through bones like butter, allowing you to carve your enemies up like spring chickens. What a pity they aren't rusty, poisoned and white-hot too!

items.name: Black Rat Necklace
items.description: The rat who used to own this necklace thought he would become the chief of his clan. He was devoured by a rabid Lenald.

items.name: Black Rat Boots
items.description: Be careful when you put on these boots, as there might still be a foot or two of the previous owner inside them.

items.name: Black Rat Belt
items.description: Unlike his Bontarian cousin, the Black rat is discreet and wears a simple fabric belt. But he also likes to take a lot of weapons with him, and it all makes a terrible clinking noise at each of his steps.

items.name: Black Rat Glove
items.description: They say that the Black Rat himself scratched his own back with the sharp claws on this glove. Be that as it may, it may still have fur and hair caught in the crevices and there are no guarantees as to the odour. One could even wonder if he only scratched his back...

items.name: White Rat Rapier
items.description: This weapon is the symbol of the White Rat. It will slice both enemies and allies with the same ease.

items.name: White Rat Hat
items.description: With this hat, the White Rat looks like a real musketeer from Bonta. Without this hat, he looks like an ordinary, hatless white rat from Bonta.

items.name: White Rat Cape
items.description: This cape is the identifying symbol of white rats throughout the Bonta sewers. It is the reward a rat gets after a long and difficult series of examinations and is proudly worn until the pants his final ratty breath... which usually isn't very long at all.

items.name: White Rat Necklace
items.description: If you wear this around your neck like a necklace, it'll protect you from the toxic sewer fumes. If you wear it lower down like a belt, it will protect your allies from your toxic intestinal fumes.

items.name: White Rat Glove
items.description: This glove used to belong to Julia Dilch, master cook at the Bonta palace. She used it to knock out gobballs that didn't want their throats slit, wild plants that didn't want to end up in a salad bowl, and clients reluctant to eat what was on the menu. And through it all, she stayed classy, never once getting her hands dirty.

items.name: White Rat Belt
items.description: Although their Brakmarian cousins may not agree, white rats like to be as discreet as possible. That's why this belt is so light and small – to stylishly offset overly imposing bodies.

items.name: White Rat Boots
items.description: With these boots, your balance will be perfect. You won't sway in the slightest, even on the windiest of days.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Hat
items.description: This hat has nothing to do with a Dora, a Brave's Dark Dora, a Dora Bora or a Doro L. Blak. Absolutely nothing! So don't bother spreading rumours about its designer being slack or uninspired! It's just a very nice looking hat.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Cape
items.description: This colourful cape turns you into an ideal target. Only quick and nimble adventurers can wear it for more than a few minutes.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Necklace
items.description: To dissuade greedy thieves, this necklace is secured around the neck of the heir to the Lord of the Rats at his birth. The only way to remove it is to take off his head... This doesn't seem to dissuade the thieves.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Ring
items.description: This ring was designed at a time when the Lord of the Rats only had one finger left after mutilating all the others. The unfortunate lords that followed had all of theirs.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Belt
items.description: The patterns on this belt will have people thinking you're on fire. The optical illusion is so powerful that you shouldn't be surprised when complete strangers throw water all over you. Amazingly enough, this corresponds exactly to the ceremonial ritual.

items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Boots
items.description: The very first Lord of the Rats died when he stepped in a pool of molten lava. To pay tribute to him, his lords wear these boots. By the way, they are not in the least bit fireproof.

items.name: Ancestral Treechelmet
items.description: The mushrooms pushing up on this helmet spread a nice exhilarating smell that makes you want to take roots. They are also quite tasty but might definitely bury you.

items.name: Ancestral Treecape
items.description: In summer, the Ancestral Treechnid likes to sunbathe but as its wood is accustomed to dark forests, it doesn't stand it very well. This cape is made of his bark peelings.

items.name: Ancestral Torc
items.description: Worn around your neck with a low-cut top, this torc will accentuate your beard beautifully. If you don't have one... well... you only have yourself to blame.

items.name: Ancestral Ring
items.description: If you've had a little too much to drink, you might see the Moskito embedded in this ring wink at you. But don't tell your friends, the little beast will deny everything.

items.name: Ancestral Shin Guards
items.description: Your legs will fear nothing when you're wearing these solid wood shin guards. Unfortunately, you can't wear them and boots at the same time. You can wear them for protection during gobbowl ball games, but your toes will take the full brunt of any toe pokers.

items.name: Ancestral Treebelt
items.description: This belt is supposed to inspire you with ancestral virility. Whether this was ever true or not, the effect has now surely gone without a trace.

items.name: Soft Oak Talisman
items.description: This piece of wood extracted from the very heart of the Soft Oak is extremely powerful. Indeed, it can even enrage the Soft Oak.

items.name: Soft Oak Ring
items.description: This ring is made of Soft Oak faeces. It's wooden alright, but the smell remains the same.

items.name: Soft Oak Flip-Flops
items.description: On Sundays, the Soft Oak takes a long nap and when he wakes up he likes to have an obedient Trunknid bring him his flip-flops. Fortunately, he doesn't have any feet so they're still brand new.

items.name: Worn Soft Oak Cape
items.description: More than 200 years ago, some fabric got stuck in the Soft Oak's branches. As the tree grew, it imbued the fabric with its magic. The cloth is now an integral part of this huge piece of wood and though it makes it hard to handle and highly flammable, its power can't be denied.

items.name: Autumnal Soft Oak G-String
items.description: In autumn, the Soft Oak wears its G-string to protect his precious acorns. In summer time, he likes to go commando.

items.name: Soft Oak Hat
items.description: No matter how you wear this hat, it will always look like it's on sideways.

items.name: Bworknroll's Scalpel
items.description: There's nothing better for collecting "bits" of creatures than Bworknroll's scalpel, which preserves the vitality of the torn-off limbs.

items.name: The Red Cape
items.description: The red cape is the favourite artefact of megalomaniacs. Once on their frail shoulders, they believe they are Superman or an ultra-powerful magician. Until they meet a Minotoror at least.

items.name: Gobtrotter
items.description: These Goblin skin boots were created by Planbworksek to charge the enemy (if possible from behind) extremely quickly. These boots saved many a Bwork comrade in wartime.

items.name: Ruskie Hat
items.description: This hat keeps your ears warm and absorbs the alcohol on your breath. What else could you ask for?

items.name: Flud
items.description: The Flud is not really a hat. It's more of a parasite that tends to develop on loud or aggressive people's heads. Its disgusting appearance repels all and sundry, compelling its wearer to scream even louder which is useless since these people have nothing to say anyway.

items.name: S'loque Cape
items.description: This padded cape absorbs all surrounding noise, plunging the wearer into a lifetime of incredibly awkward silences.

items.name: Crashers
items.description: These getas are so light that they make their owner run and jump all over the place whenever some action starts. Experienced adventurers just hate them... Every Tom Dick and Harry comes and crashes their fights uninvited.

items.name: Muffin Belt
items.description: This belt must be worn tight... so tight that it forces its wearer to stammer, shake and generally jerk around in the inimitable style of Thrustin Timbertake.

items.name: Pluswan
items.description: This small ring has no use beside making you look extremely flashy. Now people might actually want to talk to you.

items.name: Issa Mess
items.description: After several nights of hard work, the most famous jeweller in Astrub, also known for being raised by Bworks, announced to an astounded crowd: "c u l8r @ d gld hs". Even the renowned historian Champo Lhyon didn't manage to decipher the jeweller's message.

items.name: Pandawa Cub
items.description: This cute Pandawa Cub will gladly travel round the World with you and discover its mysteries with its big, round eyes.

items.name: Doro L. Blak
items.description: This cap used to belong to a little Xelorette who got a kick out of disrupting the passage of time. Legend has it that she once stole several days off the inhabitants of Amakna. She had to hand out quite a few candies to make up for that little trick.

items.name: First Blood Staff
items.description: A famous Feca warrior who lived in the jungle of Pandala was often heard to say: "To win the war, you have to become the war".

items.name: Crimson Claw
items.description: This sharp sword gained this elegant crimson colour after gutting thousands of Bworks. Before, it was just purplish.

items.name: Emment Daggers
items.description: These blades have holes all over them so that they make a nice little whistling noise when handled quickly. The holes are also extremely useful when it comes to gutting your enemies.

items.name: Clawettes
items.description: These daggers were forged for a Ecaflip who had a real thing for proper manicures. She thought that heavy swords that didn't match her perfectly varnished claws.

items.name: Stalk Sword
items.description: This shiny sword is perfect for trimming flowers and trees, even if the plants fight back.

items.name: Rubber Sword
items.description: This blade has been lubricated to slip into its sheath more easily. However, it cannot be cleaned after use and must be thrown away, especially if it's covered in blood. Bear in mind that its main use is to protect you.

items.name: Studded Staff
items.description: It's a big staff with nails knocked into it. Do not hope for something else in this staff, it's simple and loosens your enemies' teeth nicely.

items.name: Scrap Staff
items.description: Rumour has it that a Sadida named Fraye used this staff to protect his wife and son from an enraged flock of Gobballs. What a pity that he also mistook his family for the monsters during the fight.

items.name: Bushi'Bow
items.description: This bow is light, delicate, elegant and smells of cherry tree flowers. It is also lethal if used for anything other than striking a pose.

items.name: Bow Liwood
items.description: If you hold this bow high and joyfully say "Pampulilu!", you'll look absolutely ridiculous.

items.name: Wand Else?
items.description: This wand belongs to a famous Grinegau who makes excellent coffee, but who just can't get the ladies.

items.name: The Bidjiz
items.description: With the Bidjiz, you'll stay alive probably because your opponents will start dancing when they see the disco ball at the end of this wand.

items.name: Shovel Minster
items.description: Created like a Smithmagic masterpiece, this shovel digs really bad, except when it's your opponents' heads.

items.name: RIP Shovel
items.description: This shovel is a great invention. It can dig up a grave and be left on top as a cross, provided only one adventure fellow dies at the time... Or else you'll have to dig the other graves with your hands.

items.name: Red Hammer
items.description: This Hammer easily crushes skulls to pulp... which is exactly why it's tinted with a nice red tomato colour.

items.name: Stephammer
items.description: This hammer was created during the reign of King Stephan, a terrible tyrant who terrorised trillions of people.

items.name: Purrin Axe
items.description: Your pet, our passion.

items.name: Koss Axe
items.description: This strange axe is designed to easily behead Bworks. The ease with which it can also behead Astrub's inhabitants clearly indicates that there's a connection between these two populations. But no one has discovered just what it is yet.

items.name: Hat Ariutokinabot
items.description: Thanks to this warrior hat, Iops really cut a fine figure. The only problem is that it hides some of their field of vision and prevents them from hearing their opponents' words. This hat is designed for those who like to strike before they think.

Unfortunately, this brilliant artist had a tragic Quaquack accident after a particularly boozy New Year's Eve celebration.

items.name: Ukando Hat
items.description: This headgear bestows self confidence and temerity on whoever wears it. Thanks to it you'll always keep going thinking you can actually make exploits. Remember to take it off from time to time or it will take you into inextricable situations!

items.description: This hat looks like the Sulik and the Paperb' Hat. But since it's very comfy and Xelors never take it off - even when they sleep, it is commonly called Hatter Lily. items.description: Thanks to this hat, Eniripsas always know how to deal with emergencies. Indeed, all the first aid tips are discreetly written on the lining. It makes them look as if they just graduated even though no one would normally wear such a ridiculous hat even for a school ceremony!

items.description: You might have expected this headgear to be a handsome orange colour. It's nothing of the sort. Not only that, this fashion accessory is more of a mask than a cap... So why did the creators decide to call it a Cap Ricott? Probably just to get people talking about it!

When their allies are in trouble on the battlefield, these comfy boots help them recover and ward off the threat.
