items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Cape
items.description: Made from Mopy King Fabric, this cape is riddled with micro-holes that allow sweat to escape more easily during periods of intense exercise - during aggressive melees in steamy swamps, for example. The holes may let the humidity out, but they keep the heat in, and so you always stay dry, whatever the situation. It's just a pity the stench of mould is so hard to shift.

items.name: Ouassingual Cape
items.description: This cape may not be as powerful as the fancier Mopy King version, but it still has the same sweat evacuation system. You'll be able to face any situation wearing it, as long as you're able to fight while holding your breath, that is. The stench is truly unbearable!

items.name: Zoth Sergeant Mask
items.description: This sturdy wooden mask will have you fearlessly facing all kinds of dangers, which isn't surprising given that it completely blocks your view.

items.name: Zoth Disciple Hat
items.description: From a distance, this hat looks like a lampshade with two holes for the eyes. It looks the same up close actually.

items.name: Light Treeckler Mask
items.description: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects.

items.name: Dark Treeckler Mask
items.description: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects. The dark touch simply indicates that you're in a bad mood... and that you should not be annoyed and you're ready to throw a flurry of blows to anyone who does not respect that!

items.name: Snailmet
items.description: You'll look like a Snailmet if you wear this hat. Of course it will protect your head from blows, but does that make up for the slobber all over your head?

items.name: Great Coralator Mace
items.description: Bigger, heavier and more powerful, this mace makes a louder noise when smashing the enemies. But curiously, it's lighter and has a better grip to it. The Coralator we used to make it wasn't great for no reason!

items.name: Zoth Girl Hammer
items.description: Despite her small size, the Zoth Girl carries a huge hammer. It's a way to reinforce her muscle structure. No need to add weights around her wrists and ankles to increase her strength. Dragging the hammer is quite enough!

items.name: Zoth Warrior Axe
items.description: The Zoth Warrior is used to carrying two axes because he can't reach his enemy's left side with his right hand. It's hard to tell whether it is due to a lack of self-confidence or if he was just born clumsy!

items.name: Cheeken Wig
items.description: The Cheeken is an awkward, winged creature which has as much energy as a Tofu with avian flu.

items.name: Barbrossa's Hat
items.description: This hat is large enough to hide Barbrossa's ridiculously hairless head and beard. But it won't cover big-headed skulls.

items.name: Coralator Mace
items.description: This hammer took its nice colour from the pieces of Coralator used to make it. Unlike what people think, it was not originally used to crush Iops and other enemies, but as a door-knocker for the hard of hearing.

items.name: Dark Treeckler Branch
items.description: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. But don't worry, the dark colour is authentic, it's got nothing to do with the various sorts of deposits contained in the inaccessible cavities of the Treeckler.

items.name: Light Treeckler Branch
items.description: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. This might explain the stick's stickiness.

items.name: Rotaflor Stem
items.description: Rotaflors use their stem to clean their ears. Sculptors, however, prefer to use them as weapons. Proof, indeed, that there's no accounting for taste.

items.name: Zoth Master Staff
items.description: This staff completely binds the Zoth Master, making him fearless and therefore formidable. When it comes to eating though, it makes an awful mess.

items.name: Tynril Rhizome
items.description: Just like weeds, Tynrils can breed infinitely thanks to this simple piece of rhizome. After making this discovery some greedy staffmakers made a staff from Tynril and tried to breed it. It was a miserable failure.

items.name: Thierry Voodoo Mask
items.description: This Voodoo mask serves primarily to hide and protect the faces of those who, like Thierry, like slingshots, but often miss their target.

items.name: Jav Voodoo Mask
items.description: When Jav Kanniballs feel a little blue, they dye their hair this colour. Is it due to frustrated love or something else? Hard to know for sure, but it would be great if they could just wear the mask and stop telling everyone how sad they were.

items.name: Sarbak Voodoo Mask
items.description: Many moons ago, the Kanniballs were travelling actors respected for their comedies and tragedies, as represented by two masks - one laughing, the other cruel. When their chief lost the happy mask, the Kanniballs descended into savagery.

items.name: Archer Voodoo Mask
items.description: Kanniball archers can't concentrate and aim right unless they are very angry. So, in order to be sure to see red at all times, they painted their masks this colour.

items.name: Crocodyl Dandy's Hat
items.description: When he puts on this hat, Crocodyl Dandy thinks he's at the forefront of fashion. Fashion must be pretty dull if that's the case. However, it'd be best if you didn't let him know how ridiculous he looks, after all, he is particularly touchy.

items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Hood
items.description: This hood serves as a royal headdress, and shares the same virtues as the Mopy King Sovereign Cape. Its micro-vents allow sweat to drain away more easily, so you'll always have a cool head. Unfortunately, it shares the same defects as the cape: its foul stench is so strong, you could cut it with a knife.

items.name: Ouassingual Hood
items.description: It may be less efficient than the Sovereign Hood, but it still allows for a good draining of the sweat. Maybe too good, actually. As a result, whether you wear it or not, it won't make any difference.

items.name: Zoth Girl Hat
items.description: The Zoth Girl's hat makes her see double. Strange. This is the reason she lisps.

items.name: Zoth Warrior Helmet
items.description: This helmet has the same advantages as other Zoth hats - it'll protect you from the sun no matter how hot it is, from blows dealt on the head, and it prevents the wearer from being aware of the danger by restricting his visual field. Anyway, this is the perfect warrior headgear.

items.name: Zoth Master Hat
items.description: The main advantage of the Zoth Master Hat is that it restricts your field of view far more than any other helmet. Thanks to this peculiarity, the wearer can use the famous fighting technique known as "The Weasel". In short, this method consists of striking anywhere using all your strength. As it's completely unpredictable, you're guaranteed to defeat your opponent (or at least surprise them enough to finish them off with a well-placed kick).

items.name: Barkritter Root
items.description: This stick is a firm favourite with the trunk-women. But it'll seduce any old kind of girl. Probably.

items.name: Floramor Root
items.description: If you're superstitious and always need to knock on wood, use the Floramor Root! On the other hand, you should try to be careful not to saw the branch you're sitting on and especially not to get your fingers in the way!

items.name: Crack Sparrow's Own Withered Hat
items.description: You say that a kraken, with the foulest breath you've ever seen, follows you wherever you go? Well, deal with it: it's only a tiny inconvenience that comes with the hat!

items.name: Sharkal Shield
items.description: This shield will protect you for now, but don't be fooled, it won't last.

items.name: Bherbal Bherb Belt
items.description: When the Bherb has got butterflies, he wears his Bherbal belt and healthily eliminates them.

items.name: Boots Kwish
items.description: These boots create a disgusting suction noise with each step, which will remind you of a rutting Trool's love chant if you've ever heard it. A painful memory that you could easily live without.

items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Seal
items.description: This seal indicates that its owner is the undisputed sovereign of Otomai Island's Bottomless Peat Bog, although it's difficult to imagine a more pastoral kingdom...

items.name: Coral Ring
items.description: This ring was pulled off the still-warm finger of a freshly slaughtered Coralator. His mother was expecting him for dinner, until she saw he'd been transformed into a tombstone.  Coralators are not as stone-hearted as people might imagine.

items.name: Round Kimbo Sandals
items.description: Only Kimbos, with their weird feet, feel comfortable in these sandals. However, they're not the only ones who can benefit from their powers. But be careful not to wear them the wrong way!

items.name: Parkinn Pan's Pikokowal Belt
items.description: Parkinn Pan truly believed that he could fly thanks to this belt trimmed with Pikoko wings, but what he didn't know was that very few Pikokos can actually fly. That's why every time he jumped off the Tree Keeholo he routinely crashed to the forest floor below. His nickname "Cake" comes from "flat as a pancake".

items.name: Zothulet
items.description: This amulet might be nothing more than a few pieces of wood bound with a strip of torn fabric, but the Zoths are absolutely convinced it has terrible powers. The doddery old fools!

items.name: Snailmet Bow
items.description: This bow string is made of Snailmet Slobber, not too dry with a unique elasticity. However, its slimy and gooey texture reminds you of, well, nothing really, but it's quite unpleasant.

items.name: Snailmet Ring
items.description: Carved in a Snailmet carapace, this ring can resist anything and anyone.

items.name: Powerful Dazzling Cloak
items.description: Woven from Zoth fabrics, this cape has extraordinary powers of unknown origin.

items.name: Moopet Cape
items.description: With this cape on, you'll be craving for some vinaigrette.

items.name: Cheeken Axe
items.description:
The Cheeken Beak on this weapon is absolutely useless, and can be more of a handicap than anything else.
Fortunately, it is quite powerful.

items.name: Wooden Treeckler Boots
items.description: These boots are so heavy that they should actually be categorised as weapons. Indeed, they make the slightest kick lethal.

items.name: Dark Treeckler Belt
items.description: Carved in a Dark Treeckler, this belt isn't pliable enough to let you move around easily, but at least, it'll protects you.

items.name: Light Treeckler Belt
items.description: Carved from a Light Treeckler, this belt won't afford you great protection, but at least it is soft enough to let you move around freely.

items.name: Ring Dikuloos
items.description: This jewel is not precious but is the perfect size to balance the moorgale in a nice belgroot flavoured with a hint of Glaviooze.

items.name: Krabelt
items.description: Finally a good excuse to smell of the sea!

items.name: Ouassulet
items.description: This jewel sometimes tries to steal some of your food when you're eating, so don't let it hang down too low.

items.name: Inky Veil
items.description: This strange cape seems to be made of black ink, but oddly enough, it behaves just like fabric - it doesn't run. As for stains, well, that's another matter. Your backside will never be clean again.

items.name: Kringlove
items.description: Once round your finger, you won't be able to take it off, ever. Its suckers are way too powerful.

items.name: Kidommer
items.description: This hammer is not handy, not particularly good looking, not very ergonomic, not powerful, too light, too fragile, unbalanced, too shiny and smelly. But at least it's got pretty colours.

items.name: Polished Ring
items.description: Unfortunately, this ring is only polished on the outside. You put your finger through a hole full of sharp rock fragments. It is recommended for Sacriers.

items.name: Amufafah
items.description: It's the Mufafah moustaches that cause the wearer of this necklace to bellow so loudly. Why? They hang down and tickle the nipples constantly.

items.name: Solo's Ring
items.description: Solo was a nice good-for-nothing, and he admitted as much himself. That didn't stop him from being hanged on the village square for stealing a thong belonging to the chief's wife. Solo wasn't a bright guy, no, but he was a nice guy all the same.

items.name: Improved Helmet
items.description: In theory, this helmet should keep your wig on your head if you decide to go ride a Scaraleaf. Simply priceless!

items.name: Improved Wooden Wings
items.description: These improved wooden wings have been padded and made lighter thanks to feathers and high-quality fabric. Since the frame is still in wood, it will be hard not to crash!

items.name: Rahm Bow
items.description: Once upon a time, a man named Rahm got lost in the jungle. Have you heard of Viet Rham?

items.name: Little Bow Sleep
items.description: This strange bow was carved by a Sadidette during a very productive sleep-stroll. Just looking at it makes you feel sleepy - that goes for the archer as well as the target.

items.name: Dagger Doo
items.description: These daggers are perfect for pushing Pineapis and shaking trees, or pushing Pineapis and grinding coffee, if that's what takes your fancy. Just remember: to the left, to the right, jump up and down and to the knees.

items.name: Gaga Daggers
items.description: Long ago there lived a mad Sram called Gaga... this guy, he robbed from the poor and gave to the rich.

items.name: Porkeez Daggers
items.description: Porkeez is a better drinker than he is a fighter, and let me tell you he doesn't get any better as time passes by. All the same I wouldn't go around looking like a cork when he's got his daggers out.

items.name: Kriss Tobal
items.description: This should not be mistaken for the famous staff of similar name. The blades on this implement spill far more blood.

items.name: Fuchsia
items.description: Many a proud adventurer refused this weapon because of its colour. Many the same died by its blade.

items.name: Az'tech
items.description: This sword used to belong to an old, power-hungry Enutrof. Just like his ego, it's made of solid gold.

items.name: Kukri Kura
items.description: Smile! Say cheese! Perfect! Sliced in half!

items.name: Sick Axe
items.description: Ourag'han was an old Pandawa with skin so soft he was known as Slippiderm. His odour on the other hand gave rise to another name altogether. He christened his trusty axe likewise.

items.name: Michael Dougle Axe
items.description: Driven into a horticidal rage when a mischievous squirrel stole a grain of his rice during a summer holiday on Pandala Island, Brouce Boulgoure used this axe to flatten each and every bamboo shoot the squirrel hopped onto.  The Pandawas in the village had to feed him half their stock of bamboo wine to keep him from razing the entire forest. Trust old Broucey.

items.name: Hickory Shovel
items.description: Even as a young Iopette, Mel dreamt of slaying dragons. With a spade for a sword and a rock for a dragon, she honed her skills in the back yard. The mere mention of a shovel now has the poor rock in convulsions.

items.name: Shovel Shattkitou
items.description: This is a wild shovel which tries to bite its owner each time it's picked up. It makes the most unusual sounds when it's happy and can only be pacified with the soothing sound of chimes.

items.name: Shovel Egant
items.description: A cunning Enutrof became a pirate after noticing that there were more treasures to be found on fresh corpses than in rotten graves. This blood-red shovel was his symbol and filled the sailors of the Asse Sea with terror.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.

items.name: Ecaflip Paw
items.description: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.

items.name: Perfect Ecaflip Paw
items.description: This sword represents the incarnation of the god Ecaflip's luck. You're holding in your hands the purest version of the Ecaflip Paw, which testifies to your incredible, yet somehow undignified, luck.

items.name: Air Pikoko Helmet
items.description: If you spin around at the speed of sound while wearing this helmet, you'll take off. As for landing, well, you'll have to sort it out.

items.name: Head Band
items.description: This cold, slimy ring never stops sucking on your finger from the minute you slip it on. If you can see past its flaws, however, its great powers are yours to wield.

items.name: Blord Warrior's Cursed Scythe
items.description: This blade cuts wheat as well as enemies, but it also makes your allies extremely jealous. That's the destiny of powerful people.

items.name: Blord Warrior's Cursed Sword
items.description: This sword holds an immense power of which the many victims fill chapters in the history books. It's said there's also a cursed scythe, but only the most famous farmer could confirm that.

items.name: Sidimote Shield
items.description: This shield will remind your opponents you grew up in the Sidimote Moors. That alone could be enough to scare them away.

items.name: Phtalmo
items.description: This shield is covered with peepers to allow you to give one of those devastating multi-evil-eyes. Unstoppable.

items.name: Inn Shield
items.description: The Innkeeper at the Feubuk Brewery in Bonta was bored to death one day when he suddenly got the idea of equipping his bouncers with neon advertising shields.

items.name: Akwadala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Akwadala should do the trick.

items.name: Fan Shield
items.description: When your allies run out of breath, or when you want to clear the air after an unexpected wind of panic, this shield can save your life. The only thing you need to do is to shake it energetically in all directions, like you'd do with a hungry baby.

items.name: Sadida Shield
items.description: Sadidas originally used this shield as a stool when they needed to rest. If you tuck in your feet, it will protect you from a wide range of attacks. Nothing will protect you from the cruel laughter of your opponents, however.

items.name: Shield in Briefs
items.description: This surprising creation is covered in a pair of Chafer Lancer Leather Briefs which have been boiled, cleaned and stretched so that they hug the arm as perfectly as they did the full, generous curves of Chafer Lancer's... I think that's quite enough of that actually.

items.name: Asse Shield
items.description: This magnificent shield contains a few drops from the Asse Sea. Not only does it bring good luck but it can also be used as a flask.

items.name: Treechnid Shield
items.description: Hidden behind this shield, some naive adventurers could mistake you for a Treechnid and run off screaming. Most will attack all the more eagerly, thinking they can get some amber out of you.

items.name: Pandawa Shield
items.description: Perfect if you want to fit in on Pandala, or to stand out anywhere else! The biggest advantage of this shield is that it's entirely covered with hypoallergenic Pandawa hair, so now you don't need to pack your underwear and your armour in separate suitcases when you take your vacation.

items.name: Fire Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Fire element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Air Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Air element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Earth Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Earth element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Water Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Water element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Lumberjack Shield
items.description: This shield used to protect lumberjacks from falling trees. Its function quickly changed and now it is more often used to protect warriors from enemies who tend to land on them without warning!

items.name: Mount Stinkky Shield
items.description: Greenish and smelly, this shield remains a first choice for protection when it comes to fighting the creatures of green and smelly Mount Stinkky.

items.name: Imp Shield
items.description: If your dearest dream is to become a real imp, this is the shield you need. Passed down from generation to generation, it will enable you to rob all the young Astrubian adventurers you like without getting hurt.

items.name: Heart Quarter
items.description: A renowned adventurer spent his whole life looking for all four quarters of this shield. Some say that when the shield is complete, it has the exact opposite effect of that of breaking a mirror.

items.name: Bawbawian Shield
items.description: Not all Wabbits are nice little creatures. In fact, all Wabbits are vile creatures. Some get their kicks smashing up Cawwots with this huge shield and taking baths in the juice.

items.name: Derma Tho
items.description: This shield of skin will fit you like a glove. Don't forget to treat its warts and furuncles from time to time to prevent them from getting worn.

items.name: Captain Amakna Shield
items.description: A young adventurer once dreamt of joining the Bonta militia to protect the oppressed. Considered morally unfit for service, he was contacted by an Amakna alchemist who took advantage of his good nature, using him as a guinea-pig for his potions. You'll be glad to know that this is one story that ends... well, the middle bit is happy. He became so strong that he was known forever more as Captain Amakna and had this reputedly indestructible shield forged for him. The end... well, you don't wanna know the end.

items.name: Kloome
items.description: This huge shield saved the famous adventurer Kloome from an awful death: squashed under the weight of a Crackler who was in love with him. The legend doesn't say if he survived the side effects of his subsequent romance with the stony beast.

items.name: Flying Shield
items.description: As strange as it might sound, some say this shield of wood and hair enables the lightest adventurers to become airborne for a brief moment... a final attempt to shock their enemies before falling flat on their faces.

items.name: LeChouque's Shield
items.description: LeChouque used this shield to protect himself from the friendly cannonballs his friends regularly tossed to him. Some crazy stories tell that some of those balls were alive.

items.name: Gobball Shield
items.description: Although it's all but useless, its stench alone will spread your fame far and wide. This shield accompanies many young adventurers on their first quests - maybe that's why so few make it to thirty.

items.name: Bowisse's Shield
items.description: This shield is a tribute to Bowisse's Cloak which itself was a tribute to a famous relic composed of three triangular shapes. Blimey, all this history is putting me to sleep.

items.name: Crackler Shield
items.description: This stone shield is in fact made from a Crackler's head, smashed by the foot of a Minotoror. A perfect combination of big head and smelly feet.

items.name: Terrdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Terrdala should do the trick.

items.name: Feudala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Feudala should do the trick.

items.name: Aerdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Aerdala should do the trick.

items.name: Gore Master's Ring (Gms Only)
items.description: In his time, Gore Master was very strong and had all he needed - money, women and more. He didn't quite deserve all of it since he got his strength from his nice ring. Until the day he carelessly crossed the street. And BAM! No more Gore Master. Since then, unscrupulous people pass it on to other unscrupulous people.

items.name: Ougaammer
items.description: Ougaa had a head thicker than anyone else, which is why a hammer created from the skull of this redoubtable deity is perfect for crushing those of others.

items.name: Morello Cherry Blop Ring
items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way around your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

items.name: Pippin Blop Ring
items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

items.name: Coco Blop Ring
items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

items.name: Indigo Blop Ring
items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Blop Ring
items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

items.name: Royal Pippin Blop Ring
items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

items.name: Royal Coco Blop Ring
items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

items.name: Royal Indigo Blop Ring
items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

items.name: Ougaamulet
items.description: This rough copy of the great Ougaa should be worn around the neck, with a hungry stare and a well-kept beard to boot.

items.name: Colette's Ring
items.description: A young Cra named Colette lost her head in Eltneg Wood. The poor girl stepped in the way of Brouce Boulgoure's hatchet, which he threw thinking she was a giant fern. Lucky she didn't live – she would have died had she found out she looked like a giant fern.

items.name: Tash Ring
items.description: Are you too young to get into the good clubs? Are you nervous around girls? Well, stick this ring on your finger, and hold it in front of your upper lip. It'll add a few years to your age and do wonders for your self-confidence. Just don't go out in strong winds, or it'll blow away, like your quickly evaporating self-esteem.

items.name: Fungal Ring
items.description: If your enemies are allergic to mushrooms, let them nibble your fingers.

items.name: Beddy Bow
items.description: This bow is made from sharp, thin, very flexible slats that are more often used to make beds than deadly weapons. Now they're used to bring on a more permanent sort of sleep.

items.name: Wanderelle
items.description: Originally, blowing hard into this trumpet-shaped fungal wand would call Jon Lemon, the wandering minstrel, to the scene of battle. He'd then begin singing and everyone who hadn't blocked their ears would die on the spot. Since this made it a bit too easy to kill monsters, the gods decided to plug the trumpet and turn it into a relatively harmless wand.

items.name: Mush Mishish Staff
items.description: The three points of this staff attract particles of plasmogrine present in the quadramental breeze. Carefully lick the points of the stick, align them with the hands of an inverted Xelor clock, count to sixty (try six if you're a Iop) and squeeze your buttocks together. You'll have a fifty-fifty chance of being hit by lightning or turning your enemies into grizzly Kirballs.

items.name: Mush Cuteers
items.description: These knives were once used to remove the fungus that infested the feet of adventurers. Removing the fungus actually means removing both feet, just below the knees.

items.name: Canni Blade
items.description: The different blades of this axe can be used to cut sausage very quickly. One blow is sufficient to produce three slices. It's not quite as useful when it comes to killing enemies, unless you're used to eating nothing but sliced food, of course.

items.name: Ta Boots
items.description: These boots are the perfect thing to put on if you want to go for a walk in the woods without crushing any dead leaves. You'll need to be careful, however, as their vegetal origins inevitably drive them to crush anything remotely related to manure.

items.name: Spore Boots
items.description: Contrary to popular misconception, the holes in these shoes are not there to let your feet breathe, but to let the spawn of your foot fungus escape and infect the feet of other footloose adventurers.

items.name: Ragoat
items.description: If there wasn't so much mould on this rag, it would make a great tablecloth. Not to worry, you can always dry the dishes with it when your guests aren't watching.

items.name: Deadly Night Cape
items.description: One more glass for the road? Ah, well, roads are long and nights are short, so this cape is usually used to keep the barflies warm as they finish their endless rounds of night caps. It'll kill them in the end, you know.

items.name: Stringsecticide
items.description: As its name suggests, this string assassinates any flies that get too close to your sweet spots. Just one piece of advice - never, ever pull it off a loved one with your teeth.

items.name: Fungas Belt
items.description: The best way to solve crotch fungus is to lure it elsewhere. As there's no longer room between your toes to accommodate any more fungi, you can use this belt, a truly impressive residence for any fungus worthy of the name.

items.name: Slice of Undergrowth
items.description: Take an Elm, strip the bark off, soak it for a few months in a muddy puddle, cover it with fungal infections, stick it under your bed for a week while you sleep on the floor, basting it regularly with Blop fat. All you need to know to make an Elm belt that stinks. Are you happy now?

items.name: Ougaabelt
items.description:
The tag on this belt says 'Sorry, but if you're looking for a way to get Ougaa's power, this belt is not for you.'
Well that's just great, isn't it.

items.name: Mush Ombrero
items.description: Take a Dora, cover it in Gobball Slobber and Iop sweat, let it stew for a couple of weeks and you'll get an idea of the intoxicating effects of the Mush Ombrero. Try to stay away from heavy machinery while you wear it. In fact, stay away from anything that's heavy.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Ring
items.description: Instead of cutting down on impure Blop juice, Shika Ingalsse pressed on with her harvest through her inebriated state. One day, as she was stumbling and falling through the golden fields, Shika landed on this ring. Whoever said that impure Blop juice should be taken in moderation?

items.name: Morello Cherry Amublop
items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

items.name: Pippin Amublop
items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

items.name: Coco Amublop
items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

items.name: Indigo Amublop
items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Amublop
items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

items.name: Royal Pippin Amublop
items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

items.name: Royal Indigo Amublop
items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Amublop
items.description: They have to put heaps of artificial colourants and flavourings into this amulet to stop it coming out white when it's crafted. A word of advice, it might look great and smell delicious, but don't try to eat it.

items.name: Morello Cherry Bloopts
items.description: Does it make your mouth feel funny when you say the name of this object? Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face-to-face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot... Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad you have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.

Bloo...', you'll be glad to have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.

items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Bloopts
items.description: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

items.name: Royal Pippin Bloopts
items.description: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

items.name: Royal Coco Bloopts
items.description: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

items.name: Royal Indigo Bloopts
items.description: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Bloopts
items.description: Some people let the grass grow under their feet. With these boots, you'll have enough foliage for four weddings and a funeral.

items.name: Morello Cherry Blop Belt
items.description: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious, middle-aged men.

items.name: Pippin Blop Belt
items.description: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

items.name: Coco Blop Belt
items.description: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

items.name: Indigo Blop Belt
items.description: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Blop Belt
items.description: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

items.name: Royal Pippin Blop Belt
items.description: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

items.name: Royal Coco Blop Belt
items.description: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

items.name: Royal Indigo Blop Belt
items.description: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Belt
items.description: If you tighten this belt fully, you can shut down your digestive system completely. Why you would want to do this is another question entirely.

items.name: Day'inda Knife
items.description: Jon Lemon created his last and greatest song as he was being slaughtered by the Bworker and this very blade. Goes a little something like - 'I heard the news today oh boy, Ten thousand holes all over meeeee'. Thank the gods that Bworker had the good sense to jot down the words and music of the ditty.

items.name: Pot-Bellied Bracelet
items.description: The three points of this bracelet represent the three major weaknesses of the Bworker: Thirst for vengeance, thirst for victory and, well, thirst for liquids.

items.name: Nose Ring
items.description: This ring is covered in little bits of nose rubble from the Bworker's shnoz. The dirty creature uses the sharp points to achieve that perfect pick.

items.name: Memori Amulet
items.description: When a certain Captain Chafer met the Bworker for the first time, he took the liberty of saying 'Wow, is that your backside or is it your face?' Nobody has seen the good Captain, or his famous moulded underwear, since. This amulet was created in his memory.

items.name: Chee Cape
items.description: The story goes that the Bworker sewed this cape from Rushu's butt skin. The story would be entirely believable if the Bworker actually knew how to sew.

items.name: Batouta Helmet
items.description: This beautiful helmet holds its fair share of secrets. For many years before it died, it was the Bworker's only companion. While it was still alive, he told it many stories about used protectives. It was having to listen to these atrocities that led to the helmet's death.

items.name: Pierced Boots
items.description: A long, long time ago, Danous Kwaide wanted to be clever and beat the Bworker in a baiting contest: "Your boots are covered with earrings because you're too stupid to realise that you're not supposed to put boots in your ears", he teased. The Bworker replied by crushing Danous' skull with his axe. Do you blame him? Do you even understand what Danous was going on about? No, neither do I.

items.name: Biibl Belt
items.description: This belt is used in the feast of the Dofus eggs which celebrates the gift of the six eggs, as recorded in the Biibl, an ancient text written by a Bontarian Joiner. Most people just paint ordinary eggs to look like Dofus and give them to one another, but some go a bit further, wearing this painful belt for the forty days and nights which precede the feast.

items.name: Flash Gorgon's Belt
items.description: Beyond his love for porcelain vases, there's little we know about Flash Gorgone. One legend says he was always in such a hurry that he could out run a Tofu... He learnt his lesson when he rushed out of bed one morning and tied his belt round his ankles. His porcelain collection still remembers that like it was yesterday.

items.name: Fasstroid Belt
items.description: With this attractive and delicious belt, the bigger your love handles are, the better!

items.name: Tartamulet
items.description: This amulet will remind you of the happy days, the picnic days, the days before you turned into... this.

items.name: Beanie Ring
items.description: If you find yourself stuck with a tasteless beer or coffee, stick this ring in there for a while.

items.name: Beanie Boots
items.description: Look what you've done. Just look. Trying to smash coffee cups with your boots... what were you thinking?

items.name: Pink Tutu
items.description: This pink tutu will be ideal for showing your little behind off at the New Year's festivities. Made of ancestral cotton and stretchy Sponge Mob mousse, soft and comfortable with a swishing skirt, this piece could be the first in a long line of tutus for a future star dancer.

items.name: Mitch Shroom
items.description: This headgear will give Mitcho-class style to anyone who wears it. It does have a strong smell of undergrowth that your friends could do without.

items.name: Royal Bloprown
items.description: For several years this Bloprown was worn by Kuri herself, until the fickle gods of fashion mocked her for her taste in crappy hats and she stuffed it to the back of her wardrobe to gather dust with her Feca-style Wig, Youllbea Mantle, and fluff-covered Consolation Candies.

items.name: Zawooin's Seal
items.description: In the ancient language of the Lenalds, it's name is "Zawooin Ling", which means the cursed seal of the Zawooins.

items.name: Beezers
items.description: The little wings attached to these slippers will give smelly feet some fresh air... But be careful, don't use them to play Gobbowl... Gobballs may not particularly like getting stung on the arse...

items.name: Lousy Ring
items.description: This ring will turn you into a Lousy Pig, which should satisfy your closest friends.

items.name: Lardine Belt
items.description: This little cork-screw shaped tail will bring out the jealousy of the people around you.

items.name: Eastern Wood Belt
items.description: The sling of this belt is tightly tied to it, so tightly tied that you won't be able to take it off. It will only impress highwayboys you'll meet.

items.name: Eastern Wood Boots
items.description: The spurs on these boots will enable you to cut up your Dragoturkey when you decide it's time to eat it.

items.name: Zest Ring
items.description: If your water becomes tasteless, just stick this ring on your finger, stick your finger in the glass and vigorously stir it in until it falls off. There you go! A delicious blood orange and lemon mixture... and one finger less. You can't have it all, you know.

items.name: Crystalline Ring
items.description: This ring will make your finger radiant.

items.name: Crystalline Belt
items.description: With this belt around your hips, no one will ever dare pinch you again for fear of having their fingers cut off.

items.name: Bobblamulet
items.description: This amulet can be used as a bib for both the young and the old.

items.name: Bobblering
items.description: You can wear this ring as a toe ring if you need to snuff out your foot odour.

items.name: The Kim
items.description: The Kimbo is said to wear this wig to pay tribute to a handsome, perfectly tanned young man that he met on his island. What a wonderful smile he had! Anyway, he hides the ridiculous wig under his coco.

items.name: Amunita
items.description: This jewel is so powerful that it'd kill a Moskito from 30 paces, if only its smell didn't prevent anything from getting that close!

items.name: Kralomansion
items.description: This scary amulet was hidden away in a remote mansion for ages. When it was alive, it used to dream of travelling around the World and all the places it would see. In the end, the only place it got to go around is your neck, the poor thing!

items.name: Shovel Emlaka
items.description: This dangerous shovel will steal your Vitality, your youth, the water in your body and your precious Troofles.

items.name: Sword Indinz
items.description: Made from pieces of fungi, this sword is perfect for infecting your enemies' bowels.

items.name: The Godfather's Polished Oxfords
items.description: These shoes are very shiny even when they're worn out. They're perfect for impressing your opponents when they get them right in their faces.

items.name: The Godfather's Ring
items.description: This heavy ring will give more power to your slaps and more passion to your caresses...

items.name: The Godfather's Pants 'n' Suspenders
items.description: The motto of the tailor who made this wonder was "Even in the heart of the action, your pants must always remain up your behind which they will thanks to these high quality flax suspenders". This really isn't a good motto...

items.name: Black Wab Belt
items.description: This belt is reversible and can be worn according to what you wish to hide or show.

items.name: Black Wab Boots
items.description: Made from Black Wabbit backside skin, you'll be able to take your revenge on those nasty little creatures with these butt skin boots, as they'll feel like they're kicking their own butt every time you kick something. It's the simple pleasures that count.

items.name: Armoured Dragoturkey
items.description:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

items.name: The Godfather's Gobtubby
items.description: This Gobtubby seems perfectly normal, other than its wool being black in parts... Give it time and you might be surprised!

items.name: Angora Bow Meow
items.description: This little ball of fur is more resistant to the cold than an ordinary Bow Meow. It's softer to stroke, but it's even more annoying than its short-haired cousin.

items.name: Tiwabbit Wosungwee
items.description: This creature is a little stupid. The only way to make it move forward is to attach a Cawwot and stick to its back. Fortunately, it has been well trained, so it won't be breaking wind in a panic.

items.name: Miniminotot
items.description: This Minimino was brought up by Minotot himself. Unfortunately, the beast's character rubbed off on the innocent creature, along with some nasty body odours from being cuddled.

items.name: Crocodyl
items.description: Don't be fooled: this creature's pointed teeth will end up in your backside one day, that's for sure.

items.name: Black Dragoone
items.description: Take a Pink Dragoone, plunge it into a pot of black dye, throw some gold dust on it, dip it in oil, then water – now you have a Black Dragoone.

items.name: Apprentice Pilgrim Staff
items.description: Certain adventurers whom the gods have chosen may use this staff to aid their neighbours. What a noble quest you have before you!

items.name: Alowa Sandals
items.description: The soles of these sandals are thicker than regular sandals to make sure they'll resist the weight of the heavier Alowas.

items.name: Slump Rollers
items.description: These roller skates make it easier to go down stairs but considerably increase the risk of you breaking a few bones. It's up to you to take that risk.

items.name: Alowa Amulet
items.description: This amulet is a mere flower necklace. It's supposed to give off a magic smell and transform an Alowa into an Alowaian...

items.name: Slump Necklace
items.description: Erala wore this amulet for her entire childhood. No one knows what's inside it, not even her.

items.name: Slait Ring
items.description: Adventurers like to collect this kind of rings but no one really knows why.

items.name: Slait Boots
items.description: Slait can now walk on his new wooden floors without scratching them.

items.name: Rushu's Shushu
items.description: This minor demon fresh out of the Shustuft Crust will accompany you everywhere you roam, from the Astrub Zaap to the cemetery, and maybe even from the cemetery to the Astrub Zaap. Like all its peers, and like you, it has a single obsessions: destroying everything until nothing remains.

items.name: Owl Ring
items.description: Take on the appearance of an owl.

items.name: Slamdance Bracelet
items.description: They say this bracelet is shiny, but only when you're in an inn or in the middle of the night.

items.name: Slamdance Belt
items.description: This belt has an incredibly powerful built-in magnet that keeps it shut without a buckle. Not recommended for wear with lead undergarments.

items.name: Slamdance Shoes
items.description: The headspinners among you will have very little use for these shoes, but if you use your feet from time to time, they're just what you need.

items.name: Bedazzling Fist
items.description: This ring is closer to a glove or a mitten than a wedding ring, but who cares, no one will ever shake your hand the same way again.

items.name: Bedazzling Boots
items.description: If you wear these boots when climbing Mount Jifu, you're almost guaranteed to see strange UFO flying across the sky.

items.name: Siks Wonn Ein Boots
items.description: These boots take approximately 12 hours to tie up and slightly longer to get off. That gives you just enough time to get some sleep every day or so, so long as you're single, unemployed, and very good with your hands.

items.name: Siks Wonn Ein Belt
items.description: The Achilles heel isn't always below the knees, you know. Sometimes it's just below the waist. In that case, this heavy but effective belt will give all those wieners among you peace of mind and sackfulls of confidence.

items.name: Ring of Death
items.description: This ring is also known as the Black Band, but in spite of its two names, it remains unfinished. Even so, it's powerful enough to destroy a small planet.

items.name: Pair o'Shuplins
items.description: These shoes are rumoured to have been eaten by a starved gold miner only to be stitched back together when they came out the other end. That must be why they're so shiny.

items.name: The Chavate
items.description: This charm is an amulet and a cravat in one, and it'll give you the air of a gentleman even when you're down and out.

items.name: Hurrian Hammer
items.description: This stone hammer was invented to lure smiths into believing that they were holding a hammer of excellent quality. It is strongly advised that you do not touch it, better still, do absolutely nothing with it at all.

items.name: Scratcher Smith's Hammer
items.description: This hammer, to be used in a forge, was created for a specific purpose, which makes it difficult to use for anything else. Only someone desperate or on the margins of society would use it to make weapons.

items.name: Handle Slasher
items.description: This slasher is for slashing handles, not candles. You can dangle a candle on your sandals, you vandal, but the scandal would be too much for Randall to handle. And no, I don't know who Randall is, either.

items.name: Vampyre Ring
items.description: This ring spent three years in a pool of Borbat guano. It's still magic, though.

items.name: Vampyre Amulet
items.description: This amulet is supposed to stop vampyres sucking your blood. The idea is that they're meant to believe you're a vampyre too.

items.name: Vampyre Belt
items.description: This belt not only glows in the dark, it also glows in the light, although it's hard to be sure.

items.name: Vampyre Cape
items.description: Bram was right after all: you should watch out for grown men who prance around with make-up and long, flowing capes.

items.name: Vampyre Boots
items.description: They say that Countess Bathory herself used to wear these boots. Knowing her, they should be nice and soft... just hope there aren't too many pimples on them.

items.name: Vampyre Mask
items.description: If nothing else, this mask will protect you from the sun.

items.name: Vampyrina
items.description: This creature with a wan complexion will take cruel pleasure in sucking the blood of your friends, and even take a nip out of you if you need taking down a peg. What it likes most, however, is when you fight horrible monsters so it can bleed them dry. You're therefore going to have to spend all your time fighting... Poor you, how terrible.

items.name: Borbat
items.description: This pet had a long, hard childhood, which was not made any easier by its frankly stupid name. Maybe that explains its volatile temper and uneven temperament... It's quite taken with you, since it sees those same "qualities" in you. It follows you everywhere, determined to haunt the World of Twelve at your side.

items.name: Amlugo
items.description: This amulet is meant to protect you from random beheadings, but it increases your chances of dying from a random hanging.

items.name: Slugo
items.description: These slippers are more comfortable than your average footwear, but it's hard to say why... perhaps the parasites that infest them massage your feet.

items.name: Belugo
items.description: This belt was made using the leftovers from spools of Flax String. It ties up rubbish bags too.

items.name: Trophy Dark Vlad Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Moon Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Soft Oak Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Dragon Pig Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Minotoror Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Kimbo Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Wa Wabbit Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Koolich Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Sphincter Cell Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Trophy Bworker Shield
items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

items.name: Chisp Boots
items.description: Ponch polished his boots every morning before mounting his Dragoturkey and leaving on missions to save widows and orphans. Especially widows. Ponch was quite the charmer.

items.name: Chisp Fingerless Gloves
items.description: These fingerless leather gloves are perfect for rainbow coalitions of dancing.

items.name: Slugly Amulet
items.description: This amulet will feed a vorpal slug for two days, or three days if it accompanied by a puree of your head.

items.name: Slugly Boots
items.description: The soles of these boots are covered with a sticky slime and the interior is filled with a slippery slime. Or maybe it's the other way round.

items.name: The Esteban
items.description: This medallion acts as the key to a mysterious, forgotten city.

items.name: Solaris Ring
items.description: This ring was found in a mysterious city where nobody knew of its existence until they began frantically searching for it.

items.name: Noke's Necklace
items.description: This boar-tooth necklace will terrify boars, and by extension, your mother-in-law.

items.name: Oxo Ring
items.description: This ring used to belong to the Oxon King. He liked to play with the sunbeams reflecting on the ring and used to say "Watch out for the Oxon Laser!'"

items.name: Oxo Boots
items.description: Don't forget to put these boots on when you have your heads in the clouds, they'll keep you high. Even though they're cool, don't wear them to go dancing if you want to keep your feet on the ground.

items.name: Oxo Belt
items.description: This belt is perfect when you need to rest and digest your granny's Oxo Bucco.

items.name: Dontase Mebro Shovel
items.description: This shovel is primarily intended for medical use, despite being used very controversially by the Enutrof known as Resat as a weapon of self defence.

items.name: The Maidartes
items.description: These boots belonged to the unforgettable Maidarte, a misunderstood genius who specialised in infinite loops and recursion. Nobody really understood what he was explaining nor why he or continually repeated the same stories. Just as the surf crashes against the rocky shoreline, so have his diatribes become a part of the landscape, forever colliding with the obstacle of common sense.

items.name: Jellufo
items.description: Trained by its former master to eat only monsters living near Cania Lake, this creature from elsewhere eventually diversified its diet. However, its breath still reeks of blops.

items.name: Real Gobbly Glove
items.description: This battered old glove helps you catch Gobbowl balls, or any other round thing covered in wool, for that matter. What you do with it as result concerns you, and you only...

items.name: Lamechester United Glove
items.description: With this glove on your hand, you can pretend you're a famous Gobbowl player when you're playing fetch with your Bow Wow.

items.name: Toot's Belt
items.description: Gobbowl matches are brutal, and this belt was designed to protect players from muscular blows. However, you can also use it as a life-belt when you're taking a bath. Who'd have thought?

items.name: Monty's Belt
items.description: They say that Gobbowl is a game for real men. This belt's for real men too, with plenty of protective padding to soften low blows. It's also great for training young Srams.

items.name: Real Gobbly Boots
items.description: These boots have been around for a while, you can certainly smell that. Plant them on your feet and you'll look just like a real Gobbowl player. Plant their crampons in the rump of a few Gobblies, and the fans will come flocking.

items.name: Lamechester United Boots
items.description: "Fashionable footwear feeds fascinated fan's frenzy", reads the latest headline, and for once, the papers aren't wrong. When properly polished, these boots help make it look like your opponent pushed you over, when in fact, you slipped. Congratulations! You've just learnt one of the basics of Gobbowl.

items.name: Grute's Amulet
items.description: Grute the Bwork wasn't very clever. He was even stupid as stupid can be. For years, his companion tried to fill his head with something other than beer – to no avail. Grute stayed just as dim-witted, just with no froth on top.

items.name: Grute's Belt
items.description: Those who have had to face Grute the Bwork will tell you, "Don't bother aiming for the head, it's empty". This advice also applies to all those who face Iops, Goblins or mothers-in-law.

items.name: Grute's Boots
items.description: Grute's Boots give off such a pungent aroma that you'll be able to knock your opponents out with one quick kick to their head. These boots were forbidden in combat situations by the Sufokia Convention a long time ago, a convention which, it has to be said, has saved many, many lives.

items.name: Koksiks's Ring
items.description: Koksiks's had many rather questionable preferences, such as dipping vinegar crisps in chocolate spread or – shudder – eating bow meow fur. Many went far in their efforts to get him to see the error of his ways, and got lost on their way back.

items.name: Koksiks's Boots
items.description: There's nothing noisier than the tap-tapping of bones on an elm coffin. You should have seen Koksiks going at it in these soft boots. A sight to behold he was. Dancing. Dancing as if no one was listening – not his neighbours, not the dead, and especially not his dead neighbours.

items.name: Koksiks's Belt
items.description: Koksiks had two dreams in life: climb Crackler Mountain and become a minstrel. Life was very cruel to him, because all he ever accomplished before he died was being the opening act for Jon Lemon concerts. Sometimes, life throws you lemons. In Koksiks's case, it threw crates of lemons.

items.name: Goboff's Amulet
items.description: A popular saying amongst those of the mauve persuasion is: "Sometimes you hit the bar, sometimes the bar hits you."

items.name: Goboff's Belt
items.description: Goboff the Goblin loved to gobble very rotten eggs. While his digestive tract was able to deal with this atrocious habit easily, those who came within whiffing distance of his foul breath would drop like mooflies. Those unlucky enough not to be rendered unconscious immediately would grab onto this belt to stop themselves hitting the floor.

items.name: Goboff's Ring
items.description: Goboff was a keen gardener. He loved nothing more than whacking trespassers around the head with his rake. He found this ring on the finger of an impudent rambler who'd dared to trample his babbage leaves.

items.name: Lektor's Amulet
items.description: When the two small balls attached to this amulet collide, they produce a slight rattling noise, which means a Kanniball is very close by. When you hear this noise, it is usually too late to escape, but there is still time to choose which sauce you want to be devoured with.

items.name: Lektor's Ring
items.description: The ring is infused with secret spices, used for flavouring broth when stirred by hand. The spices are so good that once you put the ring on, there's a real risk you'll bite your own fingers off, they'll be that tasty.

items.name: Lektor's Boots
items.description: Kanniball Lektor wore these boots for several years before trading them in for a tourist on Moon Island. Look, he was hungry, alright?

items.name: Stroy Zemol's Amulet
items.description: Stroy Zemol had a sister, Faye Pworme. She liked travelling alone and exploring dark, foul-smelling tunnels.

items.name: Stroy Zemol's Belt
items.description: This belt is allegedly reversible, only no one's ever dared try it as they don't want to be the first to discover that it isn't actually reversible.

items.name: Stroy Zemol's Boots
items.description: Stroy Zemol made these boots himself, from a few blocks of wood and a little bit of fabric. They might not look like other boots, but blimey, they're certainly magical nevertheless.

items.name: Fyred Ampe's Ring
items.description: When it comes into contact with warm, sticky liquids, this ring changes colour, which explains why Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner loved it so much.

items.name: Fyred Ampe's Boots
items.description: The soles of these magic boots allow you to shatter lumps of coal by vibrating at its resonant frequency (look it up). The user guide indicates that they will even vibrate on their own when Slamdance music is played nearby.

items.name: Fyred Ampe's Belt
items.description: This belt, reinforced with several different metals, was strong enough to support the weight of Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner's enormous sack. Don't worry, though, it should be just as useful for tiny packets too.

items.name: Ogrine Seeker
items.description: This strange pet is a cross of the best truffle hunters in all Amakna. Its massive snout lets it sniff out ogrines, even ones hidden underwater. It seems Otomai took several years to create this species, and it's said that he's using it to try and find something he lost or a creature he let escape. Only he knows the full story...

items.name: Haks Or Mask
items.description: Equipped with this golden helmet, your head will soon be up for auction and worth its weight in gold.

items.name: Haks Or Cloak
items.description: This fabric cloak, coated with a thin layer of gold, is magical. It attracts attention and reflects light directly into the pupils of dishonest types who try to stab you from behind. Essential if you have Sram friends.

items.name: Haks Or Ring
items.description: This ring is so heavy that it greatly increases the inertia of your fist when you distribute blows to your opponents. When you begin punishing peasants, it will be virtually impossible to stop you.

items.name: Haks Or Belt
items.description: This belt is perfect to hang your gold bars around your waist, they'll pass unnoticed.

items.name: Intrepid Amulet
items.description: No one has a clue what powers this amulet brings, but everyone knows what it takes away: your credibility.

items.name: Intrepid Ring
items.description: You've heard of the game "Pick it, lick it, roll it, flick it", right? Well this ring will protect you from the flicked stuff.

items.name: Intrepid Boots
items.description: Warm on the inside and cold on the outside, these boots will let you kick snowmen's arses without melting their pert little buttocks.

items.name: Exuberant Sword
items.description: Unsheathed from its scabbard, this sword can cut ham, Enutrofs, one-legged men, dancers and one-legged, Enutrof dancers wrapped in a slice of ham. Sadly though, it's useless for killing monsters.

items.name: Intrepid Shield
items.description: This shield won't protect you from your own stupidity.

items.name: Intrepid Belt
items.description: Having problems hiding your dagger in your underwear? No problem, you can wedge it between your love handles and this belt.

items.name: Intrepid Cloak
items.description: You'll be able to fly with this cape around your shoulders. Just close your eyes, clench your fists, open your mouth, stretch out your arms and jump off a cliff shouting "I can fly!". Moments later, you'll wake up with two broken legs.

items.name: Intrepid Hat
items.description: This shoddy hat admirably hides your baldness. Unfortunately, it's not big enough to hide your false modesty.

items.name: Golden Dragoone
items.description: More golden than a Black Dragoone, less pink than a Pink Dragoone, and rarer than a Skeleton Dragoone, this pet will draw all eyes towards you, even if you're as ugly as a Piwi.

items.name: Initiate's Axe
items.description: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

items.name: Gobbowl Helmet
items.description: They say sticks and stones may break your bones, but names will never hurt you. With this helmet on, you'll certainly challenge that misconception...

items.name: Phishing Rod
items.description: Having a dispute over money? Thanks to this rod, there'll only be one winner: you!

items.name: Banana Cape
items.description: Is that a Banana Cape in your pocket or are you just pleased to see me?

items.name: Barking M'hat
items.description: It doesn't take much to make you look like an Ouginak. Watch out for fleas.

items.name: Gobbamu
items.description: You wear this amulet proudly, as a symbol of your participation in this great sporting event. You need it to stay proud having been through a scrum with B.C. Trool.

items.name: Phero-Cape
items.description: Driven into a strange frenzy, any Tofus that you meet will want to rub up against your leg. Are you sure it's the cape that attracts them?

items.name: Hulkrap's Boots
items.description: Hulkrap slipped these comfortable boots on to his ample feet once a year, but he took them off every day, which suggests they might be magic.

items.name: Klume's Boots
items.description: These boots can also be used as anvils. Their former owner urges you not to dance while wearing them.

items.name: Hulkrap's Belt
items.description: This belt is constructed around a magnetic metal frame which attracts the purses of those careless enough to rub up against you.

items.name: Klume's Belt
items.description: Klume had three weaknesses: Arachnees, being tickled, and tickly Arachnees.

items.name: Kloug's Belt
items.description: This belt is still covered in flour, perhaps because Kloug the Dark Baker wore it as an apron. Mind you, it might not be flour; it could be the powder he uses to soothe his embarrassing rash.

items.name: Hulkrap's Amulet
items.description: Hulkrap stole this amulet from Ted Gonztipay, an anally retentive goblin with absolutely no sense of humour whatsoever.

items.name: Kloug's Amulet
items.description: This amulet allows you to knead the skin on your neck without using your hands.

items.name: Klume's Ring
items.description: Gontran Klume the smith traded a sword belonging to Dame Antium for this ring.

items.name: Kloug's Ring
items.description: This ring has been dipped in a multitude of different yeasts. It is said that it is capable of transforming those who wear it into mould. Some adventurers don't see any difference after slipping it on.

items.name: Tarzantula
items.description: This Arachnee is very badly behaved: it jumps around, screams all the time, and bites anyone it meets... but for some reason you still love it.

items.name: Smush
items.description: This unique Mush Mush was raised by a pack of Boowolves, which still doesn't explain why it has such hairy armpits.

items.name: Tofrazzle
items.description: This Tofu was struck by lightning 11 times while still growing. It'll give you an electric shock if you stroke it, and it'll shock you with electricity if you don't stroke it. The choice is yours.

items.name: Sting
items.description: This pet loves artichoke hearts smothered in Bherb blood, endives with Pikoko hair, and Jon Lemon's songs. It seems to enjoy your company as well.

items.name: Grofus
items.description: Well, there you are. You did it: you took part in the greatest dragonic birth-control exercise ever. As a result, you're going to have to eat omelette for weeks to come.

items.name: The Black Crow's Ring
items.description: There's nothing unusual about a bird being ringed!

items.name: The Black Crow's Boots
items.description: Like the rest of the Black Crow set, this pair of boots has been passed down, foot to foot, through the generations. That explains the strong smell of Clakoss.

items.name: Plunder's Boots
items.description: The soles of these boots are so spongy that they absorb sewer sludge and release it each time you place your foot on the ground. As you can imagine, it's quite handy if you ever need to retrace your steps.

items.name: Plunder's Belt
items.description: Plunder hung his booty from this belt. You can make out a small valve on the inside. This valve allows the belt to be inflated, transforming it into a buoy. An essential item when venturing into the sewers.

items.name: Plunder's Amulet
items.description: This amulet was specially designed not to get stuck in Plunder's neck hairs, so you can wear it without fear under your armpit or even keep it in your hand.

items.name: Cheeky Bag
items.description: With this bag slung at a jaunty angle over your shoulder, you'll be able to muck about while still keeping that charming smile on your face, you cheeky little monkey!

items.name: Phong Huss's Ring
items.description: Fungi generally have collars. Phong Huss, however, preferred rings. We assume this was so that he could boast about having fingers.

items.name: Phong Huss's Belt
items.description: Phong Huss wore this belt across his body so he could sheath his sword in it. The belt pinched his nipples on multiple occasions, but that's the price to pay when you want to pull your sword with class.

items.name: Phong Huss's Boots
items.description: The feet of fungi are rarely very clean - they are often covered with mycelium. Phong Huss's feet were no exception to this rule and he took care to hide them with his boots. They don't smell particularly good, but they are well suited for growing mushrooms. Which of your stomach or your nose will win?

items.name: Ektope's Amulet
items.description: A ghost's amulet must be extremely powerful, given that it glows in the dark.

items.name: Ektope's Ring
items.description: It's a well-known fact that real ghosts don't have fingers. So how are they able to wear rings? That seems completely irrational. A bit like you, actually.

items.name: Ektope's Belt
items.description: Captain Haddock'n'roll once stumbled into Ektope on his way home from a drinking contest at the Ripate Inn. "Ectoplasm on skates!" he exclaimed. Poor Captain Haddock'n'roll, his tipsy mind was playing tricks on him: Ektope has never had any skates.

items.name: Snow Bow Meow
items.description: This bow meow has known the winter of the far north, even if it has never actually seen the far north. Nobody knows how it arrived in Amakna, although the elders claim that it was imported from Frigost Island to counter the tragic shortage of ice cubes for use in drinks.

items.name: Frost Belt
items.description: This belt cools the hips, nearby organs, and ardour of all who dare wear it. The perfect gift for your most stubborn suitors.

items.name: Frost Boots
items.description: Heavy and stiff, these boots don't look particularly special, but their icy sole will have you ice-skating without the need for ice. Of course, you'll need to find a surface covered with ice-skate blades, but in these crazy times, that shouldn't be too difficult.

items.name: Brindled Minifoux
items.description: Crazier than a regular Minifoux but much less ginger, this pet can swim underwater without needing to plug its nose.

items.name: Brindled Bow Wow
items.description: This pet may have stripes, but that won't stop it from sniffing your bottom or trying to relieve itself on your carpet. What did you expect?

items.name: Black Quaquack
items.description: This ugly little Black Quaquack was rejected by its own family because it was different: it loved listening to the songs of Jon Lemon, the famous minstrel. Maybe it was just misunderstood.

items.name: Stone-washed Borbat
items.description: This pet stayed out too long in acid rain. It doesn't glow in the dark, nor is it magical, but you can make a very potent salad dressing from it.

items.name: Gupin
items.description: This strange creature crossed the oceans on a block of ice to escape from a lost port. It looks like it's taken you for a block of ice.

items.name: Doggona Rope
items.description: This belt was given to Goultard by his father for his 5th birthday. It is more solid than its appearance suggests, and will keep your trousers snugly around your hips. It can also be used as a washing line, or even a skipping rope.

items.name: Clementine Amulet
items.description: If you dip this amulet into your glass, your tasteless water will be transformed into a delicious, citrus-flavoured beverage.

items.name: Clementine Boots
items.description: The soles of these boots are made from the tough skin of fruit harvested on an island whose very existence remains unknown to mere mortals.

items.name: Pynekone Belt
items.description: This belt is composed of scales arranged spirally in accordance with the Vibronacci suite.

items.name: Pynekone Ring
items.description: Who were you hoping to seduce with a ring like this?

items.name: Lonne's Boots
items.description: This versatile pair of boots guarantees full freedom of movement. That's why Lonne Jenone wears them when he dances with Boowolves.

items.name: Gobbowl Boots
items.description: These boots were specially designed to destroy your opponents' shin pads, and then their shins, and then your own toes.

items.name: Gobbowl Ring
items.description: You can use this ring to puncture the Gobbowl Ball when you want to quietly enjoy a break in play.

items.name: Gadjet's Belt
items.description: If you wear this belt upside down and press on it hard enough, you may be able to activate its integrated retromagic module. It has never worked, but you can activate it anyway. Then you can then sell it on to someone even more naive than you.

items.name: Gadjet's Ring
items.description: Worn by several generations of handymen, this ring will protect your knuckle from hammer blows. Unfortunately, it is never sold in packs of five.

items.name: Grillian's Boots
items.description: Grillian the magician traded a magic ring for this pair of boots. It seems that he lost out on the deal, as they aren't even padded.

items.name: Grillian's Amulet
items.description:
Grillian wore this amulet around his neck when... when... 
Oh, what does it matter? He died and now this amulet is yours.

items.name: Improved Quaquack
items.description: In levels of sheer idiocy, the Tofu, the Gobball and even the Iop can't hold a candle to the Quaquack.

items.name: Efferves Sword
items.description: The following text is engraved on the pommel: "This sword steals life from the poor and gives it to the rich." Too bad you're poor.

items.name: Rapiat's Boots
items.description: Rapiat manufactured these boots himself, without it costing him a kama. The same can't be said of two of his fellows, for who it cost their lives.

items.name: Rapiat's Belt
items.description: To this belt's great misfortune, Rapiat's only guilty pleasure were the breads of Danioul Garnioul the Baker. He was actually the only one to continue eating them after learning they were kneaded with the feet, saying that was what gave them their unique aftertaste.

items.name: Rapiat's Amulet
items.description: This beautiful amber amulet actually seems to be made of a much less noble material, which explains its foul odour and its low price. But it's the result that counts, right?

items.name: Ougicle's Ring
items.description: This ring helped Ougicle to stop biting his claws. To this day, it still glistens with slobber.

items.name: Ougicle's Belt
items.description: In his youth, Ougicle wore his belt as a loincloth, with no trousers. He stopped the day he realised why people were laughing at him when he turned away from them.

items.name: Ougicle's Amulet
items.description: Ougicle especially liked his gold necklace: it amplified his cries so much that the ground around him vibrated. Very handy for flushing out Kolerats.

items.name: Kawotz's Ring
items.description: The dark Cawwot that adorns Kawotz's ring isn't magic, and it's certainly not evil, it's just the same age as him.

items.name: Kawotz's Amulet
