items.name: Isolation Helmet
items.description: Deks has assured you that this helmet will allow you to resist the Resonance Crystals' influence. You hope it's effective: if you're going to look this ridiculous, it had better not be for nought.

items.name: Crabtun Necklace
items.description: Making a necklace out of a Crabtun Lantern is rather daring: the light might attract a certain type of person, and your skull probably isn't strong enough to deal with it like a Crabtun does.

items.name: Crustic Ring
items.description: This robust ring will leave quite an impression on anybody you hit with it.

items.name: Koutoulou Mask
items.description: Furious insanity, masked madness, monstrous hallucinations... Some things would be better left in the abyss.

items.name: Hungry Pendant
items.description: Having a trashcan within arm's reach to throw away anything you like seems interesting, and this pendant could effectively fill that role. However, it gets heavier with each item ingested, so you'll have to work out your neck to keep wearing it.

items.name: Merdiodon Cloak
items.description: This cape sucks up water to inflate itself and thusly regains the shape of a globe-fish.

items.name: Unnamable Boots
items.description: Finding a name for these boots is really hard. So their name goes without saying.

items.name: Spookkoth Amulet
items.description:
This amulet represents a simplified version of a Spookkoth. Not that you needed to be reminded of their appearance – you're not likely to forget any time soon.
P.S.: The necklace is elastic.

items.name: Mantaze Cloak
items.description: Don't Mantaze me, bro!

items.name: Ockloth
items.description: You might start to wonder why this loincloth has tentacles – don't ask questions you don't want to know the answers to.

items.name: Tritun Palms
items.description: Underwater, these palms will make you feel like a fish in the water.

items.name: Indescribable Cape
items.description:
It's an interesting experiment, trying to come up with a description for an indescribable item. Some would opt for the easy and economic solution of not describing the item at all. But we're better than that. If a wall of text must be written, so be it! Here we go. 
There's a lot that you can say about what it means to be indescribable. It could have several meanings. It might mean that we don't have the right words to describe the thing in question, because it's completely unprecedented, because it's unlike anything we've ever known, or maybe also because we don't have the lexical knowledge necessary to choose the right words that will best express the indescribable nature of the thing. So we hide all this uncertainty behind phrases like, "You see?! It's indescribable!", said with deep conviction. But is that really the end of the story? 
If we search deep inside, maybe an exact and appropriate description will reveal itself. Something sufficiently clear, and at the time sufficiently abstract to facilitate understanding of the described thing. If the words aren't sufficient, maybe it's necessary to invent new ones? Words coming from the heart. Words which speak for themselves when the limits of language have been reached. The indescribable, in the end, is actually an unknown, which requires only that we put forth the effort to understand it, to let your imagination, your reason, and your feelings intermingle in order to better understand and therefore find the words that could describe it.
But that would be too much work for a simple cape description.

items.name: Menobelt
items.description: This belt didn't belong to Meno – it was used to mark his prisoners.

items.name: Bitrydent
items.description: Formed from Tryde Tridents, this staff is used for fishing.

items.name: Strange Wand
items.description: Disquieting to look at, this wand will sow doubt in the minds of your opponents.

items.name: Koutoulou Bow
items.description: The second in a long line of bows where an eye replaces the cord. Nobody really understands how it works, but it seems as if the arrows it fires come from another dimension.

items.name: Shorpoon
items.description: For those passionate about underwater treasure who just can't stop themselves from digging up every possible spot in the hopes of finding something, this shovel-harpoon will help you defend yourself if you happen to accidentally unearth an unfriendly crustacean.

items.name: Mantax
items.description: Blessed with the natural abilities of a Mantaze, this axe uses electricity to augment its abilities.

items.name: Terrord
items.description: This sword strikes straight at the soul of your enemies.

items.name: Daguanos
items.description: When they hit their target, these daggers let out a viscous and disquieting liquid, as if they were sucking it out of their victim's body.

items.name: Hammerture
items.description: This hammer was created to cause suffering. First, visually, with its appearance. It also generates sounds imitating a cheap plastic flute, which makes your ears suffer. And, of course, it can generate massive physical damage.

items.name: Sashucker
items.description: With a Sashucker equipped, you'll be ready to scale any wall. No need to hang on – you just need to press your adhesive hips against it. It also works on other living beings, but it's generally viewed as harassment.

items.name: Tentashoes
items.description: Quite practical for walking underwater, these shoes will stick you to the ground, so long as you don't lift both feet.

items.name: Octat
items.description: Not as popular as Pol the Octopus's Hat, the Octat doesn't give the gift of clairvoyance. But it's sure stylish.

items.name: Meno Boots
items.description: Why decide between pinching and kicking when you can do both at the same time?

items.name: Meno Cap
items.description: This hat, which comes with a respirator mask, will give you the genuine look of a genuine captain of a genuine sunken submarine.

items.name: Meno Cape
items.description: Although some might believe that the symbol on this cape indicates that a powerful sorcerer took possession of it, it's really just Meno's insignia.

items.name: Amulet of the Unspeakable
items.description: What is unspeakable cannot be said.

items.name: Belt of the Unspeakable
items.description: What is unspeakable cannot be said.

items.name: Boots of the Unspeakable
items.description: What is unspeakable cannot be said.

items.name: Tritun Ring
items.description: This very elegant ring is the perfect engagement ring. For Trituns.

items.name: Tritun Boots
items.description: If you ignore their colour, these boots are perfect for getting around underwater: they're impermeable and assist in swimming.

items.name: Tritun Mask
items.description: This mask won't let you pass for a Tritun, sadly. But it will let you breathe underwater, so it's got that going for it, which is nice.

items.name: Luminescent Amulet
items.description: Two eyes are better than none, and two extra eyes are even better. They'll make you look serious. Or annoyed. Or thoughtful.

items.name: Luminescent Belt
items.description: This belt sticks its tongue out when it's too tight. So it will also let you know when it becomes time to do a sit-up or two.

items.name: Luminescent Cloak
items.description: Wearing a Yoloinist Crab shell is very dangerous: they have a tendency to pinch similar things with all their strength to test them.

items.name: Cute Koutoulou Pendant
items.description: This is the pendant you give to your loved ones to reassure them, and keep them from knowing the true nature of Koutoulou.

items.name: Cycloptic Helmet
items.description: This helmet will give you a look that's completely normal and acceptable – for a lunatic.

items.name: Horrifing
items.description: This ring constantly biting into your finger will remind you not to make stupid decisions. Like wearing this ring.

items.name: Abyssal Dofus
items.description: According to official sources, this unusual-looking Dofus is a creation of the Foggernauts of Sufokia: it can therefore be concluded that it is not a real dragon egg. Well, that's what the authorities would like us to believe... Anyway, who really knows what's hiding in the abysses?

effects.formatted: At the start of each turn, if there are no enemies in close combat, gives 1 MP. Otherwise, gives 1 AP.

items.name: Skrot
items.description: A ridiculous giant Borbat, the Skrot is an unfailingly faithful mount. Its love for you will manifest itself in many ways: sometimes it will lick you from head to toe, and it won't hesitate to swallow and suck on the former! Never has such an affectionate animal been seen, so long as it doesn't take you for its next snack...

items.name: Transparent Hat
items.description: This hat is invisible in the dark, in the same way that light is.

items.name: Transparent Cloak
items.description: This cloak is invisible in the dark, in the same way that light is.

items.name: Brambelt
items.description: As the swimsuit version was too risky, you opted for this belt to force you to keep an eye on your waistline, and thus keep a flat stomach.

items.name: Bramulet
items.description: Created by a witch of questionable morals, this amulet can tighten on command. Weirdly, the witch was never short of volunteers to wear it.

items.name: Blessed Water Diviner Wand
items.description: The wand points towards the north of the Castuc Territory.

items.name: Lightning Spud
items.description: A tool of advanced technology which should allow you to confront a storm.

items.name: Gan Green Gloves
items.description: These gloves are disposable after use, due to their side effects on the skin, caused by the synthetic material they're made from.

items.name: Water Diviner Wand
items.description: You just need to bless this wand, then go off in search of Nonexistent Water.

items.name: Ourobubble Cape
items.description: If you're looking for a way to camouflage yourself in the desert, this cape could prove useful.

items.name: Ourobubble Ring
items.description: This ring suddenly starts to shine in extreme heat, which can warn you about dramatic incidents if ever you don't realise on your own.

items.name: Ourobubble Boots
items.description: Essential for walking on the hot sand without damaging the arch of your foot, these boots will also prevent you from sinking into quicksand.

items.name: Desert Cape
items.description: If fur isn't necessarily the most highly recommended clothing for an arid environment, Fennex fur actually protects you from external heat.

items.name: Fennexeadgear
items.description: Using Fennex tails to make quilts... that's right.

items.name: Leopena G-String
items.description: "But it's hot!" – at least you have that excuse.

items.name: Mantiscore Axe
items.description: The objective here is not to slice; a mere pinprick is already dangerous enough.

items.name: Spykbal Mace
items.description: Sometimes, there's no point in being subtle.

items.name: Capetuc
items.description: This cape can by equipped in two ways: one being recommended for anyone who isn't a Sacrier.

items.name: Capstuc
items.description: One might be tempted to knock you on the head, given the shape of this helmet... that's where the thorns come in handy.

items.name: Beltuc
items.description: Wearing this belt isn't easy – nor is removing it.

items.name: El Piko Sombrero
items.description: Who's never dreamed wearing this type of sombrero, at least for a few seconds?

items.name: El Piko Ring
items.description: It's better to have small fingers for this ring to be comfortable, even if abrupt gestures aren't advised.

items.name: El Piko Amulet
items.description: This lucky cactus lives off the water in your body.

items.name: Castuc Daggers
items.description: This daggers cut, prick, tear and stun. You just have the predicament of choosing.

items.name: Maracassabre
items.description: Are you a musician at heart? This sabre will add a sound atmosphere to your choreography of combat.

items.name: The Dorado
items.description:
In bright weather, this headset will blind your opponents by reflecting the sun's rays.
In cloudy weather, it'll blind them all the same, because that's how this bright gold works.

items.name: Welt
items.description: This belt won't be enough to turn you into a brave little tailor capable of defeating seven giant Moskitos in one fell swoop, nor will it allow you to capture Unikrons.

items.name: Woolensocks
items.description: With your little feet protected from the cold, you're now ready to face the long winter evenings slouched in front of the fireplace.

items.name: Hatlouse
items.description: Once this hat is on your head, its fangs sink into your flesh to prevent it from flying off at the slightest gust of wind. You don't care that it's sucking up your cerebral matter, since it was of no use to you anyway.

items.name: Beltrus
items.description: Its appearance makes it more effective for fending off suitors than a chastity belt.

items.name: Fanglace
items.description: The merchant who sold you this necklace assured you it was harmless. Yet, you have the unpleasant sensation that it's about to stick its fangs into your neck at any moment.

items.name: Sharshoes
items.description: Nicknamed the jaws of the sands, these boots are worn only by the boldest nomads and Iops.

items.name: Capleworm
items.description: This cape is still alive and ready to bite anyone who dares caress it, which makes it very popular among celebrities who hate mingling with the crowds.

items.name: Wurmring
items.description: Because this ring is permeated with the personality of the Wurmlord, it pushes its owner to wear it in other places than on a finger.

items.name: Tal Kasha Nemes
items.description: Monday in the sun is something people around you will never see, because they'll be so dazzled by the brilliance of your headgear.

items.name: Tal Kasha Head of Hair
items.description: Ambitious Enutrofs have led great conquests with the sole purpose of getting a head of hair as thick as this.

items.name: Tal Kasha Sandals
items.description: Tal Kasha couldn't stand people walking on her feet, which is why her sandals have evolved to look like this.

items.name: Mumystiboots
items.description: These boots are designed to produce a metallic rattling noise with every step. The shrill sound that results from walking on the stone floor of the pyramid is amplified by the resonance of the vast corridors. This leads us to believe that like Astrubians, Mumystics like to be the centre of attention.

items.name: Mumysring
items.description: Legend gives this ring strange powers, like the ability to turn on itself without intervention from its wearer.

items.name: Mumystorque
items.description: This solid gold torque is essentially used to flaunt one's wealth to everyone.

items.name: Moum-Ra's Hood
items.description: Since he's getting senile with old age, Moum-Ra regularly loses his hood, which forces him to steal them from other Mumystics.

items.name: Ankhape
items.description: According a recent study, the symbol on this cape is a one-legged gnome with his arms spread wide.

items.name: Sneerena Loincloth
items.description: Anyone who has already faced a Sneerena knows that this loincloth delineates the healthy part from the atrophied part of the monster. Since you wear it around your waist, everyone knows what to expect.

items.name: Ringaeus
items.description: This snake's garnet eyes can hypnotise an Enutrof for hours on end.

items.name: Pyraring
items.description: Whoever christened this ring was no more inspired than whoever was responsible for describing it to the common man.

items.name: Heqaxe
items.description: Originally, this weapon's crystals were white, but they became engorged with the blood of the people that its wearer guided with the Heqaxe.

items.name: Bone Band
items.description: This ring is given to young Ouginaks so that they lick their paws instead of chewing their claws.

items.description: It's said that once they're decked out in this hat, some old Ouginaks can predict changes in the weather – in the next ten seconds.

items.description: Used as a whip, this belt can make you scream with pleasure – whether you're the whipper or the whippee.

items.name: Dauge
items.description: If in some dreadfully unfortunate circumstance, someone were to push granny into a bunch of cacti, don't worry! Dauge won't hesitate for a second before helping her and becoming the sole beneficiary of her will.

items.name: Watchdog Belt
items.description: Like all Bow Wows, you now have the right to wag your tail in public without worrying about reprisals from the vice squad.

items.name: Watchdog Amulet
items.description: "Did you see that bo...?" Such were the last words of Patsy VeDross the Iop to her friend Jon Drumpf while visiting the Ouginak Temple. Nobody ever figured out if she was talking about the big bone that she had just noticed, or the watchdog guarding it.

items.name: Sponghield
items.description: This porous but absorbent yellow shield was made from the remains of a creature who used to live in a Pineapi Mask at the bottom of the sea.

items.name: Dragokart Cup
items.description: This shield is a replica of the trophy given to the winners of the famous Dragoturkey race. It's not as prestigious as the original, of course, but if it stops you from getting sliced in two by an anonymous madman, who are you to complain?

items.name: Aerdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Aerdala should do the trick.

items.name: Feudala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Feudala should do the trick.

items.name: Terrdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Terrdala should do the trick.

items.name: Crackler Shield
items.description: This stone shield is, in fact, made from a Crackler's head, smashed by the foot of a Minotoror. A perfect combination of big head and smelly feet.

items.name: Bowisse's Shield
items.description: This shield is a tribute to Bowisse's Cloak, which itself was a tribute to a famous relic composed of three triangular shapes. Blimey, all this history is putting me to sleep.

items.name: Gobball Shield
items.description: Although it's all but useless, its stench alone will spread your fame far and wide. This shield accompanies many young adventurers on their first quests – maybe that's why so few make it to thirty.

items.name: LeChouque's Shield
items.description: LeChouque used this shield to protect himself from the big cannonballs his friends regularly tossed to him. Some crazy stories tell that some of those balls were even alive.

items.name: Flying Shield
items.description: As strange as it might sound, some say this shield of wood and hair enables the lightest adventurers to become airborne for a brief moment... a final attempt to shock their enemies before falling flat on their faces.

items.name: Kloome
items.description: This huge shield once saved the famous adventurer Kloome from an awful death squashed under the weight of a Crackler who had fallen in love with him. The legend doesn't say if he survived the side effects of his passionate romance with the Crackler.

items.name: Captain Amakna Shield
items.description: A young adventurer dreamed of enrolling in Bonta's militia to defend the oppressed. Although he was refused for being too weak, he was contacted by an alchemist in Amakna who was determined to use him as a guinea pig to test one of his new magic potions. The effect was immediate, and the young adventurer quickly turned into a real warrior, becoming incredibly strong... and incredibly stupid. In short, he became a Iop. This reputedly indestructible shield was forged for him, and he would forevermore be known as Captain Amakna (after the famous Captain Chafer who disappeared in very mysterious circumstances).

items.name: Derma Tho
items.description: This skin shield will fit you like a glove. Don't forget to treat its warts and furuncles from time to time to prevent them from getting worn.

items.name: Bawbawian Shield
items.description: Not all Wabbits are nice little creatures. In fact, all Wabbits are vile creatures. Some get their kicks by smashing up Cawwots with this huge shield and taking baths in the juice.

items.name: Heart Quarter
items.description: A renowned adventurer and collector spent his whole life looking for all four quarters of this shield. Some say that when the shield is complete, it has the exact opposite effect of that of breaking a mirror.

items.name: Imp Shield
items.description: If your dearest dream is to become a real imp, this is the shield you need. Passed down from generation to generation, it will let you rob all the young Astrubian adventurers you like without getting hurt.

items.name: Mount Stinkky Shield
items.description: Greenish and smelly, this shield remains a first choice for protection when it comes to fighting the creatures of green and smelly Mount Stinkky.

items.name: Lumberjack Shield
items.description: This shield used to protect lumberjacks from falling trees. Its function quickly changed, and now it is more often used to protect warriors from enemies who tend to land on them without warning!

items.name: Water Dial
items.description: This shield will protect you from rain and slobber, and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Earth Dial
items.description: This shield will protect you from stone-throwing, mud-slinging, and will give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Air Dial
items.description: This shield will protect you from the winds of your opponents, and will give them plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Fire Dial
items.description: This shield will protect you from meteorites and fire-breathers, as well as giving your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Pandawa Shield
items.description: Perfect if you want to fit in on Pandala, or to stand out anywhere else! The biggest advantage of this shield is that it's entirely covered with hypoallergenic Pandawa hair. Now you don't need to pack your underwear and your armour in separate suitcases when you go on holiday.

items.name: Treechnid Shield
items.description: When you're hidden behind this shield, some naive adventurers could mistake you for a Treechnid and run off screaming. Most will attack all the more eagerly, thinking they can get some amber out of you.

items.name: Asse Shield
items.description: This magnificent shield contains a few drops from the Asse Sea. Not only does it bring good luck, but it can also be used as a flask.

items.name: Shield in Briefs
items.description: This strange-looking shield is covered with used underpants that once belonged to a Chafer – certainly the best way show your opponents that you intend to beat the pants off of them.

items.name: Sadida Shield
items.description: Sadidas originally used this shield as a stool when they needed to rest. If you fold the feet in, it will protect you from a wide range of attacks. Nothing will protect you from the cruel laughter of your opponents, however.

items.name: Fan Shield
items.description: When your allies run out of breath, or when you want to clear the air after an unexpected Wind of Panic, this shield can save your life. The only thing you need to do is to shake it energetically in all directions, like you'd do with a hungry baby.

items.name: Akwadala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Akwadala should do the trick.

items.name: Inn Shield
items.description: The Innkeeper at the Feubuk Brewery in Bonta was bored to death one day, when he suddenly got the idea of equipping his bouncers with neon advertising shields.

items.name: Phtalmo
items.description: This shield is covered with peepers to allow you to give one of those devastating multi-evil-eyes. Unstoppable.

items.name: Sidimote Shield
items.description: This shield will remind your opponents you grew up in the Sidimote Moors. That alone could be enough to scare them away.

items.name: Sharkal Shield
items.description: This shield protects you from taxes and from having to share your riches.

items.name: Precious Shield
items.description: This shield only works if you're facing the sun, and then its giant gemstone will let you blind your enemies. Does not work against zombie pumpkins or any other blind but dangerous creatures.

items.name: Broucey Bark
items.description: Used by Brouce Boulgoure himself when he was looking for a Rescue Board.

items.name: Brambler
items.description: Every rose has its thorns. And this does too.

items.name: Cawwot Wound
items.description: This giant Cawwot slice can absorb numerous magic attacks, but won't hold up for long against nibbling Wabbits.

items.name: Ambuckler
items.description: If this amber breaks in combat, it's likely the villainous Arachnee that's been locked inside for fifty-three years will try to bite you.

items.name: Wunsupon
items.description: This shield could have helped you travel back in time if it wasn't missing its time-travel system.

items.name: Locksmith Shield
items.description: This shield is a good pick to keep you from becoming a skeleton.

items.name: Shelld
items.description: This shield can resist any attack except, apparently, whatever weapon was used to kill the poor creature that thought it was protected by this shell.

items.name: Four-Leaf
items.description: Four's a good number. A lot of things come in fours: seasons, doors, tops, lokos, squares... Most say the elements do too, but some rumours say there's a fifth one.

items.name: Seven Years Bad Luck
items.description: This shield is made of a very fragile mirror. It won't protect you against much of anything at all, but if your opponent breaks it, you can be sure they'll suffer seven years bad luck. Or at least, that's what you can tell yourself after your humiliating defeat.

items.name: Upcykld
items.description: Designed to protect the skull, this hat was used as a shield by an adventurer who was hard-headed enough that he didn't need extra protection.

items.name: Bivalve
items.description: When it's warm, this shield opens and a smelly juice leaks out. Nature in all its splendour.

items.name: Proplr Shield
items.description: You can use this shield's propeller to mess up your enemy's hair and get in an attack of opportunity while they're fixing it.

items.name: Chafer Foot Soldier's Shield
items.description: This is the Chafer Foot Soldier's last line of defence against getting his bones rattled in a fight.

items.name: Cubist Shield
items.description: Don't pretend like you understand what the artisan wanted to express with this work.

items.name: Honeycomb Shield
items.description: Unfortunately, this shield doesn't taste like honey, just imminent defeat.

items.name: Crocodyl Chief Shield
items.description: The shape of this shield makes it easier for you to collect Crocodyl tears from your enemies after their defeat.

items.name: Wild Sunflower Shield
items.description: You'll have to hold tight to this shield because it will always try to turn towards the sun.

items.name: Stalak Shield
items.description: This shield was designed to be carried on the back. Some use it because they need to protect their backsides while fighting, and others use it because they'll turn tail and run at the first sign of trouble.

items.name: Cycloid Shield
items.description: This shield was designed by Harry Stottel. While it might not help you avoid certain death, it will make your silhouette much curvier.

items.name: Count Razof's Belt
items.description: Among all Count Razof's trophies, the Boar whose remains embellish this belt hold a special place in his heart: it was his first victim. It was a very aggressive Boar that was threatening farmers near Bonta.

items.name: Count Razof's Slippers
items.description: The Hunters who arrived on Mishell Island weren't expecting such a show. Some even overdosed on all the colours and had to leave early. As for Count Razof, he got so accustomed to all the lively colours that he even went as far as incorporating them into his own wardrobe.

items.name: Count Razof's Helmet
items.description: This helmet protects the Count from getting his bell rung.

items.name: Tive Cape
items.description: This cape symbolises the madness of the Chassulliers, prisoners to their passion for hunting.

items.name: Spitshiners
items.description: Licking these boots will drastically increase your saliva production, giving you more than enough spit to shine your shoes, clean countless children's faces, and do a lot whatever else you might normally use spit for.

items.name: Amulethal
items.description: Since the Chassulliers aren't really sensitive, they slip this ring on just before dealing the final blow to their prey.

items.name: Hunderp Cleavers
items.description: Hunderps are into a different sort of cleavage...

items.name: Magma Belt
items.description: This belt is used as part of many diets, due to its ability to burn fat without its wearer lifting so much as a finger.

items.name: Fiery Tongue Sword
items.description: Thanks to this sword, you won't need a torch or campfire any more. Simply roast your meat and treats by impaling them!

items.name: Alabaster Skrot
items.description: Its atrocious personality is inexcusable, but you can't help but forgive and kiss it every time it does something stupid.

items.name: Anerice Mask
items.description: What would a vampire be without their measure of masked balls? The one in Forfut seems to be going on a little longer than usual: Anerice has refused to take her mask off for several years now.

items.name: Anerice Cloak
items.description: Due to the fact it looks like a Prespic, when wearing this cloak, you may have a little more difficulty finding travelling companions.

items.name: Anerice Shield
items.description: Some ghouls, in a flurry of clarity, suddenly start attacking their masters. Anerice originally designed this shield to defend herself in this kind of situation, but it never really worked; she just ends up stunning them with it.

items.name: Goulring
items.description: This ring sticks out its tongue when you're hungry. In other terms, it always sticks its tongue out.

items.name: Goulboots
items.description: Specially designed to give you that oh-so-desirable Ghoul limp!

items.name: Goulshield
items.description:
This shield once belonged to one General de Ghoul. He was a valiant ghoul who prepared a secret rebellion against the vampires, but who had a hard time finding allies among his peers. Eventually, one eighteenth of Junssidor, he went into action alone: the most notable thing he did was throwing a shovel at a vampire.
Even if he didn't have much of an impact, this event is still foremost in the minds of the ghouls, who will never forget it and still today talk of the heroic actions General de Ghoul and his shovel on that eighteenth of Junssidor.

items.name: Scurvion Helmet
items.description: Scurvions may be among the best-armed monsters, but paradoxically, this helmet gives you everything you need to defend yourself where they cannot: on your head.

items.name: Scurvion Cloak
items.description: This cloak has settled on your back, which explains its colour.

items.name: Scurvion Amulet
items.description: Some intellectuals regularly get together to classify venoms depending on how dangerous they are: ranging from "slightly deadly" to "agonisingly deadly". To do so, they work off the density of ghosts present around the various venoms' sources. According to this data, Scurvion Venom is expected to make one "mildly dead". Wearing this amulet can mean one of two things: either you have little use for it, or you will soon understand the meaning of this classification system.

items.name: Cauldini Shield
items.description: This shield's resemblance to Captain Amakna's ends at its appearance: optical illusions do have their limits.

items.name: Cauldini Boots
items.description: These boots will allow you to find out one of Cauldini's best-kept secrets: it's not his boots that make him levitate. You can probably "boot" that information, for all it's worth.

items.name: Cauldini Mask
items.description: By wearing this mask, you'll look strangely like a rodent. Goes to show that magic can really make things prettier!

items.name: Riktus Mask
items.description: For some people, it's not the costume that makes the man. This saying doesn't really apply to the Riktus.

items.name: Riktus Cloak
items.description: As acrobats, the Riktus know that a cloak can sometimes be a deadly disadvantage. But some people still can't do without one, so they shorten it as much as possible in order to limit the risks involved.

items.name: Riktus Ring
items.description: Riktus – how to endlessly amuse other people and yourself: that's your belief.

items.name: Boowoldlum Headgear
items.description: Don't take its nonchalant style and empty gaze at face value: the Boowoldlum makes them all crack up, whether it's a Boowonoké or your ribs.

items.name: Boowoldlum Cloak
items.description: Regardless of how other people look at you, regardless of their prejudices, you can make the choice of wearing this Boowoldlum fur as a sign of rebelliousness: being ridiculed only makes you stronger. Possibly.

items.name: Boowoldlum Loincloth
items.description: An entire ecosystem seems to have grown around this hair, so take care of it!

items.name: Forfut Shovel
items.description: In Forfut, there are ghouls by the shovelful.

items.name: Forfut Hammer
items.description: If a ghoul starts asking themselves existential questions, they will be hit over the head with this hammer until they return to their habitual state.

items.name: Revived Fiery Tongue Sword
items.description: This sword's creation sits somewhere between the invention of fire and modern torches.

items.name: Invisible Shield
items.description: This shield won't protect you from ridicule.

items.name: Thing
items.description: Thing is a hand that can think, write and act by itself. It's a very obliging creature. It's believed that it once worked for the prestigious Dadums family from Forfut. However, they used this hand in ways we wouldn't want to mention in polite company, and it was eventually driven to run away and find a less twisted owner. It happened to find you, and there's a good chance you won't be much better than the Dadums family. Thing's destiny is nothing if not tragic.

items.name: Death Mask
items.description: The reason this item resembles the Kwismas Nightmare Mask is because it was made by the same artisan: Jack the Sram. Sneaky skeleton, eccentric Frigostian and unlucky joker... Jack had many faces. That could explain the exceptional power held by these death masks: that of allowing a living being to enter the kingdom of the dead.

items.name: Amulet of the Valiant Heart
items.description: This amulet symbolises courage and bravery. At least, that's what some intellectuals think.

items.name: Boots of the Valiant Heart
items.description: These stone boots are perfect in combat, as long as your legs are strong enough to lift them.

items.name: Cape of the Valiant Heart
items.description: This cape has a kind of integrated belt. You can use it to tie it to your waist at any time, to prevent enemies from grabbing it and slowing you down.

items.name: Amulet of the Bleeding Heart
items.description: This amulet symbolises courage and bravery. At least, that's what some intellectuals think.

items.name: Boots of the Bleeding Heart
items.description: These stone boots are perfect in combat, as long as your legs are strong enough to lift them.

items.name: Cape of the Bleeding Heart
items.description: This cape has a kind of integrated belt. You can use it to tie it to your waist at any time, to prevent enemies from grabbing it and slowing you down.

items.name: Belt of the Salvatory Spirit
items.description: Have these wings been strategically placed to send you some sort of message? Now all you have to do is figure it out.

items.name: Boots of the Salvatory Spirit
items.description: Sometimes you can find out who someone is just by looking at their shoes. So, what do these ones say?

items.name: Mask of the Salvatory Spirit
items.description: If you don't already know what you're wearing next Karnaval, here's an interesting idea.

items.name: Belt of the Unsound Mind
items.description: Have these wings been strategically placed to send you some sort of message? Now all you have to do is figure it out.

items.name: Boots of the Unsound Mind
items.description: Sometimes you can find out who someone is just by looking at their shoes. So, what do these ones say?

items.name: Mask of the Unsound Mind
items.description: If you don't already know what you're wearing next Karnaval, here's an interesting idea.

items.name: Cape of the Sharp Eye
items.description: This discreet and lightweight cape is perfect for your spying missions, especially when you have to hide in the snow.

items.name: Hood of the Sharp Eye
items.description: This hood preserves your anonymity so you can steal from the rich to give to the poor, without any of that pesky glory.

items.name: Amulet of the Sharp Eye
items.description: This amulet is normally worn by Bonta's spies. But anybody can own one. If not, they would be too easy to spot.

items.name: Cape of the Putrid Eye
items.description: This discreet and lightweight cape is perfect for your spying missions, especially when you have to hide in the dark.

items.name: Hood of the Putrid Eye
items.description: This hood preserves your anonymity so you can steal from the poor to give to the rich, without any of that pesky glory.

items.name: Amulet of the Putrid Eye
items.description: This amulet is normally worn by Brakmar's spies. But anybody can own one. If not, they would be too easy to spot.

items.name: Bontarian Shield
items.description: Having been under threat of destruction many a time, the White City is always in need of warriors, priests and spies to protect it. Behind this shield hides one of these Bontarians, who's potentially willing to risk their life for their city.

items.name: Brakmarian Shield
items.description: Sometimes destroyed, sometimes rebuilt, the Black City is always in need of warriors, priests and spies to protect it. Behind this shield hides one of these Brakmarians, who's potentially willing to risk their life for their city.

items.name: Ilyzaelle Amulet
items.description: It is said that this amulet harnesses a small amount of the Opaline Dofus's power. That's an awfully good selling point!

items.name: Ilyzaelle Helmet
items.description: Ilyzaelle is so charismatic that some knights have offered to serve her personally. This is particularly the case for the unsung knights of the Doziak: the best of them wore a golden armour of their own making to imitate that of Ilyzaelle, so the story goes.

items.name: Ilyzaelle Shield
items.description: The artisan who forged this shield seems to have encrusted a single opal in place of the Dofus of Kings.

items.name: Soul-Blaze Wedding Ring
items.description: Did you know that Soul-Blazes try to possess mortal bodies? Probably not, or you wouldn't be wearing a Soul-Blaze Wedding Ring.

items.name: Dust Kickers
items.description: Since they couldn't possess your body, two Soul-Blazes decided to possess these shoes instead. They seem happy.

items.name: Soul-Blaze Mask
items.description: It'll take a lot more than that to look as threatening as a Soul-Blaze, but it's a good start.

items.name: Corrupted Spear
items.description: If you don't really know how to use a spear, you could always use it like a staff.

items.name: Ilyzaelle Daggers
items.description: Ilyzaelle rarely gets these daggers out in combat. She prefers to use them like actual knives.

items.name: Soul-Blaze Sword
items.description: It looks like a Skoul has possessed this sword. It's therefore recommended that you take care when using it, and wear gloves so you don't touch the Soul-Blaze.

items.name: Corrupted Bow
items.description: Corrupted by energies originating from Externam, this bow is linked to the kingdom of the dead. So, if one of its arrows hits its target, that's where they're headed!

items.name: Gobbalator
items.description: Gobbalator has been training for war since he was a nipper. He can open a can of beer or a Brakmarian's head with his teeth alone.

items.name: Gobbalux
items.description: Gobbalux has been training for war since he was a nipper. He can skewer barbecued meat or a Bontarian's forehead with just a jab of his horns.

items.name: Lavasmith Dofus
items.description: Despite its somewhat unusual appearance, this Dofus is a genuine dragon egg; it would be a shame to hock it for a few nails. It will keep warm you during the long winter nights, and let you to organise barbecues in the summer. In any case, avoid going too close to haystacks or bundles of kindling with it; otherwise, you could be mistaken for a dangerous arsonist.

effects.formatted:
Applies 100% of level as shield points to its bearer, 1 time max per turn for pushback damage and 1 time for each type of movement: 
- pushback damage
- pushback / attraction
- place switching / teleportation / Eliotrope portal
- carried by a Pandawa

The effect can only be triggered by enemies.

items.name: Zrid Gloves
items.description: These gloves have been made to take precise samples; they aren't suitable for combat.

items.name: Necronyx Sword
items.description: This sword forged by the divine hammer of Gobannus allows you to use the power of Necronyx to petrify the Veriun Dead.

items.name: Molekound
items.description: From the volcanoes of Sidimote, this magma Bow Wow is descended from a long line of Cerberus trained by the Ouginaks. Some legends claim that sacrifices of young, innocent souls were necessary to stir up its ferocity, but this is no longer the case.

items.name: Burning Shoes
items.description: Your feet will stay warm whenever you're hot to trot.

items.name: Burning Mask
items.description: Your burning gaze will melt anyone, and your enemies will see only smoke.

items.name: Burning Cape
items.description: This fireproof cape's full potential can be seen in the heat of inaction.

items.name: Volcanic Amulet
items.description: The back of this amulet is inscribed with the following proverb: "When you light a candle for your god, light two for Rushu."

items.name: Volcanic Bag
items.description: This bag will allow you to communicate easily using smoke signals. Watch out, though, as where there's smoke, there's fire.

items.name: Volcanic Clogs
items.description: The metallic soles of these clogs allow you to slide on any surface and create a shower of sparks that will satisfy your most primal pyromaniac instincts.

items.name: Lavaxe
items.description: More dangerous than a fireball, more terrifying than a ball afire, this axe will devour your adversaries' bravery.

items.name: Steelymace
items.description: Crush heads or nuts? With the Steelymace, the choice is yours.

items.name: Scapu Helm
items.description: With this helm, you might finally have your shoulders on your head.

items.name: Suspender Belt
items.description: The cobbler who produced this marvel reached his highest potential in the last-minute rush. His favourite saying was "Always put off what you can do today until tomorrow." He remains widely misunderstood to this day.

items.name: Lavaring
items.description: It puts out a terrifying heat. And is not meant for all sands, err, bands, err, lands, err.... Oh, you know what I mean!

items.name: Solar's Shield
items.description: This shield reflects light. Don't bother trying to see your reflection in it: just like Solar's, yours won't appear in it.

items.name: Bluster Belt
items.description: Among dungeon keepers, the ones with the most bark have the least bite.

items.name: Drowhirl Hat
items.description: If you hold this giant shell to your ear, you just might hear the sound of the Hermaffrodaight Sea.

items.name: Sucgunner Cape
items.description: This indescribable pile of foam and decomposing coral surprisingly does not give off any putrid odours – a sufficiently strange occurrence in the World of Twelve to be noteworthy.

items.name: Bethel's Panties
items.description: The seams are reinforced and the inside is as soft as the outside. Once soiled, you can therefore turn them inside out and wear them another month.

items.name: Micrab Slippers
items.description: "Comfortable on the inside, spiky on the outside." These slippers remind you of someone who hurt you horribly, but whom you miss terribly all the same.

items.name: Funerbroadsword Mask
items.description: Hard to know which way is up with this mask... Big teeth and small ears, or the opposite? This difficult decision will keep you busy during those long winter nights.

items.name: Mishmash Wand
items.description: The artisan who created this wand used a few drops of sea foam, a pinch of decomposing matter, an ounce of a bad faith, and a piece of good will.

items.name: Ensorcel Lance
items.description: This magic lance has the amazing power to transform offal into sweets and boiled celery into Turkish delight. A curse for foodies, a blessing for the younger generation.

items.name: Absoluti Cape
items.description: This cape belonged to a dangerous aquatic criminal whose sins were forgiven.

items.name: Celebring
items.description: It will make you world famous – among crustaceans.

items.name: Hirofant Necklace
items.description: According to ancient writings translated with only a passing glance at the text, this strange necklace seems to have belonged to a pawnbroker willing to do anything to pass on his knowledge to the students living in the fields near his home.

items.name: Boot Boots
items.description: "The advantage of these dead fish boots is that they mask the smell of my feet." Ah, what poetry emerges from the depths of the sea!

items.name: Courageous Ring
items.description: You won't be able to rule them all with this ring, but you will at least feel more powerful when you put it on. It's a start.

items.name: Silver Dofus
items.description: Created by Ratathrosk, the grey dragon, this egg is an enigma. It may not be as powerful as a Primordial Dofus, but it seems older than time... You'd do well to guard it closely. After all, only the Norrai and the god Xelor know what the future holds.

effects.formatted:
As soon as the bearer falls below 20% of their health points, the Dofus's effect is triggered.
At the start of their next turn: heals 20% HP (once per fight).

items.name: Weapon Curse
items.description: This curse is more effective against your spouse than wheat.

items.name: Syllabu Shield
items.description: You can tell an adventurer's fight history just by looking at the hits taken by this shield.

items.name: Nackle Tabard
items.description: Once used in religious ceremonies, nowadays this item of clothing can be worn for any occasion.

items.name: Rotceres Pickaxe
items.description: The metal of this pickaxe is as tough as diamond. Now this is a tool that can probably cut through anything.

items.name: Wild Crimson Rhineetle
items.description:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated. You will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

items.description:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated. You will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

items.name: Golden and Emerald Rhineetle
items.description:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated. You will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

items.name: Grithril Belt
items.description: The inside of this belt is lined with the fuzz of young Stubbyobs who were voluntarily volunteered to be donors against their will.

items.name: Grithril Ring
items.description:
This ring is designed to fit Stubbyobs: it can be worn readily around anything short and stubby. Like fingers or toes, of course! What else?
It might fit your wrist.

items.name: Grithril Helmet
items.description: With that much weight on your noggin, it won't be easy to hold your head high for long.

items.name: Freezammer Cloak
items.description: Having a beard down your back is not as practical as having eyes in the back of your head.

items.name: Stubbeard
items.description: There's nothing better than a fake beard to disguise a misleading appearance.

items.name: Freezammer Amulet
items.description: Axe head or tiny anchor? Either way, your neck will be cursing the Stubbyob who made this "jewel".

items.name: Rhineetle Helmet
items.description: The tiny antennae on this helmet let you understand the Rhineetle's complex dialect consisting of the words Vrrr, Brrr, Trrr, and Krrr, which signify eat, eat, eat, and eat, respectively.

items.name: Rhineetle Belt
items.description:
The huge antennae located in the back of this belt are pheromone receptors.
They alert you whenever anyone (or anything) genetically compatible with you comes close.
Oh, no, that won't be awkward at all!

items.name: Rhineetle Amulet
items.description: Made by a former Rhineetle breeder, this amulet gives off a delicate scent of stables, a mixture of manure, sweat, and underpaid labour.

items.name: Rhineetle Ring
items.description: The tiny wings beat rapidly to maximise your ability to tickle anyone you touch. Torture for some, pleasure for others... You may test it on yourself to figure out which camp you're in.

items.name: Rhineetle Bow
items.description: The antenna serves as an arrow rest, the horn serves to intimidate opponents, and the wings serve no purpose whatsoever. Just remember to grip it properly to shoot accurately.

items.name: Crocobur
items.description: The legendary sword that Grougalorasalar gave to his son is now in your possession. But if the weapon you removed from the rock is indeed Crocobur, it is only the shadow of what it was... It's up to you to return its powers and history.

items.name: Crocobur
items.description: After much effort, you finally hold in your hands the sword of the emperor who nearly conquered the world long ago. Nevertheless, don't forget the deal you made with Volkaragnar. Once you have the Ebony Dofus, you will have to give Crocobur back to its creator. Can't have it all...

items.name: Sparkling Silver Dofus
items.description: When the dragon Ratathrosk created the Silver Dofus, when the World of the Twelve did not yet exist, a miracle happened: the first of the Phoenixes came back to life. Time has passed, gods have vanished, stars have gone out. Now, the egg that you hold in your hands sparkles brightly like it once did... like a lost love whose flame burns yet again.

effects.formatted:
As soon as the bearer falls below 20% of their health points, the Dofus's effect is triggered.
At the start of their next turn: heals 30% HP and gives 20% final damage for 1 turn (once per fight).

items.name: Crocobur
items.description:
"The Crocodyls numbered in the thousands, a few hundred kametres from the city gates. We had prepared for the assault, the full guard were assembled in front of the main gate, and the war machines had been set up on the ramparts. The sight of the gigantic army of reptiles was already terrifying, but the worst was when we saw them. Crocoburio stood in the midst of his soldiers, several heads taller than all of them, brandishing his cursed sword towards us. When the green mass began to march, a shiver ran through our ranks, and we knew that the coming battle would be terrible."

– A Bontarian soldier

effects.formatted:
Crocobur's Appetite:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer inflicts 11 to 15 damage on themself in their best attack element to steal 11 to 15 health from adjacent entities at the end of the bearer's turn.

items.name: Scissors of Destiny
items.description: This item is legendary – you, however, are not.

effects.formatted:
Fateful Destiny:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer gains 20% weapon damage if adjacent to an enemy.
• When the bearer locks, they become Unmovable until the start of their next turn.

items.name: Brumaire's Shiver
items.description: This item is legendary – you, however, are not.

effects.formatted:
Novamaire Cold:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer gains 20 AP Reduction if adjacent to an enemy. Otherwise, the bearer gains 20 Dodge. 
• When the bearer finishes off an enemy fighter during their turn, they become invisible for 1 turn.

items.name: Buhorado Feather
items.description:
"There was a time before safes existed. Enutrofs would hide their savings in socks or under their mattresses, squirrels would hide their hazelnuts inside tree trunks, and dragons would stockpile their gold coins in dark, damp caves. Then the Firm created the banking network. What a revolution! Finally, Twelvians could keep their belongings safe behind reinforced doors. Of course, there are still Rogues setting off bombs and illegal kama dealers cheating overly greedy adventurers, but that's no big deal. You just need good insurance."

– Buhorado

effects.formatted:
Buhorado Feather:
• When the bearer lands a critical hit, they gain 10 Pushback Damage for 3 turns, stackable 10 times.

items.name: Fallanster's Rectitude
items.description:
"Any Feca heading into combat must carry a shield. But the best protection against adversity, the best rampart against all those who seek to harm or destroy us, is union. Mercenaries! Time has come to set our quarrels aside and unite under a single banner. Astrub is not merely an old merchant city founded by a gang of bandits who've grown tame. Astrub is also an ancient city, with its own heritage and culture. Astrub is a nation! Today, dear council members, you are going to elect a new leader. I have applied for the position. Will you place your trust in me? It's your decision."

– Fallanster, Head of the Council of Astrub

effects.formatted:
Fallanster's Rectitude:
• When the bearer ends their turn in an enemy's line of sight, the damage suffered by the bearer is reduced by 10% for 1 turn. This reduction is lost if the bearer is attracted, pushed, carried, teleported or transposed.

items.name: Death-Defying
items.description:
"Death is a necessary evil, but even so, we'd all prefer it comes for someone else, isn't that so? That's why I forged this shield. It is indestructible; it will never wear out and never rust. It turns away all blows that could take you from living to dead. Despite its impressive size, it is light and manageable. Plus, its macabre looks will intimidate your opponents; the most cowardly among them won't be able to bear the dark pits of its empty eyes and will run away screaming. Still need convincing? Time for a demonstration. You're up, Sargent Kocksis."

– a craftsman who wishes to remain anonymous

effects.formatted:
Death-Defying:
• When the bearer has more than 50% of their HP, their close-combat damage is increased by 10% but the damage they suffer is increased by 15%.
• When they have less than 50% HP, the damage taken is reduced by 20%.

items.name: Bram Worldbeard's Crown
items.description:
"They think us small and weak. They mock our costumes and our ancestral traditions. They take us for smelly barbarians, greedy and uncouth. They think us happy to stay in our mines, digging in the dark like Rotceres. But they are wrong! I will show them the Stubbyobs' true nature. I will burn their farms and crops. I will flatten their cities. I will shave their heads and eyebrows. I will shear their Gobballs. I will take their gold, empty their barrels, shred their banners. I am the King Under the Mountain... and soon, I shall be king of the world!

– Bram Worldbeard

effects.formatted:
King Under the Mountain:
• When the bearer suffers an attempted AP, MP or Range removal, they gain 3% weapon damage for 2 turns (stackable 5 times).

items.name: Ganymede's Diadem
items.description:
"When a young soul leaves the temple in Incarnam, that soul dreams of the life waiting for it outside. A life full of thrilling adventures, personal exploits, enriching exchanges, and communion with others. The soul has forgotten who it was before. Perhaps it reigned over an empire, only a little rubble of which remains. Perhaps it was a humble shepherd watching over a herd of Gobballs. The past is of little importance when one looks to the future. The Celestial Eagles ensure that every being gets a new start, without fear or regret, until destiny has been fulfilled."

– Master Ganymede

effects.formatted:
Ganymede's Wisdom:
• The bearer gains 2 AP on even turns and loses 1 AP on odd turns.

items.name: Rykke Errel's Bravery
items.description:
"I've been training to fight dragons since I was very young. I am a knight, and knights assail huge fire-breathing lizards. That's what all the children's history books say, so it must be true! You can imagine my surprise when I met Bolgrot, then. Who would have ever thought that I'd become his best friend? Not me, that's for sure! I was as surprised as anyone. It just goes to show that you can't count on appearances... We've been together constantly for weeks. I can't wait to introduce him to Helsephine! I'm sure they'll get along famously."

– Rykke Errel, Iop knight

effects.formatted:
Rykke Errel's Bravery:
• When the bearer suffers a ranged attack, they gain 10% of their level as shield and lose 1% ranged damage for 1 turn for each cell of distance from their attacker (max. 11 cells).

items.name: Jahash Jurgen's Nobility
items.description:
"While our troops were gathering to fight off the army of the Dark City, I climbed to the top of the closest hill for one last prayer. Today, many Twelvians shall die. I wonder. Is all this violence necessary? Must we sacrifice thousands of souls so that harmony might reign again? But now is not the time for questions or doubts. Spirit of Balance, send me your wisdom. Show me the path of justice that leads to peace. And if my path should cross that of the Butcher of Brakmar... then give me the strength to fight her so that hope can be reborn in this world."

– Jahash Jurgen

effects.formatted:
Elemental Assimilation:
• When the bearer suffers damage in an element, they gain 4% resistance in that element for 2 turns (stackable 4 times, shared between elements).

items.name: Thousand-League Boots
items.description:
"They say that the first lumberjacks could travel the length and breadth of Amakna without ever tiring. The boots they wore had been enchanted by the four guardians and let them cross the country in the blink of an eye. In a single step, the sentinels with piercing eyes leapt from border to border, from the shores of the Asse Sea to the rocky valleys full of Bworks and Goblins. Alas! The power of these miraculous boots declined when the Four left... But scouts who are lucky enough to own a pair stay a few steps ahead of the kingdom's enemies."

– Cornelia Granpa

effects.formatted:
Thousand Leagues:
• The bearer gains 2 MP on odd turns and loses 1 MP on even turns.

items.name: Kicked Ass Boots
items.description:
"Come close, newcomers! Don't hang back. I won't repeat myself. First, know this: Only Masters of the Order are allowed to wear the sacred boots during official boot-kissing ceremonies. You must be able to fill the boots, you see. Anyone who dares disobey will be trampled by all their peers before being booted out on their backsides. Does everyone have their polishing brushes and Blibli wax? Good! Line up and enter the room in silence. I only want to hear one pair of heels!"

– Bowisse, Grand Master of the Kicked Ass

effects.formatted:
The Kicked Asses:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer pushes adjacent entities back by 2 cells.

items.name: Dodge's Audacity
items.description:
"When you're unlucky, it's tempting to do nothing and stay at home filing one's claws so you don't trigger a disaster... But if you must be jinxed with bad luck, you might as well make it count! Audacity can break the paralysing grip of an unlucky jinx. There's nothing like a bit of nerve to ward off bad luck. You tried something and failed? Brilliant! You just have to try again! 'Tis better to try and fail because of bad luck than because you lacked nerve. What's important is landing on your feet."

– Dodge the Ecaflip

effects.formatted:
Dodge's Audacity:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer teleports or switches places to a random adjacent cell or is not moved. If not moved, the bearer gains 20% Critical and 80 Pushback Damage for 1 turn.

items.name: Lady Jhessica's Courage
items.description:
"A master's passing is a tragedy for his students. When Prosperus Elementor disappeared, all Huppermages were orphaned. How can we survive the emptiness left in his wake? How can the young generations receive their heritage when questions remain unanswered? I'm leaving today for the lush green island of Ohwymi to open a door that will let me find our guide. May the Scales tip in my favour... and may the god Xelor grant me the time I need to reach my goal."

– Lady Jhessica

effects.formatted:
Lady Jhessica's Courage:
• At the end of each turn, the bearer removes 60 Dodge from adjacent enemies for 1 turn.

items.name: Sacrificial Knives
items.description: Is eating your enemies' hearts a barbaric practice from another time, or an ancestral tradition to pass on? Start by using this knife on someone, and you'll be able to form your own opinion on the question.

items.name: Paztek Sandals
items.description: The sandals worn by Paztek warriors give them all the sensations of going barefoot, while considerably reducing the risk of slipping clumsily on the blood of their enemies.

items.name: Paztek Cloak
items.description: The tinkling of the gold coins attached to the hem of this cape lets the wearers play music to accompany Paztek ritual dances, especially the dance celebrating human sacrifice. From there, it's just a tiny leap to saying that this cape trivialises murder.

items.name: Paztek Mask
items.description: Masks are a very important aspect of Paztek culture. They protect their faces, scare their enemies and evil spirits, and even identify the roles Pazteks play in their tribe: warrior, priest, merchant, or worker, for example. Paztek masks therefore make lovely gifts for friends or family living on the continent and, as wall hangings, are wonderfully suited to provide the most exotic touch to any home.

items.name: Cocoa Dofus
items.description: All your cares and worries seem to melt away as you carry this massive cocoa egg. You do indeed feel the effects of the chocolate: you are both comforted and a bit wider and heavier.

items.name: Copiou Sceptre
items.description: This sceptre controls the hunger of whoever wields it. If you wave it in front of the Waddicts, it's highly likely that they'll start obeying you.

items.name: Mawaboots
items.description: After trudging leagues and leagues through chocolate, the soles of these boots have absorbed so much that they leave footprints wherever you go. Discretion NOT guaranteed...

items.name: Slimming Belt
items.description: There's nothing better than this belt to offset all chocolate excesses and sculpt a dreamy Iop body.

items.name: Waddict Ring
items.description: This furry ring will warm any finger you put in it.

items.name: Chocomancer Amulet
items.description: This amulet has a secret compartment that contains a small piece of very concentrated chocolate. This cocoa piece is used by Chocomancers who need to shore up their power during a fight, but since you don't practice chocomancy, it'll just make a welcome snack if you get hungry. Be warned, it's a bit bitter.

items.name: Chocomancer Belt
items.description: Chocomancy requires its practitioners ingest large quantities of chocolate. Traditional belts that squeeze practitioners' tummies too tightly often prevent their stomachs from welcoming the precious cocoa. This belt is remarkably stretchy, so it lets them stuff themselves with chocolate without losing their pants.

items.name: Chocomancer Shield
items.description: You might doubt just how effective an edible shield can be, but this one is surprisingly very resistant. Do wait until the end of the fight before nibbling on your shield, though, or you might never get another chance to taste it.

items.name: Foodie-Slicer Spatula
items.description: This giant spatula is a very versatile tool. With it, you can prepare a huge and delicious chocolate cake, then mercilessly slice into any gluttons who try to taste it without your permission.

items.name: Chokao Mask
items.description: Wearing this mask, you can try to found a sect based on excessive chocolate consumption. But be sure you're never unmasked or your own followers will grind you up like a common cocoa bean.

items.name: Chocrunch Helmet
items.description: Whoever designed this item wasn't very clever: if you don't want to be stumbling around in the dark (chocolate), you need to eat one side of the helmet.

items.name: Chocrunch Boots
items.description: Made by two brothers, Ay-Ess and Em-Ar, these boots make the delicious sound of cracking chocolate with every step you take.

items.name: Snackpack Sack
items.description: This little bag will bring back fond memories of childhood (either yours or someone else's): your mum's homemade snacks, skipping down the path to school ready to take a bite out of life, and getting your precious snacks stolen by bigger kids... Ah, those were the days.

items.name: Cocoa Dofus
items.description: You close your eyes and suddenly the divine egg's chocolate scent fills your nose. You bring the mythical object to your innocent lips, heady with temptation and yearning for a new culinary pleasure. As your taste buds are flooded with bitterness, you learn to your great dismay that not all divine essences taste good.

effects.formatted:
Each ranged attack suffered by the bearer when adjacent to an enemy applies a chocolate mark.

These marks are consumed at the end of its turn; each one gives 25% of its level as shield for 1 turn.

items.name: Chronoxygene Tank
items.description: You'll finally be able to take a breather thanks to the air in this tank.

items.name: Chronomagic Suit
items.description: When combined with a chronoxygene tank, this time-dive suit lets you travel through time and never fear working overtime.

items.name: Vulbis Dofus
items.description: The dragon who laid this Dofus decided to remain anonymous. Even the wisest adventurers still wonder why.

items.name: Crocoring
items.description: This ring will make you stronger, but might take off your finger.

items.name: Crocobelt
items.description: This belt was made by an aspiring designer. Frustrated because inspiration wouldn't come, the designer threw the Crocodyl scales and teeth on the ground, which resulted in this oh-so-very unique pattern. He loved the results so much that he now only ever uses that method for his new designs.

items.name: Crocoshield
items.description: Crocodyl scales are as hard as Iops' heads. This shield is covered in them, making it a must-have accessory for adventurers everywhere who like to jump carelessly into the fray.

items.name: Lunar Boots
items.description: The creation of these boots was one small step for the shoemaker who made them and one giant leap for the Twelvians who wear them.

items.name: Lunar Necklace
items.description: They say you'll turn into a Boowolf if you wear this necklace under a full moon.

items.name: Lunar Ring
items.description: If you like wearing your rings on your thumbs, you're out of luck. This ring can only be worn on your ring finger. You do get to choose which hand, though. So what will it be, the right or the left?

items.name: Turtelonia Wand
items.description: After being bossed around by Turtelonia, the Arkelon turtle, with a wave of her wand, the Crocuzkoians decided to make exact replicas of her wand so they could boss silly adventurers around when they came to the island. Some were more successful than others, but it's the thought that counts.

items.name: Turtelonia Carapace
items.description: Make sure you don't land on your back while you're wearing this carapace. You might not be able to roll back over.

items.name: Turtelonia Horn
items.description: Some say you can tell how old an Arkelon turtle is by the size of its horn. If you wear this one, you won't look your age anymore.

items.name: Prytekt
items.description: This prysmaradite will protect you against the first arrow from a Iop who only just became a Cra.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 550% of their level in shield points on the first turn, 200% on the second turn and 100% on the third.

items.name: Shiny Prytekt
items.description: This prysmaradite will protect you against the first arrow from a Iop who only just became a Cra.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 150% of their level in shield points on the first turn, 450% on the second turn and 150% on the third.

items.name: Iridescent Prytekt
items.description: This prysmaradite will protect you against the first arrow from a Iop who only just became a Cra.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 100% of their level in shield points on the first turn, 200% on the second turn and 350% on the third.

items.name: Plushy-Ball: Drheller
items.description: First put an adorable creature in a ball, then launch it at your opponent... Quite the recipe for a franchise. And you're responsible for it.

items.name: Plushy-Ball: Gobball
items.description: First put an adorable creature in a ball, then launch it at your opponent... Quite the recipe for a franchise. And you're responsible for it.

items.name: Plushy-Ball: Tofu
items.description: First put an adorable creature in a ball, then launch it at your opponent... Quite the recipe for a franchise. And you're responsible for it.

items.name: Plushy-Ball: Bow Meow
items.description: First put an adorable creature in a ball, then launch it at your opponent... Quite the recipe for a franchise. And you're responsible for it.

items.name: Plushy-Ball: Minikron
items.description: First put an adorable creature in a ball, then launch it at your opponent... Quite the recipe for a franchise. And you're responsible for it.

items.name: Weighted Wooden Wings
items.description: These wings won't let you soar: they were merely built to scuttle Kat, Zen and Jammer.

items.name: Weighted Helmet
items.description: This helmet was designed for a single purpose: to prevent Goblins from getting to Moon Island. Don't look for another use for it, as you'll only end up disappointed.

items.name: Nightmare Catcher
items.description: How could something so fragile-looking be used to capture four monsters that are spookier than an undertaker? Only one way to find out... Be sure to equip the nightmare catcher before challenging a Horlamare, or you'll likely regret it.

items.name: Pryssure
items.description: This prysmaradite will put you under pressure, so don't lose your cool.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 1 AP for 3 turns but inflicts -10% damage.

items.name: Shiny Pryssure
items.description: This prysmaradite will put you under pressure, so don't lose your cool.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 2 AP for 2 turns but inflicts -35% damage.

items.name: Iridescent Pryssure
items.description: This prysmaradite will put you under pressure, so don't lose your cool.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 4 AP for 1 turn but inflicts -50% damage.

items.name: Surpryz
items.description: This prysmaradite brings luck! How lucky! Since your last adventure to Ohwymi, you've really needed some.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 15% Critical for 3 turns.

items.name: Shiny Surpryz
items.description: This prysmaradite brings luck! How lucky! Since your last adventure to Ohwymi, you've really needed some.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 35% Critical for 2 turns.

items.name: Iridescent Surpryz
items.description: This prysmaradite brings luck! How lucky! Since your last adventure to Ohwymi, you've really needed some.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 100% Critical for 1 turn.

items.name: Pryndsight
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for slow and resentful adventurers. Kind of like you, actually.

effects.formatted: For 1 turn, the bearer gains as much Power as damage suffered by enemies, up to 200 Power (3 turns).

items.name: Shiny Pryndsight
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for slow and resentful adventurers. Kind of like you, actually.

effects.formatted: For 1 turn, the bearer gains as much Power as damage suffered by enemies, up to 300 Power (2 turns).

items.name: Iridescent Pryndsight
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for slow and resentful adventurers. Kind of like you, actually.

effects.formatted: For 1 turn, the bearer gains as much Power as damage suffered by enemies, up to 600 Power (1 turn).

items.name: Prycapture
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for getting close to adventurers who would have liked to put some distance between you and them. As a very wise person, you know the secret of heroes who can be a drag: perseverance.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 1 MP (2 turns) per enemy more than 15 cells away.

items.name: Shiny Prycapture
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for getting close to adventurers who would have liked to put some distance between you and them. As a very wise person, you know the secret of heroes who can be a drag: perseverance.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 1 MP (2 turns) per enemy more than 12 cells away and loses 1 AP (2 turns) per enemy within 12 cells.

items.name: Iridescent Prycapture
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for getting close to adventurers who would have liked to put some distance between you and them. As a very wise person, you know the secret of heroes who can be a drag: perseverance.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 1 MP (2 turns) per enemy more than 9 cells away and loses 2 AP (2 turns) per enemy within 9 cells.

items.name: Prygenerate
items.description: This prysmaradite is a bit like a fountain of youth, just without the water... and without the fountain, come to think of it. It won't really make you any younger, either. Actually, as analogies go, this is a pretty bad one.

effects.formatted: Heals 15% of enemy damage suffered until the end of the third turn.

items.name: Shiny Prygenerate
items.description: This prysmaradite is a bit like a fountain of youth, just without the water... and without the fountain, come to think of it. It won't really make you any younger, either. Actually, as analogies go, this is a pretty bad one.

effects.formatted: Heals 30% of enemy damage suffered until the end of the second turn.

items.name: Iridescent Prygenerate
items.description: This prysmaradite is a bit like a fountain of youth, just without the water... and without the fountain, come to think of it. It won't really make you any younger, either. Actually, as analogies go, this is a pretty bad one.

effects.formatted: Heals 100% of enemy damage suffered until the end of the first turn.

items.name: Prysipitate
items.description: This prysmaradite gives you the feeling that you're always late. Maybe it's not just a feeling...

effects.formatted: The bearer gains +2 AP for their first round.

items.name: Shiny Prysipitate
items.description: This prysmaradite gives you the feeling that you're always late. Maybe it's not just a feeling...

effects.formatted: The bearer gains +3 AP for their first round but also loses 2 MP.

items.name: Iridescent Prysipitate
items.description: This prysmaradite gives you the feeling that you're always late. Maybe it's not just a feeling...

effects.formatted: The bearer gains +4 AP for their first round but also loses 4 MP.

items.name: Spryritual
items.description: This prysmaradite lifts its bearer's spirits, but without teaching them good manners, so you're safe.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 250 AP Parry on the first turn, then 50 AP Parry on the second turn.

items.name: Prysical
items.description:
This prysmaradite will give your body what it needs to endure the hardships of an adventurer's life.

This is a stone. Do not ingest. Our products are not tested on Ecaflips or Ouginaks. Non alcoholic. Does not contain palmiflower oil.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 250 MP Parry on the first turn, then 50 MP Parry on the second turn.

items.name: Pryank
items.description: This prysmaradite will give you that cheeky quality that teens have these days without sacrificing the obscene comfort of your privileged position.

effects.formatted: At the end of their first turn, the bearer reduces damage by 5% (3 turns) for each enemy (excluding summons) in their line of sight.

items.name: Shiny Pryank
items.description: This prysmaradite will give you that cheeky quality that teens have these days without sacrificing the obscene comfort of your privileged position.

effects.formatted: At the end of their first turn, the bearer reduces damage by 10% (2 turns) for each enemy (excluding summons) in their line of sight.

items.name: Iridescent Pryank
items.description: This prysmaradite will give you that cheeky quality that teens have these days without sacrificing the obscene comfort of your privileged position.

effects.formatted: At the end of their first turn, the bearer reduces damage by 20% (1 turn) for each enemy (excluding summons) in their line of sight.

items.name: Disaprys
items.description: This prysmaradite will give you the wildest experiences that involve disappearing temporarily. For example, imagine the disappointment on your mother-in-law's face when she sees you reappear!

effects.formatted: The bearer becomes invisible (1 turn) at the start of their first round.

items.name: Prywitchment
items.description: This unbewitching prysmaradite is perfect if you want to train for the Kolossium after a rather boozy party. You Lousy Pig breath will even be an ally in close combat.

effects.formatted: Reduces the duration of active effects on the bearer by 4 at the start of their first round.

items.name: Pryshield
items.description: This prysmaradite is perfect for slugs and snails, and that's not just a metaphor.

effects.formatted: The bearer gains 200% of their level in shield (infinite) for each opponent (excluding summons) that plays before them.

items.name: Pryximity
items.description: This prysmaradite protects introverts at gatherings where a few too many people have... well, gathered.

effects.formatted: At the start of their first round, the bearer gains 200% of their level in shield (infinite) for each enemy (excluding summons) in their line of sight.

items.name: Prymune
items.description: This prysmaradite will be the delight of adventurers who don't show the slightest drop of initiative.
